Bava Metzia 85a:16-85b:3: Ulema leh kulle hay, deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hamelammed et ben chavero tora zoche veyoshev bishiva shel mala, shenneemar: "im tashuv vaashivcha lefanay taamod".
Vechol hamelammed et ben am haaretz tora – afillu hakkadosh baruch hu gozer gezera, mevattelah bishvilo, shenneemar: "veim totzi yakar mizzolel kefi tihye".

Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: kol shehu talmid chacham, uveno talmid chacham uven beno talmid chacham – shuv en tora poseket mizzaro leolam, shenneemar: "vaani zot beriti vegomer lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha amar Adonai meatta vead olam".
May "amar Adonai"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani arev lecha bedavar ze. may "meatta vead olam"? amar rabbi yirmeya: mikkan veelach tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah.

Rav yosef yetev arbein taaniyyata, veakreyu "lo yamushu mippicha". yetev arbaim taaniyyata acharine, veakreyuhu "lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha". yetev (mea) [arbein] taaniyyata achraynyata, veakreyu "lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha". amar: mikkan veelach la tzerichna – tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah.

Rabbi zera ki selek leara deyisrael yatev mea taaniyyata delishtakkach talmuda bavlaa minneh, ki hechi dela nitredeh. yetev mea achranyata dela lishkov rabbi elazar bishneh, venaflin illaveh mille detzibbura. vitev mea acharine, dela nishlot beh nura degehinnam.
Kol telatin yome hava badek nafsheh: shegar tannura selek vitev begavveh vela hava shalta beh nura. yoma chad yehavu beh rabbanan ena veicharachu shakeh, ukero leh "katin charich shakeh".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv "mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vaasher dibber pi Adonai elav veyaggidah al ma avda haaretz", davar ze

Amru chachamim velo pershuhu, amru neviim velo pershuhu, ad sheppersho hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai al ozvam et torati asher natatti lifnehem". amar rav yehuda amar rav: shello berchu battora techilla.

Amar rav chama: may dichtiv "belev navon tanuach chochma uvekerev kesilim tivvadea", "belev navon tanuach chochma" – ze talmid chacham ben talmid chacham, "uvekerev kesilim tivvadea" – ze talmid chacham ben am haaretz. amar ulla: hayeynu deamri inashe: istera belagina kish kish karya.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: may dichtiv "katon vegadol sham hu veeved chofshi meadonav"? attu la yadinan dekaton vegadol sham hu? ella kol hammaktin atzmo al divre tora baolam hazze – naasa gadol laolam habba, vechol hammesim atzmo keeved al divre tora baolam hazze – naase chofshi laolam habba.
Berakhot 8a:30-8b:10: Amar rav huna bar yehuda, amar rabbi amme: leolam yashlim adam parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur. shenayim mikra veechad targum.
Vaafillu "atarot vedivon". shekkol hammashlim parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur mearichin lo yamav ushenotav.
Rav bivi bar abbaye savar leashlominhu lefarashyayta decholla shatta bemaale yoma dechippure, tena leh chiyyay bar rav middifti: ketiv: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh baerev".
Vechi betisha mitannin?! vahalo baasara mitannin! ella lomar lecha kol haochel veshote bitshii, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitanne teshii vaasiri.
Savar leakdominhu, amar leh hahu sava, tenena: uvilvad shello yakdim veshello yeacher.
Kedaamar lehu rabbi yehoshua ben levi livneh: ashlimu parashyotayychu im hatztzibbur shenayim mikra veechad targum.
Vehizzaharu bivridin kerabbi yehuda, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot et havveridin.
Vehizzaharu bezaken sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso. deamrinan: luchot veshivre luchot munnachot baaron.
Amar lehu rava livneh: kesheattem chotchin basar, al tachtechu al gav hayyad. ikka deamri: mishshum sakkana. veikka deamri: mishshum kilkul seuda.

Veal teshvu al mittat arammit, veal taavru achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin. veal teshvu al mittat arammit, ikka deamri la tigno bela keriat shema, veikka deamri dela tinsevu giyyorta. veikka deamri, arammit mammash.

Umishshum maase derav pappa. derav pappa azal legabbe arammit, hotzia lo mitta. amra lo: shev! amar lah: eni yoshev, ad shettagbihi et hammitta. higbiha et hammitta umatzu sham tinok met. mikkan amru chachamim: asur leshev al mittat arammit.
Jeremiah 34:14-17: Mikketz sheva shanim teshallechu ish et-achiv haivri asher-yimmacher lecha vaavadcha shesh shanim veshillachto chofshi meimmach velo-shamu avotechem elay velo hittu et-oznam
Vattashuvu attem hayyom vattaasu et-hayyashar beenay likro deror ish lereehu vattichretu verit lefanay babbayit asher-nikra shemi alav
Vattashuvu vattechallelu et-shemi vattashivu ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato asher-shillachtem chofshim lenafsham vattichbeshu otam lihyot lachem laavadim velishfachot {s}

Lachen ko-amar Adonai attem lo-shematem elay likro deror ish leachiv veish lereehu hinni kore lachem deror neum-Adonai el-hacherev el-haddever veel-haraav venatatti etchem (lazevaah) [lezaava] lechol mamlechot haaretz
Jeremiah 34:18-22: Venatatti et-haanashim haovrim et-beriti asher lo-hekimu et-divre habberit asher kartu lefanay haegel asher kartu lishnayim vayyaavru ben betarav
Sare yehuda vesare yerushala͏m hassarisim vehakkohanim vechol am haaretz haovrim ben bitre haegel
Venatatti otam beyad oyvehem uveyad mevakshe nafsham vehayta nivlatam lemaachol leof hashshamayim ulevehemat haaretz
Veet-tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda veet-sarav etten beyad oyvehem uveyad mevakshe nafsham uveyad chel melech bavel haolim mealechem
Hinni metzavve neum-Adonai vahashivotim el-hair hazzot venilchamu aleha ulechaduha userafuha vaesh veet-are yehuda etten shemama meen yoshev {p}
Jeremiah 34:8-13: Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai achare kerot hammelech tzidkiyyahu berit et-kol-haam asher birushala͏m likro lahem deror
Leshallach ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato haivri vehaivriyya chofshim levilti avod-bam bihudi achihu ish
Vayyishmeu chol-hassarim vechol-haam asher-bau vabberit leshallach ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato chofshim levilti avod-bam od vayyishmeu vayshallechu
Vayyashuvu achare-chen vayyashivu et-haavadim veet-hashshefachot asher shillechu chofshim (vaykabeyshevam) [vayyichbeshum] laavadim velishfachot {p}
Vayhi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael anochi karatti verit et-avotechem beyom hotzii otam meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim lemor
Jeremiah 35:1-6: Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai bime yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda lemor
Haloch el-bet harechavim vedibbarta otam vahaviotam bet Adonai el-achat halleshachot vehishkita otam yayin
Vaekkach et-yaazanya ven-yirmeyahu ben-chavatztzinya veet-echav veet-kol-banav veet kol-bet harechavim
Vaavi otam bet Adonai el-lishkat bene chanan ben-yigdalyahu ish haelohim asher-etzel lishkat hassarim asher mimmaal lelishkat maaseyahu ven-shallum shomer hassaf
Vaetten lifne ׀ bene vet-harechavim geviim meleim yayin vechosot vaomar alehem shetu-yayin
Vayyomru lo nishte-yayin ki yonadav ben-rechav avinu tzivva alenu lemor lo tishtu-yayin attem uvenechem ad-olam
Jeremiah 35:7-11: Uvayit lo-tivnu vezera lo-tizrau vecherem lo-tittau velo yihye lachem ki boohalim teshvu kol-yemechem lemaan tichyu yamim rabbim al-pene haadama asher attem garim sham
Vannishma bekol yehonadav ben-rechav avinu lechol asher tzivvanu levilti shetot-yayin kol-yamenu anachnu nashenu banenu uvenotenu
Ulevilti benot battim leshivtenu vecherem vesade vazera lo yihye-lanu
Vanneshev boohalim vannishma vannaas kechol asher-tzivvanu yonadav avinu
Vayhi baalot nevuchadretztzar melech-bavel el-haaretz vannomer bou venavo yerushala͏m mippene chel hakkasdim umippene chel aram vanneshev birushala͏m {p}
Ketubot 22a:6-22b:1: Gemara amar rav assi: minnayin lehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir min hattora? shenneemar: "et bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha". "laish" — asra, "hazze" — hittira.

Lema li kera? sevara hi: hu asra, vehu share la! ella ki itzterich kera, lechidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin laav shenneeman leesor et bitto min hattora, shenneemar: "et bitti natatti laish". "hazze" lema li?
Mibbee leh lechidtane rabbi yona. detane rabbi yona: "et bitti natatti laish hazze". "hazze" — velo layyavam.

Tanu rabbanan: haishsha sheamra "eshet ish ani", vechazra veamra "penuya ani" — neemenet. veha shavvevya lenafsha chaticha deissura? amar rava bar rav huna: kegon shennatna ammatla lidvareha. tanya name hachi: amra eshet ish ani, vechazra veamra: penuya ani — enah neemenet. veim natna ammatla lidvareha — neemenet.

Umaase name beishsha achat gedola shehayta gedola benoy, vekaftzu aleha bene adam lekaddeshah. veamra lahem: "mekuddeshet ani". leyamim amda vekiddesha et atzmah. amru lah chachamim: ma rait laasot ken? amra lahem: battechilla shebbau alay anashim sheenam mehugganim, amarti: "mekuddeshet ani", achshav shebbau alay anashim mehugganim, amadti vekiddashti et atzmi. vezo halacha heela rav acha sar habbira lifne chachamim beusha, veamru: im natna ammatla lidvareha — neemenet.
Bea minneh shemuel merav: amra "temea ani", vechazra veamra "tehora ani", mahu? amar leh: af bezo, im natna
Ammatla lidvareha — neemenet. tena minneh arbaim zimnin, vaafillu hachi la avad shemuel ovada benafsheh.
Menachot 43a:15-43b:7: Tanu rabbanan: hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit, kohanim, leviyyim veyisreelim, gerim, nashim vaavadim. rabbi shimon poter benashim, mippene shemmitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot.
Amar mar: hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita, dei kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim petiri, man lichayyayv?

Kohanim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav. gedilim taase lach", man dela ishteri kilayim legabbeh bilvisha hu demichayyayv betzitzit, hane kohanim hoil veishteri kilayim legabbayyhu – la lichayyeyvu.
Ka mashma lan: nehi deishteri beiddan avoda, bela iddan avoda la ishteri.
Rabbi shimon poter benashim. may tama derabbi shimon? detanya: "ureitem oto" – perat lichsut layla.
Atta omer: perat lichsut layla, o eno ella perat lichsut some? keshehu omer: "asher techasse bah", hare kesut some amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "ureitem oto"? perat lichsut layla.
Uma raita lerabbot kesut some ulehotzi kesut layla? merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim, umotzi ani kesut layla sheenah biriyya etzel acherim.
Hay "asher techasse bah" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "al arba kanfot kesutecha" – arba velo shalosh.
Atta omer arba velo shalosh, o eno ella arba velo chamesh? keshehu omer "asher techasse bah", hare baalat chamesh amur, uma ani mekayyem "al arba"? arba velo shalosh.
Uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulehotzi baalat shalosh? merabbe ani baalat chamesh, sheyyesh bichlal chamesh arba, umotzi ani baalat shalosh, sheen bichlal shalosh arba.
Verabbi shimon, measher" nafka. verabbanan, "asher" la mashma lehu.

Verabbanan, hay "ureitem oto" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "ureitem oto uzechartem", ree mitzva zo uzechor mitzva acheret hatteluya (bo) [bah], veezo zo? zo keriyyat shema, ditnan: meematay korin et shema beshacharit? mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan.

Vetanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem" – ree mitzva zo uzechor mitzva acheret hassemucha lah, veezo zo? zo mitzvat kilayim, dichtiv: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav. gedilim taase lach".
Tanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai", kevan shennitchayyev adam bemitzva zo nitchayyev bechol mitzvot kullan, verabbi shimon hi, deamar: mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hi.
Mishnah Gittin 6:7-7:3:
Amar lishnayim, tenu get leishti, o lishlosha, kitvu get utenu leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. amar lishlosha, tenu get leishti, hare ellu yomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din, divre rabbi meir. vezo halacha heela rabbi chanina ish ono mibbet haasurin, mekubbal ani beomer lishlosha, tenu get leishti, sheyyomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din. amar rabbi yose, numenu lashshaliach, af anu mekubbalin, sheafillu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, tenu get leishti, sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu. amar laasara, kitvu get leishti, echad kotev ushenayim chotmin. kullechem ketovu, echad kotev vechullam chotmin. lefichach, im met echad mehen, hare ze get batel: 
Mi sheachazo kurdeyakos, veamar, kitvu get leishti, lo amar kelum. amar, kitvu get leishti, vaachazo kurdeyakos, vechazar veamar, al tichtovu, en devarav haacharonim kelum. nishtattek, veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha, vehirkin berosho, bodkin oto shelosha feamim, im amar al lav lav veal hen hen, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu: 
Amru lo, nichtov get leishtecha, veamar lahem ketovu, amru lassofer vechatav, velaedim vechatmu, af al pi shekketavuhu vachatamuhu unetanuhu lo vechazar unetano lah, hare hagget batel, ad sheyyomar lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu: 
Ze gittech im matti, ze gittech im matti mecholi ze, ze gittech leachar mita, lo amar kelum. mehayyom im matti, meachshav im matti, hare ze get. mehayyom uleachar mita, get veeno get. im met, choletzet velo mityabbemet. ze gittech mehayyom im matti mecholi ze, veamad vehilech bashshuk vechala umet, omdin oto, im mechamat choli harishon met, hare ze get. veim lav, eno get:
Mishnah Gittin 7:4-7:
Lo tityached immo ella vifne edim, afillu eved, afillu shifcha, chutz mishshifchatah, mippene shellibbah gas bah beshifchatah. ma hi veotan hayyamim. rabbi yehuda omer, keeshet ish lechol devareha. rabbi yose omer, megoreshet veenah megorashet: 
Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz, hare zo megoreshet, vetitten. al menat shettitteni li mikkan vead sheloshim yom, im natna lo vetoch sheloshim yom, megoreshet, veim lav, ena megoreshet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, maase vetzaydan beechad sheamar leishto, hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li itzteliti, veavda itztelito, veamru chachamim, titten lo et dameha: 
Hare ze gittech al menat shetteshammeshi et abba, al menat shetteniki et beni, kamma hi menikato, shete shanim. rabbi yehuda omer, shemona asar chodesh. met habben o shemmet haav, hare ze get. hare ze gittech al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim, al menat shetteniki et beni shete shanim, met habben o shemmet haav o sheamar haav i efshi shetteshammesheni, shello vehakepada, eno get. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kaze get. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, kol akkava sheenah hemenna, hare ze get: 
Hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan vead sheloshim yom, vehaya holech mihuda laggalil, higgia leantippatres vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan ad sheloshim yom, vehaya holech miggalil lihuda, vehiggia lichfar otnay vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan ad sheloshim yom, vehaya holech limdinat hayyam vehiggia leakko vechazar, batel tenao. hare ze gittech kol zeman sheeevor mikkeneged panayich sheloshim yom, haya holech uva, holech uva, hoil velo nityached immah, hare ze get:
Mishnah Gittin 7:8-8:3:
Hare ze gittech im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, umet betoch shenem asar chodesh, eno get. hare ze gittech meachshav im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, umet betoch shenem asar chodesh, hare ze get: 
Im lo vati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh kitvu utenu get leishti, katvu get betoch shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh, eno get. kitvu utenu get leishti im lo vati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, katvu vetoch shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh, eno get. rabbi yose omer, kaze get. katvu leachar shenem asar chodesh venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh umet, im hagget kadam lammita, hare ze get. veim mita kadma lagget, eno get. veim en yadua, zo hi sheamru, megoreshet veenah megorashet: 
Hazzorek get leishto vehi vetoch betah o vetoch chatzerah, hare zo megoreshet. zerako lah betoch beto o vetoch chatzero, afillu hu immah bammitta, enah megoreshet. letoch chekah o letoch kaltah, hare zo megorashet: 
Amar lah, kinsi shetar chov ze, o shemmetzaato meachorav, kora vahare hu gittah, eno get, ad sheyyomar lah, he gittech. natan beyadah vehi yeshena, neora, kora vahare hu gittah, eno get, ad sheyyomar lah he ze gittech. hayta omedet birshut harabbim uzerako lah, karov lah, megoreshet. karov lo, enah megoreshet. mechetza al mechetza, megoreshet veenah megorashet: 
Vechen leinyan kiddushin. vechen leinyan hachov. amar lo baal chovo, zerok li chovi, uzerako lo, karov lammalve, zacha hallove. karov lallove, hallove chayyav. mechetza al mechetza, shenehem yachaloku. hayta omedet al rosh haggag uzerako lah, kevan shehiggia laavir haggag, hare zo megoreshet. hu milmala vehi millematta uzerako lah, kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag, nimchak o nisraf, hare zo megorashet:
Mishnah Gittin 8:4-7:
Bet shammay omrim, poter adam et ishto veget yashan. uvet hillel osrin. veezehu get yashan, kol shennityached immah achar shekketavo lah: 
Katav leshum malchut sheenah hogenet, leshum malchut maday, leshum malchut yavan, levinyan habbayit, lechurban habbayit, haya vammizrach vechatav bammaarav, bammaarav vechatav bammizrach, tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze, veen lah lo chetubba velo ferot velo mezonot velo velaot, lo al ze velo al ze. im natla mizze umizze, tachazir. vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze mittammein lah, velo ze vaze zakkain lo vimtziatah velo vemaase yadeha velo vahafarat nedareha. hayta vat yisrael, nifselet min hakkehunna. bat levi, min hammaaser. bat kohen, min hatteruma. veen yorshav shel ze veyorshav shel ze yorshin ketubbatah. veim metu, achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin. shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah: 
Kol haarayot sheamru tzarotehen muttarot, halchu hatztzarot haellu venisseu venimtzeu ellu ayloniyyot, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah: 
Hakkones et yevimto vehalcha tzaratah venisset leacher venimtzea zot shehi aylonit, tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu vah:
Mishnah Gittin 8:8-9:1:
Katav sofer get laish veshover laishsha, vetaa venatan get laishsha veshover laish, venatnu ze laze, uleachar zeman hare hagget yotze miyyad haish, veshover miyyad haishsha, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah. rabbi eliezer omer, im lealtar yatza, en ze get. im leachar zeman yatza, hare ze get. lo chol hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni. katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, bet shammay omrim, pesalah min hakkehunna. uvet hillel omrim, af al pi shennetano lah al tenay velo naasa hattenay, lo fesalah min hakkehunna: 
Hamegaresh et ishto velana immo befundeki, bet shammay omrim, enah tzerichah hemennu get sheni. uvet hillel omrim, tzericha hemennu get sheni. ematay, bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin. umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah. kenasah beget kereach, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu vah: 
Get kereach, hakkol mashlimin alav, divre ven nannas. rabbi akiva omer, en mashlimin alav ella kerovim haruyin lehaid bemakom acher. veezehu get kereach. kol shekkesharav merubbin meedav: 
Hamegaresh et ishto veamar lah, hare at mutteret lechol adam ella lifloni, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin. ketzad yaase. yittelennu hemenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah veyomar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam. veim ketavo vetocho, af al pi shechazar umechako, pasul:
Mishnah Gittin 9:2-6:
Hare at mutteret lechol adam ella leabba uleavich, leachi uleachich, leeved ulenachri, ulechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin, kasher. hare at mutteret lechol adam, ella almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, ulechol mi sheyyesh lah alav kiddushin afillu vaavera, pasul: 
Gufo shel get, hare at mutteret lechol adam. rabbi yehuda omer, veden deyeheve lichi minnay sefer teruchin veiggeret shibbukin veget pitturin, limhach lehitnesava lechol gevar detitzbayin. gufo shel get shichrur, hare at bat chorin, hare at leatzmech: 
Shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset, havvalad kasher. katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad, hare ellu shelosha gittin pesulin. veim nisset, havvalad kasher. rabbi elazar omer, af al pi sheen alav edim ella shennetano lah bifne edim, kasher vegova minnechasim meshubadim, sheen haedim chotmin al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam: 
Shenayim sheshshalchu shene gittin shavin venitarvu, noten shenehem lazo ushenehem lazo. lefichach, avad achad mehen, hare hashsheni vatel. chamishsha shekkatvu chelal betoch hagget, ish peloni megaresh pelonit ufeloni pelonit, vehaedim millematta, kullan kesherin, veyinnaten lechol achat veechat. haya chatuv tofes lechol achat veachat, vehaedim millematta, et shehaedim nikrin immo, kasher: 
Shene gittin shekketavan ze vetzad ze ushenayim edim ivrim baim mittachat ze letachat ze ushenayim edim yevanim baim mittachat ze letachat ze, et shehaedim harishonim nikrain immo, kasher. ed echad ivri veed echad yevani, ed echad ivri veed echad yevani bain mittachat ze letachat ze, shenehen pesulin:
Mishnah Kelim 7:2-5:
Dachon sheyyesh bo vet kibbul kederot, tahor mishshum kira, vetame mishshum keli kibbul. hatztzedadin shello, hannogea bahem eno tame mishshum kira. harachav shello, rabbi meir metaher, verabbi yehuda metamme. vechen hakkofe et hassal veose al gabbav kira: 
Kira shennechleka learkah, tehora. ulerachbah, temea. kuppach shennechlak ben learko ben lerachbo, tahor. chatzar hakkira, bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot, mittammea vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan, mittammea vemagga veenah mittammea vaavir. ketzad meshaarin otah. rabbi yishmael omer, noten et hashshappud milmalan lemattan uchenegdo mittammea vaavir. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, nitmea hakkira, nitmet hechatzer. nitmea hechatzer, lo nitmet hakkira: 
Hayta mufreshet min hakkira, bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot, mittamma vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan o shehayta chalaka, tehora. pitpute chira, shelosha, shel shalosh etzbaot, mittammeim bemagga uvaavir. pachot mikkan, kol shekken hen temeim, vaafillu hen arbaa: 
Nittal achad mehen, mittammein bemagga veenam mittammeim baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. asa shenayim, ze cheneged ze, mittammein bemagga uvaavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. hayu gevohin mishshalosh etzbaot, mishshalosh ulemattan mittammeim bemagga uvaavir, mishshalosh ulemalan mittammein bemagga veenan mittammein baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. hayu meshuchim min hassafa, betoch shalosh etzbaot, mittammeim bemagga uvaavir, chutz mishshalosh etzbaot mittammeim bemagga veenam mittammeim baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher:
Mishnah Kelim 7:6-8:4: Ketzad meshaarin otan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten et hakkanna benehen, min hakkanna velachutz tahor, min hakkanna velifnim, umekom hakkanna tame:

Hattannur shechatzatzo vinsarim o viriot, nimtza sheretz bemakom echad, hakkol tame. kavveret pechuta ufekuka vekash umeshulshelet laavir hattannur, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tame. hashsheretz battannur, ochalin shebbetochah temein. verabbi eliezer metaher. amar rabbi eliezer, im hitztzila vemet hechamur, lo tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal. amru lo, im hitztzila vemet hechamur, shekken cholkim ohalim, tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal, sheen cholkim keli chares:

Hayta shelema, vechen hakkuppa, vechen hachemet, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tahor. hashsheretz battannur, ochalin shebbetochah tehorin. nikkevu, heasuy leochalin, shiuran bezetim. heasuy lemashkin, shiuran bemashkim. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilim oto lechumro, bechones mashke:

Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur veshokaat letocho veen lah gappayim, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tame. hashsheretz battannur, ochalim shebbetochah, temein, sheen matztzilin miyyad keli cheres ella chelim. chavit shehi melea mashkin tehorin, unetuna lematta minnechushto shel tannur, hashsheretz battannur, hechavit vehammashkin tehorin. hayta chefuya ufiha laavir hattannur, hashsheretz battannur, mashke tofeach shebbeshule hechavit tahor:

Kedera shehi netuna vattannur, hashsheretz battannur, hakkedera tehora, sheen keli cheres metamme chelim. haya vah mashke tofeach, nitma vetimmeah. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
Mishnah Kelim 8:5-8: Tarnegol shebbala et hashsheretz venafal laavir hattannur, tahor. veim met, tame. hashsheretz shennimtza vattannur, happat shebbetocho, sheniyya, shehattannur techilla:

Bet seor mukkaf tzamid patil venatun letoch hattannur, hasseor vehashsheretz betocho vehakkeretz bentayim, hattannur tame vehasseor tahor. veim haya chazzayit min hammet, hattannur vehabbayit tame, vehasseor tahor. im yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame:

Hashsheretz shennimtza vaayin shel tannur, baayin shel kira, baayin shel kuppach, min hassafa happenimit velachutz, tahor. veim haya vaavir, afillu chazzayit min hammet, tahor. veim yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame:

Nimtza mekom hannachat haetzim, rabbi yehuda omer, min hassafa hachitzona velifnim, tame. vachachamim omrim, missafa happenimit velachutz, tahor. rabbi yose omer, mikkeneged shefitat hakkedera velifnim, tame. mikkeneged shefitat hakkedera velachutz, tahor. nimtza mekom yeshivat habballan, mekom yeshivat hatztzabba, mekom yeshivat shel sholke zetim, tahor. en tame ella min hassetima velifnim:
Mishnah Kelim 8:9-9:1: Bor sheyyesh bo vet shefita, tame. veshel ose zechuchit, im yesh bo vet shefita, tame. kivshan shel sayyadin veshel zaggagin veshel yotzrim, tehora. furena, im yesh lah lizbez, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lah istegiyyot. rabban gamliel omer, im yesh lah sefayot:

Magga teme met, shehayu ochalin umashkin letoch piv, hichnis rosho laavir hattannur tahor, timmeuhu. vetahor shehayu ochalin umashkin letoch piv vehichnis rosho laavir hattannur tame, nitmau. haya ochel devela veyadayim mesoavot, hichnis yado letoch piv littol et hatztzeror, rabbi meir metamme, rabbi yehuda metaher. rabbi yose omer, im hafach, tame. im lo hafach, tahor. haya fundeyon letoch piv, rabbi yose omer, im litzmao, tame:

Haishsha shennataf chalav middaddeha venafal laavir hattannur, tame, shehammashke metamme leratzon veshello leratzon. hayta gorafto vehikkattah hakkotz veyatza mimmenna dam, o shennichvat venatna etzbaah letoch piha, nitma:

Machat o tabbaat shennimtzeu vinchushto shel tannur, nirin aval lo yotzim, im ofe et habbatzek vehu nogea bahen, tame. beeze vatzek amru, bevatzek habbenoni. nimtzeu vitfelat hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, im betame, temein. veim betahor, tehorim. nimtzeu vimgufat hechavit, mitztziddeha, temeim, mikkeneged piha, tehorim. nirin betochah aval lo laavirah, tehorin. shokim betochah vetachtehem kiklippat hashshum, tehorin:
Mishnah Kelim 9:2-6:
Chavit shehi melea mashkin tehorin umenikat betochah, mukkefet tzamid patil unetuna veohel hammet, bet shammay omrim, hechavit vehammashkin tehorin, umenikat temea. uvet hillel omrin, af menikat tehora. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay: 
Hashsheretz shennimtza lematta minnechushto shel tannur, tahor, sheani omer, chay nafal veachshav met. machat o tabbaat shennimtzeu lematta minnechushto shel tannur, tahor, sheani omer, sham hayu ad shello va hattannur. nimtzeu veefer mikle, tame, sheen lo vamme yitle: 
Sefog shebbala mashkin temein venaguv mibbachutz venafal laavir hattannur, tame, shessof mashke latzet. vechen chaticha shel lefet veshel gemi. rabbi shimon metaher bishne ellu: 
Charasin shennishtammesh bahen mashkin temein venaflu laavir hattannur, hussak hattannur, tame, shessof mashke latzet. vechen begefet chadasha, aval bishana, tahor. veim yadua sheyyotze mehen mashkin, afillu leachar shalosh shanim, nitma: 
Haggefet vehazzaggin shennaasu vetohora vehalchu alehem temeim, veachar kach yatzu mehen mashkin, tehorin, shemmittechillatan naasu vetohora. kush shebbala et hatztzinnora, malmad shebbala et haddarvan, levena shebbala et hattabbaat, vehen tehorim, nichnesu leohel hammet, nitmau. hesitan hazzav, nitmau. naflu laavir hattannur tahor, timmeuhu. naga bahen kikkar shel teruma, tahor:
Mishnah Kelim 9:7-10:2:
Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, nisdak min hattannur lassereda, shiuro melo fi mardea shello nichnas. rabbi yehuda omer, nichnas. nisdeka sereda, shiuro chimlo fi marde nichnas. rabbi yehuda omer, shello nichnas. haya agol, en roin oto aroch, ella shiuro chimlo fi mardea nichnas: 
Tannur shennikkav meeno, shiuro melo chush nichnas veyotze dolek. rabbi yehuda omer, shello dolek. nikkav mitztziddo, shiuro chimlo chush nichnas veyotze shello dolek. rabbi yehuda omer, dolek. rabbi shimon omer, min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. vechen haya omer bimgufat hechavit shennikkeva, shiurah melo mitza sheniyya shel shifon. min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. vechen haya omer bachatzavim gedolim shennikkevu, shiuram melo mitza sheniyya shel kane. min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shennaasu leyayin, aval im naasu lishar mashkin, afillu chol shehu, temeim. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shello naasu vide adam. aval im naasu vide adam, afillu chol shehu, temeim. nikkevu, heasuy loochalim, shiuran bezetim. heasuy lemashkim, shiuran bemashkim. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilim oto lechumro, betzamid patil uvechones mashke: 
Ellu chelim matztzilin betzamid patil, kele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, kele cheres, uchele neter, atzmot haddag veoro, atzmot chayya shebbayyam veorah, uchele etz hattehorim. matztzilim ben mippihem ben mitztziddehen, ben yoshvin al shulehen ben muttin al tziddehen. hayu chefuyim al pihen, matztzilim kol shettachtehen ad hattehom. rabbi eliezer metamme. al hakkol matztzilin, chutz mikkele cheres, sheeno matztzil ella al hoochalim veal hammashkin veal kele chares: 
Bamme makkifim. besid uvegippesis, bezefet uveshaava, betit uvetzoa, bechomer uvecharsit, uvechol davar hammitmareach. en makkifim lo bevaatz velo veoferet, mippene shehu fatil veeno tzamid. en makkifin lo vidvela shemena, velo bevatzek shennillosh beme ferot, shello yeviennu lide fesul. veim hikkif, hitztzil:
Mishnah Maasrot 1:1-2:
Kelal amru bammaasrot, kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulav min haaretz, chayyav bammaasrot. veod kelal acher amru, kol shettechillato ochel vesofo ochel, af al pi shehu shomro lehosif ochel, chayyav katan vegadol. vechol sheen techillato ochel aval sofo ochel, eno chayyav ad sheyyease ochel: 
Meematay happerot chayyavot bammaasrot. hatteenim, mishsheyyavchilu. haanavim vehoovashim, mishshehivishu. haog vehattutim, mishsheyyadimu. vechol haadummim, mishsheyyadimu. harimmonim, mishsheyyimmassu. hattemarim, mishsheyyattilu seor. haafarsekim, mishsheyyattilu gidim. haegozim, mishsheyyaasu megura. rabbi yehuda omer, haegozim vehashshekedim, mishsheyyaasu kelippa:
Mishnah Maasrot 1:3-6:
Hecharuvin, mishsheyyinnakedu. vechol hashshechorim, mishsheyyinnakdu. haagasim vehakkerustomelin vehapparishin vehauzradim, mishsheyyikkarechu. vechol hallevanim, mishsheyyikkarechu. hattiltan, mishshettetzammeach. hattevua vehazzetim, mishsheyyachnisu shelish: 
Uvayyarak, hakkishshuin vehaddeluim vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot, hattappuchim vehaetrogin, chayyavim gedolim uketannim. rabbi shimon poter et haetrogim bekatnan. hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim, patur bammetukim, hachayyav bammetukim, patur bammarim: 
Ezehu garnan lammaasrot. hakkishshuim vehaddeluim, mishsheyyefaksu. veim eno mefakkes, mishsheyyaamid arema. avattiach, mishsheyyeshallek. veim eno meshallek, ad sheyyaase muktze. yarak hanneegad, mishsheyyogad. im eno oged, ad sheyyemalle et hakkeli. veim eno memalle et hakkeli, ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko. kalkala, ad sheyyechappe. veim eno mechappe, ad sheymalle et hakkeli. veim eno memalle et hakkeli, ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko. bamme devarim amurim, bemolich lashshuk. aval bemolich leveto, ochel mehem aray ad shehu maggia leveto: 
Happered vehatztzimmukin vehecharuvin, mishsheyyaamid arema. habbetzalim, mishsheyyefakkel. veim eno mefakkel, mishsheyyaamid arema. hattevua, mishsheyyemareach. veim eno memareach, ad sheyyaamid arema. hakkitniyyot, mishsheyyichbor. veim eno chover, ad sheyyemareach. af al pi shemmerach, notel min hakkuttaim umin hatztzedadim umimma shebbetoch hatteven, veochel:
Mishnah Maasrot 1:7-2:3:
Hayyayin, mishsheyyekappe. af al pi shekkippa, kolet min haggat haelyona umin hatztzinnor, veshote. hashshemen, mishsheyyered lauka. af al pi sheyyarad, notel min heakal umibben hammamal umibben happatztzim, venoten lachamitta velattamchuy, aval lo yitten lakkedera velallefas keshehen rotchin. rabbi yehuda omer, lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir: 
Haiggul, mishsheyyachalikennu. machalikim bitenim uvaanavim shel tevel. rabbi yehuda oser. hammachalik baanavim, lo huchshar. rabbi yehuda omer, huchshar. haggerogarot, mishsheyyadush. umegura mishsheyyeaggel. haya dash bechavit umeaggel bammegura, nishbera hechavit veniftecha hammegura, lo yochal mehem aray. rabbi yose mattir: 
Haya over bashshuk veamar, telu lachem teenim, ochlin ufeturin. lefichach im hichnisu levattehem, metakkenim vadday. telu vehachenisu levattechem, lo yochlu mehem aray. lefichach im hichnisu levattehem, enam metakkenim ella demay: 
Hayu yoshvin bashshaar o vachanut, veamar, telu lachem teenim, ochlin ufeturin, uvaal hashshaar uvaal hachanut chayyavin. rabbi yehuda poter, ad sheyyachazir et panav, o ad sheyyeshanne mekom yeshivato: 
Hammaale ferot min haggalil lihuda, o ole lirushalayim, ochel mehem ad shehu maggia lemakom shehu holech, vechen bihuda. rabbi meir omer, ad shehu maggia limkom hashshevita. veharochlin hammechazzerin baayarot, ochlim ad shemmaggiim limkom hallina. rabbi yehuda omer, habbayit harishon hu veto:
Mishnah Maasrot 2:4-7:
Perot shetteraman ad shello nigmera melachtan, rabbi eliezer oser milleechol mehem aray. vachachamim mattirin, chutz mikkalkalat teenim. kalkalat teenim shetteramah, rabbi shimon mattir, vachachamim osrin: 
Haomer lachavero, helach issar ze veten li vo chamesh teenim, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, ochel achat achat, patur, veim tzeraf, chayyav. amar rabbi yehuda, maase veginnat veradim shehayta virushalayim, vehayu teenim nimkarot mishshalosh umearba beissar, velo hufrash mimmenna teruma umaaser meolam: 
Haomer lachavero, helach issar ze beeser teenim sheavor li, borer veochel. beeshkol sheavor li, megarger veochel. berimmon sheavor li, poret veochel. baavattiach sheavor li, sofet veochel. aval im amar lo beesrim teenim elu, bishne eshkolot elu, bishne rimmonim elu, bishne avattichim elu, ochel kedarko ufatur, mippene shekkana vimchubbar lakkarka: 
Hassocher et happoel liktzot immo bitenim, amar lo al menat sheochal teenim, ochel ufatur. al menat sheochal ani uvene veti, o sheyyochal beni bischari, hu ochel ufatur, uveno ochel vechayyav. al menat sheochal bishat hakketzia uleachar hakketzia, bishat hakketzia ochel ufatur, uleachar hakketzia ochel vechayyav, sheeno ochel min hattora. ze hakkelal, haochel min hattora, patur, vesheeno ochel min hattora, chayyav:
Mishnah Maasrot 2:8-3:3:
Haya ose vilvasim, lo yochal bivnot sheva. bivnot sheva, lo yochal bilvasim. aval monea hu et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel. hammachalif im chavero, ze leechol veze leechol, ze liktzot veze liktzot, ze leechol veze liktzot, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, hammachalif leechol, chayyav, veliktzot, patur: 
Hammaavir teenim bachatzero liktzot, banav uvene veto ochlin ufeturin. happoalim sheimmo, bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot, ochlin ufeturin. aval im yesh lahem alav mezonot, hare ellu lo yochelu: 
Hammotzi poalav lassade, bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot, ochlin ufeturin. veim yesh lahem alav mezonot, ochlin achat achat min hatteena, aval lo min hassal velo min hakkuppa velo min hammuktze: 
Hassocher et happoel laasot bezetim, amar lo al menat leechol zetim, ochel echad echad ufatur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. lenakkesh bivtzalim, amar lo al menat leechol yarak, mekartem ale ale veochel. veim tzeraf, chayyav:
Mishnah Terumot 11:4-8:
Uktze teenim ugerogarot, vehakkelisim vehecharuvin shel teruma, asurim lezarim: 
Garine teruma, bizman shehu mechannesan, asurot, veim hishlichan, muttarot. vechen atzmot hakkadashim, bizman shehu mechannesan, asurin, veim hishlichan, muttarin. hammursan muttar. subbin shel chadashot asurot, veshel yeshanot muttarot. venoheg batteruma kederech shehu noheg bachullin. hamesallet kav o kabbayim lisa, lo yeabbed et hashshear, ella yannichennu bemakom hammutzna: 
Megura sheppinna mimmenna chitte teruma, en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umelakket achat achat, ella mechabbed kedarko, venoten letochah chullin: 
Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha, en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umetappeach, ella noheg bah kederech shehu noheg bechullin: 
Hameare mikkad lechad venotef shalosh tippim, noten letochah chullin. hirkinah umitztzah, hare zo teruma. vechamma tehe vitrumat maaser shel demay veyolichenna lakkohen, echad mishshemona lashsheminit:
Mishnah Terumot 11:9-10:
Karshine teruma, maachilin otam labbehema velachayya velattarnegolim. yisrael shessachar para mikkohen, maachilah karshine teruma. vechohen shessachar para miyyisrael, af al pi shemmezonoteha alav, lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen, lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. vechohen sheshsham para miyyisrael, maachilah karshine teruma: 
Madlikin shemen serefa bevatte chenesiyyot, uvevatte midrashot, uvammevoot haafelin, veal gabbe hacholin birshut kohen. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, vehi lemuda etzel aviha, aviha madlik birshutah. madlikin bevet hammishte, aval lo vevet haevel, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose omer, bevet haevel, aval lo vevet hammishte. rabbi meir oser kan vechan. rabbi shimon mattir kan vechan:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1:11-13: Vee ze hu zemanna bayyom. mitzvatah sheyyatchil likrot kodem hanetz hachamma kede sheyyigmor likrot ulevarech beracha acharona im hanetz hachamma. veshiur ze kemo [issur] shaa kodem shettaale hashshemesh. veim icher vekara keriat shema achar shettaale hashshemesh yatza yede chovato sheonatah ad sof shalosh shaot bayyom lemi sheavar veicher:

Mi shehikdim vekara keriat shema shel shacharit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar af al pi shehishlim kodem shettanetz hachamma yatza yede chovato. uvishat haddechak kegon shehaya mashkim latzet ladderech kore lechattechilla mishsheala ammud hashshachar:

Hakkore achar shalosh shaot bayyom afillu haya anus lo yatza yede chovat keriat shema beonato. ella hare hu kekore battora. umevarech lefaneha uleachareha kol hayyom afillu icher vekara achar shalosh shaot:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:1-3: Hakkore et shema velo kivven libbo befasuk rishon shehu <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael" lo yatza yede chovato vehashshear im lo kivven libbo yatza. afillu haya kore battora kedarko o maggiah et happarashiyyot haellu beonat keria yatza vehu shekkivven libbo befasuk rishon:

Kol adam korin kedarkan ben omdin ben mehallechin ben shochvin ben rochvin al gabbe behema. veasur likrot keriat shema vehu muttal ufanav tuchot bakkarka o mushlach al gabbo ufanav lemala. aval kore hu vehu shochev al tziddo. veim haya baal basar harebe veeno yachol lehithappech al tziddo o shehaya chole note meat letziddo vekore:
Mi shehaya mehallech al raglav omed befasuk rishon vehashshear kore vehu mehallech. haya yashen metzaarin oto umeirin oto ad sheyyikra pasuk rishon umikkan veelach im anasattu shena en metzaarin oto:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:4-6: Mi shehaya osek bimlacha mafsik ad sheyyikra parasha rishona kullah. vechen haummanin betelin mimmelachtan befarasha rishona kede shello tehe keriatan aray, vehashshear kore hu kedarko veosek bimlachto. afillu haya omed berosh hailan o berosh hakkotel kore bimkomo umevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
Haya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman keriat shema posek vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. haya osek betzarche rabbim lo yifsok ella yigmor iskehen veyikra im nishar et likrot:

Haya osek baachila o shehaya bammerchatz o shehaya osek betisporet o shehaya mehappech beorot o shehayu oskin baddin gomer veachar kach kore keriat shema. veim haya mityare shemma yaavor zeman keria ufasak vekara hare ze meshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:7-8: Mi sheyyarad litbol im yachol laalot ulehitkassot kodem shettanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra. veim haya mityare shemma tanetz hachamma kodem sheyyikra yitkasse bammayim shehu omed bahen veyikra. velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim sherechan ra velo beme hammishre velo bemayim tzelulin mippene sheervato niret bahen. aval mitkasse hu bemayim achurin sheen rechan ra vekore bimkomo:

Hakkore keriat shema lo yirmoz beenav velo yikrotz bisfatav velo yare beetzbeotav kede shello tihye keriato aray. veim asa ken af al pi sheyyatza yede chovato hare ze megunne. vetzarich lehashemia leazno keshehu kore veim lo hishmia leazno yatza. vetzarich ledakdek beotiyyotav veim lo dikdek yatza:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:9-10: Ketzad yedakdek. yishmor shello yarpe hechazak velo yachazik harafe velo yaniach hannad velo yanid hannach. lefichach tzarich litten revach ben haddevakim ben kol shete otiyyot haddomot sheachat mehen sof teva vehaacheret techillat teva hassemucha lah. kegon bechol levavcha kore bechol veshohe vechozer vekore levavcha. vechen vaavadtem mehera. hakkanaf petil. vetzarich levaer zayin shel tizkeru. vetzarich lehaarich bedalet shel echad kede sheyyamlichehu bashshamayim uvaaretz uvearba ruchot. vetzarich shello yachtof bachet kede shello yehe keomer e chad:
Kore adam et shema bechol lashon sheyyihye mevinah. vehakkore bechol lashon tzarich lehizzaher middivre shibbush shebbeoto hallashon umedakdek beoto hallashon kemo shemmedakdek bilshon hakkodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:8-9: Yisrael sheamar lenachri laasot lo melacha zo beshabbat af al pi sheavar umakkin oto makkat mardut muttar lo lehanot beotah melacha laerev achar sheyyamtin bichde shettease. velo asru bechol makom ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu ella mippene davar ze. sheim tomar yehe muttar miyyad shemma yomar lenachri laasot lo veyimtza haddavar muchan miyyad. vechevan sheasru ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu lo yomar lenachri laasot lo shehare eno mistakker kelum mippene shehu mitakkev laerev bichde sheyyease davar ze shennaasa beshabbat:

Davar sheeno melacha veen asur laasoto beshabbat ella mishshum shevut muttar leyisrael lomar lenachri laasoto beshabbat. vehu sheyyihye sham miktzat choli o yihye tzarich laddavar tzorech harebe o mippene mitzva:
Niddah 17a:9-10: Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim neemru batztzippornayim: sorfan — chasid, kovran — tzaddik, zorkan — rasha.

Vehammakkiz dam umeshammesh mittato — deamar mar: makkiz dam umeshammesh mittato — hoviyn lo banim vittekin. hikkizu shenehem veshimmeshu — hoviyn lo banim baale ratan. amar rav: vela amaran ella dela teem midde, aval teem midde — let lan ba.

Toavat melachim asot resha ki vitzdaka yikkon kisse
Shabbat 127a:13-127b:8: Mippene haorchin vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: gedola hachenasat orchin kehashekamat bet hammidrash, dekatane: "mippene haorchin umippene bittul bet hammidrash". verav dimi minnehardea amar: yoter mehashekamat bet hammidrash, dekatane "mippene haorchin", vahadar "umippene bittul bet hammidrash". amar rav yehuda amar rav: gedola hachenasat orchin mehakebalat pene shechina, dichtiv: "vayyomar Adonai im na matzati chen beenecha al na taavor vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vedam, en katan yachol lomar laggadol "hameten ad sheavo etzlecha", veillu behakkadosh baruch hu ketiv "vayyomar Adonai im na matzati vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha devarim adam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, veellu hen: hachenasat orchin, uvikkur cholim, veiyyun tefilla, vehashekamat bet hammidrash, vehamegaddel banav letalmud tora, vehaddan et chavero lechaf zechut.

Ini?! veha anan tenan: ellu devarim sheadam ose otam veochel perotehen baolam hazze, vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, veellu hen: kibbud av vaem, ugemilut chasadim, vahavaat shalom shebben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam [hane — in, midde acharina — la]!
Hane name, (bigmilut chasadim shayychi. lishshana acharina: hane) behane shayychi.

Tanu rabbanan: haddan chavero lechaf zechut — danin oto lizchut. umaase beadam echad sheyyarad miggalil haelyon veniskar etzel baal habbayit echad baddarom shalosh shanim. erev yom hakkippurim amar lo: ten li sechari, veelech veazun et ishti uvanay. amar lo: en li maot. amar lo: ten li perot. amar lo: en li. ten li karka — en li. ten li behema — en li. ten li karim uchesatot — en li. hifshil kelav laachorav, vehalach leveto befache nefesh.

Leachar haregel natal baal habbayit secharo beyado, veimmo massoy shelosha chamorim, echad shel maachol, veechad shel mishte, veechad shel mine megadim, vehalach lo leveto. achar sheachlu veshatu natan lo secharo.

Amar lo: beshaa sheamarta li "ten li sechari" veamarti "en li maot", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma perakmatya bezol nizdammena lecha, velakachta bahen. uveshaa sheamarta li "ten li behema", veamarti "en li behema", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma musekeret beyad acherim. beshaa sheamarta li "ten li karka", veamarti lecha "en li karka", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma muchekeret beyad acherim hi. uveshaa sheamarti lecha "en li perot" bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma enan meussarot. uveshaa sheamarti lecha "en li karim uchesatot" bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma hikdish kol nechasav lashshamayim.

Amar lo: haavoda! kach haya. hiddarti kol nechasay bishvil hurekanos beni shello asak battora. ucheshebbati etzel chaveray baddarom hittiru li kol nedaray. veatta, keshem sheddantani lizchut, hammakom yadin otcha lizchut.
Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad sheppada riva achat bat yisrael, velammalon hishkivah tachat margelotav. lemachar yarad vetaval veshana letalmidav.
Veamar lahen: beshaa shehishkavtiha tachat margelotay, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: shemma yesh banu talmid sheeno baduk lerabbi.

Beshaa sheyyaradti vetavalti, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: shemma mippene torach hadderech era keri lerabbi. amar lahem: haavoda! kach haya. veattem, keshem sheddantuni lechaf zechut, hammakom yadin etchem lechaf zechut.
Zohar, Mishpatim 20: (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach, (iyyov 28:12) vehachachma meayin timmatze veeze mekom bina. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu bae leyakkera lon, yatir (nusach acher bikara dilhon) al kol shear beni alma. bekadmita amar lon, (Shemot 19:6) veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim. la ade rechimuta sagia minnehon, ad dekara lon vegoy kadosh deihu yatir. la ade rechimuta minnehon, ad dekara lon (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta. la ade rechimuta minnehon, ad dekara lon (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li deihu yatir mikkolla.

Ketiv vehachachma meayin timmatze. orayyta (Bereshit 47 amud bet) mechachma nafkat, meatar deikre (59) kodesh. vehachachma nafkat, meatar deikre kodesh hakkodashim. ribbi yitzchak amar, vechen yovla itkere kodesh. dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:12) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem. veyisrael kelilan minnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv veanshe kodesh tihyun li.

Bekadmita kadosh, vehasheta kodesh. ma (Vayikra 299 amud alef) ben hay lehay. amar ribbi yosi, da leella leella, veda lav hachi. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40 kadosh yeamer lo. behay atar ikre kadosh uleella leella kodesh.

Rabbi abba hava azil bearcha, vahavu azle immeh ribbi yosi veribbi chiyyay, amar ribbi chiyyay, (sefer acher detanenan) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, menalan. amar leh, ha ribbi yosi vechullehu chavrayyay shappir kamru, vehachi hu. menalan. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, reshit: vadday chachma ikre rishit, dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai.

Umishshum deyisrael ikrun kodesh (yisrael) bishlimu decholla, ketiv (Shemot 22:30) uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu. deha yisrael deinnun shelemin al kolla, la yankin missitra dedina kashya. lakkelev tashlichun oto. lakkelev vadday, dehu dina chatzifa takkifa al kolla. kevan dedina takkifa sharya aloy, veatil zuhama beh, asir lehu leinun deikrun kodesh. ella lakkelev tashlichun oto vadday, deihu dina chatzifa, dina takkifa yattir mikkolla, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:11) vehakkelavim azze nefesh.

Ta chaze, kad idkar nevela beorayyta, ketiv beyisrael kadosh, vela kodesh. hacha ketiv, veanshe kodesh tihyun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu. vehatam binnevela ketiv, (Devarim 14:21) lo tochlu chol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittennna vegomer, ki am kadosh atta. kadosh velo kodesh, deha nevela missitra deyisrael itavid, dela pasil hay ella yisrael. vesaggiin gavvnin, it bah binnevela. kema deokimna.

Amar rabbi shimon, ketiv hacha veanshe kodesh tihyun li, uchetiv hatam ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha. laAdonai elohecha, li mibbae leh. ella hatam (sefer acher ella hacha) leella leella. vehacha (sefer acher vehatam) shechinta. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushalam kadosh yeamer lo vela kodesh. bechan kadosh, uleella kodesh. ketiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, beHei kema deokimna. veal da veanshe kodesh tihyun li vadday.

Rabbi yitzchak hava yativ kameh derabbi shimon, amar leh ha ketiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai sofye dikra ketiv kol ochlav yeshamu, may ka mayyre. amar leh rabbi shimon, shappir ka amar, kol ochlav yeshamu, hayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:14) veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga vegomer. uchetiv, vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. umishshum deyisrael ikrun kodesh, ketiv kol ochlav yeshamu. ata ribbi yitzchak venashik yedoy, amar, i la attena hacha ella lemishma milla da sagge.

Amar leh rabbi, ha tanenan, dekodesh, yattir leella min kadosh. i hachi, ha ketiv (yeshaya 6) 100 100 100 Adonai tzevaot, veda shelimu decholla. amar leh ta chaze, kad mitchabberan kachada, kullehu itavidu chad beta, vehay (Vayikra 93) beta, ikre kodesh. kelala dechullehu kadosh uvegine kach kodesh, hu kelala, decholla itkelil beh. veyisrael kad itkelil behu mehemnuta shelemata kodesh ikrun, kelala decholla, dichtiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai. uvegine kach, veanshe kodesh tihyun li.

Ligyon chad shail lera abba, amar leh, la ketiv uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu, i hachi, may dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:5) teref natan lireav. teref natan lakkelavim mibbae leh, amay natan lireav. amar leh, reka, mi ketiv terefa natan lireav, teref ketiv. vei tema, teref kitrefa. natan lireav vadday demilla da, la yahaveh leizdahara beh, ella leinun dachale shemeh, vedachalin leh. begin kach hay milla la yahiv lechu, deha yada deattun la dachalin leh, vela natrin pikkudoy, uvegin dehay milla chumera deorayyta, uvae leizdahara bah, natan lireav, lireav vadday, vela leochore. vechol chomre deorayyta, la yahiv lon kudesha berich hu, ella leinun dachale chattaa, leinun dachale pikkudoy vela lechu.

Tane ribbi elazar, ketiv (sefer acher kodesh yisrael uchetiv veanshe vegomer) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, mahu veanshe. ulevatar kodesh, ella veanshe kodesh vadday. detanenan, la nafku yisrael lecheru, ella (Bereshit 31 amud bet) missitra deyovla. batar denafku lecheru, nakit lon hay yovla begadpoy, veikrun guverin dileh. benin dileh, uchetiv beh beyovla, (Vayikra 25:12) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem, kodesh vadday, lachem vadday. uvegine kach, veanshe kodesh tihyun li, anshe kodesh vadday, guverin dileh mammash.

Vekudesha berich hu amar da, veal da zachu yisrael leitkere achim lekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay vegomer. levatar ikrun kodesh mammash. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, kodesh vela anshe kodesh, begini kach kol ochlav yeshamu, uchetiv, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo ychal kodesh. (Vayikra 22:14) veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga.

Tana, yisrael ikrun kodesh, uvegin deinnun kodesh, asir leh leeynash, lemikre lechavreh bishma dignay, vela lechannaa shema lechavreh, veonsheh saggi. vechol shekken bemillin acharanin. tana, ketiv (tehillim la) netzor leshoncha mera vegomer. mahu mera. divgin lishana bisha, marin nachtin lealma.

Amar ribbi yosi kol man dekare lechavreh bishma delet beh, veganne leh, ittepas bema delet beh, deamar ribbi chiyyay amar ribbi chizkiyya, kol man dekare lechavreh rasha, nachtin leh laggehinnam. venachtin leh leiloy, bar innun chatzifin deorayyta, dishre leh leinish lemikre lehu rasha.

Hahu gavra, delayit lechavreh, abar ribbi yesa, amar leh kerasha avadt. atyeh lekameh deribbi yehuda, amar leh rasha la kamena leh, ella kerasha, deachze milloy kerasha, vela amena deihu rasha. ata ribbi yehuda, veshail leovada kameh derabbi elazar, amar leh, vadday la itchayyayv. menalan. dichtiv, (Eicha b) haya Adonai keoyev, vela oyev. dei lav hachi, la ishtear miyyisrael gizin bealma. kegavvna da, (Eicha b) hayta kealmana, vela almana, kealmana deazil balah leivra deyamma, umechakkat leh.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, umehacha mashma, mehatam mashma, dehu ikara decholla, dichtiv, (yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam. kemare adam, vela mare adam. amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer, ketappuach vela tappuach. ketappuach: demitparsha bigvavnoy, uvigvavnin itachada milla. amar rabbi yehuda, illu la atena hacha ella lemishma millin illen, dayay.

Tana ketiv, (zecharya 12:8) vehaya hannichshal bahem bayyom hahu kedavid. kedavid, vela david. kedavid, deamar, (divre hayamim 1 22:14) vehinne veanyi hachinoti levet Adonai. uchetiv, (Tehillim 86:1) ki ani veevyon ani. vehu malka al malkin hava, vahava kare legarmeh hachi. amar rabbi abba, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu la kera lon kekodesh, ella kodesh mammash, dichtiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai, ubbegin kach kol ochlav yeshamu vegomer.
Zohar, Mishpatim 21: Tana, amar ribbi yosi, may ka chama kudesha berich hu, lemehav dinin leyisrael, batar eser amiran. ella hachi tanenan, missitra (84 amud alef) digvura, ityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael. begine kach, baa lemetan shelama benayyhu, begin deorayyta tehe netira mikkol sitroy. deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yitzchak, let alma mitkayyeyma, ella al dina, deilmale dina, la mitkayyeyma. ubbegin kach alma bedina itbere, veitkayyaym.

Tana, ribbi abba, ketiv (Yirmeyahu 21:12) dinu labboker mishpat. vechi labboker, velav bechol yoma. ella labboker, ad la yechlun dayyaynin, vela yishtun, dechol man dedain dina batar deachal veshata, lav dina dikshot hu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:26) lo tochlu al haddam. may al haddam. azhara ledayyayne, dela yechlun ad dedayyne dina, dechol man dedain dina batar deachil veshate, keillu chiyyev dama dechavreh leachara, deha dameh mammash yahiv leachara. hay bemamona, kol shekken bedini nefashot, devau dayyayne leistammera, dela lemedan dina ella kodem deachlu veshatu, veal da ketiv dinu labboker mishpat uchetiv, (yirmeya 19) ani Adonai ose chesed umishpat utzedaka baaretz ki veelle chafatzti neum Adonai.

Tanya, amar ribbi yehuda, man dimshakker bedina, meshakker betikkune malka. man tikkune malka. innun deittemar, dichtiv ose chesed mishpat utzedaka baaretz. uchetiv ki veelle chafatzti neum Adonai. vecholla hay behay talya. (nusach acher vahalo behay talya) ribbi yosi amar, illen innun tikkune kurseyay, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed kisse.
Zohar, Mishpatim 24: Yerae kol zechurecha, amay kol zechurecha. (Vayikra 165 amud bet) amar ribbi elazar kol zechurecha mammash. begin denatlin birkata, mimmabbua denachala. mikkan tanenan, kol bar yisrael deitgezar, bae leitchazaa kame malka kaddisha, begin denatil birkata, mimmabbua denachala. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 16:17) kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach. uchetiv el pene (Bereshit 2 amud alef) haadon Adonai, kema deokimna, demittamman merikan birkan, venatlin birkata. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, mikkol shear ammin.

Zimna chada, seliku yisrael lemechag chagga, veitarvu ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayyhu, vehahu shatta la ishtechach birkata bealma. atu shaillu lerav hamenuna sava, amar lehu, chametun simana bekadmita behay. amar leh, simana chamenan, dechad tavna mehatam, kol archin astimu mimmayya, vaanana, vachashocha ishtechach, dela yachlin lemehach kol innun desaliku letamman. veod, beshaata dealana leitchazaa appe shemaya itchashshachu veitregizu. (itregish bechema) amar lehu, vadday o it benayychu bene nasha dela itgezaru, o ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot seliku bahadayychu. deha la itbarchan behahi shaata, bar meinnun yisrael deitgezaru. uvehay at kaddisha mistakkel kudesha berich hu, uvarich lon.

Leshatta achara seliku, useliku innun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deitarvu bahadayyhu, kad havo achlin karbenayyay, vahavu chaddan. vechamu leinun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, detafsan bekuterayyhu lekutera dechotala. ashgachu behu decholla mevarchin, veinnun la berichu. atu veamru milla leve dina, atu veshaillu lon, amru, hay daachaltun, chulaka dilchon, man kurebana hava. la hava bidayyhu. badku veashkachu deinnun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, vekatlu lon. amru, berich rachamana desheziv leammeh, devadday let bircheta sharya, ella beyisrael, zara kaddisha, beni mehemnuta, bene keshot. vehahi shatta ishtechach bircheta bealma, bishlimu. patchu veamru, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vegomer.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, bizchut yisrael gezirin, itkenau sanehon techotehon, veyarte achasantehon. ta chaze ma ketiv, (Shemot la) yerae kol zechurecha. uchetiv batreh, ki orish goyim mippanycha vehirchavti et gevulecha. dekudesha berich hu akar diyyurin meatrayyhu, veativ diyyurin, leatrayyhu. uvegini kach yerae kol zechurecha et pene haadon Adonai. rabbi yehuda amar, haadon. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 10:33) hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot mesaef pura vegomer, veyatza choter vegomer, vecholla chad, meakker diyyurin veativ diyyurin. ribbi yitzchak amar, it adon, veit adon, vecholla bechad talya.
Zohar, Mishpatim 28: Amar ribbi yehuda, hay deamar ribbi abba, dichtiv lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, bachalev haem mibbae leh, may immo. vei tema, keneset yisrael immo desitra dimsoova, lav hachi, deha shemana deamar ribbi shimon, keneset yisrael imma kaddisha bechulakeh deyisrael itachada, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo.

Amar ribbi shimon, shappir kaamart. veha derabbi abba shappir vecholla da beda talya. ta chazi, ima itachada lehu leella, lesitra da ulesitra da, uteren innun, chada limina, vachada lismala. uvegine kach, minnehon limina, uminnehon lismala. vechullehu talyayn behay em, imma kaddisha, veitachadan bah.

Ematay itachadan bah. beshaata dehay em yanka missitra achara, umikdesha isteav, vechivya takkifa shari leitgallaa, keden gadya yanka mechalava deimmeh, vedinin mitarin. veal da, yisrael kaddemin veeytan bikkurim, uveshaata demayytin lehu, bayayn lememar ulemiftach beh belavan, devaa becharshoy illen, leshalletaa beyaakov, uvezara kaddisha, vela ityeyhivu bideh, vela itmasseran yisrael lesitra da. veal da ketiv, reshit bikkure admatcha vegomer, lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo. vela yanka hahu sitra, mechalava deimmeh, deha la yisteav makdesha, vedinin la mitarin.

Begine kach, la yechul bisra bechalava kol zara kaddisha, vechol man deate missetar da, dela yahiv ducheta, leman dela itzterich, deha beovada talya milleta, beovada diltatta, leatara leella. zakkain innun yisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, demarehon kare alayyhu, (Devarim 14:2) uvecha bachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segulla. uchetiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha (vecholla chad mila) uchetiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem vegomer.

Ta chazi, beshaata deyisrael la itkesharu ovadayyhu, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 3:12) ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo. mashlu vo dayyka, veha okimna mille beraza desifra deshlomo malka. vehachi ashkechan beh. tu ashkechan, dechol man deachil hay mechla deitchabbar kachada. (o) beshaata chada, o bisudata chada. arbein yomin itchazya gadya mekullasa biklippoy, legabbe innun dilella, vesiyyata mesaava mitkarvin bahadeh, vegarim leatara dinin bealma, dinin dela kaddishin.

Vei olid bar beinnun yomin, ozfin leh nishmeta, missitra achara, dela itztericha. uchetiv (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vegomer. ate leistaava, mesaavin leh vadday. dichtiv, (Vayikra 11:44) venitmetem bam, chaser 1, mesoovuta atima mikkolla, delet reshu leitdakkea hachi, kishar zine dimsoovuta demitdakkin. vetu, demistafe mechevan bishan, deha beenayyhu gadya ishtechach, veyachil leattezka, deha tzulma devar nash itavar minneh.

Rabbi yesa, share lemechal letarnegola bigvina o bechalava. amar ribbi shimon asir lach dela yahiv inish pitcha lezinin bishin. lech lech amrin nezira, sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav. vadday asir lach hu, dechumera it beh, kivira lashshechita. uman deshare hay, ma ketiv (Amos 2:12) vattashku et hannezirim yayin, man deshare hay, kemaan deshare hay. uchetiv (Devarim 14:3) lo tochal kol toeva, kol, leachlala kolla.

Tana, bema zachu daniyel chananya mishael vaazarya, deishtezivu meinnun nisyone, ella begin dela istaavu bemechlehon. amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv (Daniel 1:8) vayyasem daniyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech vegomer. vetana bistima dematnitin, mechla dehahu rasha, bisra bechalava hava ugevina im bisra, bar mechlan acharanin, veda salik leh befatoreh, bechol yoma.

Vedaniyel deistammar mehay, kad ramu yateh leguva dearyayvavta, ishtelim betzulema demareh, vela shane (Bereshit 191 amud alef) tzulemeh letzulema achara, veal da dachalu aryayvavta minneh, vela chabbeluhu. vehahu rasha, beshaata demalchuta itade minneh, (Daniel 4:20) veim chevat bara hava madoreh, ade tzulema deanpoy minneh, umehahu yoma, la itchaze tzulemeh, tzulema devar nash. vechol beira deate, itchaze leh, tzulema dezineh, venukeveh, vahavu atyayn aleh kullehu, uvechamma zimnin havo achlin leh chevat bara, bar deitgezar hay onsha aleh, begin dichtiv, (chavakkuk 1:10) vehu bammelachim yitkallas, begin kach, kolla yitkallesu beh, kol hahu zimna.

Ta chazi, ma ketiv, (Daniel 1:13) ulemiktzat yamim asara nira marehen tov mikkol hayeladim haochlim et pat bag hammelech. nira marehen tov, detzulema demarehon la adiu minnehon, umeacharine adiu. man garim hay. begin dela itgaalu begiule mechlehon. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv behu, veanshe kodesh tihyun li.
Zohar, Mishpatim 29: (Shemot 24:1) veel moshe amar ale el Adonai vegomer. veel moshe amar, (131 amud alef) man amar. da shechinta. ale el Adonai, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim vegomer. (sefer acher Vayikra elav Adonai) amay kol da, lekayyeyma immehon kayyaym, begin deha itperau, ma dela nafku hachi mimmitzrayim, deitgezaru, vela itperau, (40 amud alef) vehacha ha itperau, vealu bivrit kayyayma, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:25) sham sam lo chok umishpat. dayyka vesham nissahu, behay at kaddisha, deitgalyay behu, vehacha itkayyaym behu, al yeda demoshe gezira dekayyayma, dichtiv, vayyikkach moshe et haddam vayyizrok al haam vegomer.

Amar ribbi yitzchak may dichtiv, vachatzi haddam zarak al hammizbeach, bammizbeach la ketiv, ella al hammizbeach dayyka. vehishtachavitem merachok, mahu merachok. kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li. uchetiv, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok. tane ribbi abba, dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, uveh shaata, zachu yisrael yattir bechulaka kaddisha, vegazru kayyayma kaddisha bekudesha berich hu.

Veel moshe amar ale el Adonai. may tama. amra leh shechinta, istelik leella, deha ana veyisrael, nishtattef kachada bishlemuta al yedach, ma dela hava ad hacha. ma ketiv vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vegomer, palag leh litren. chatzi haddam zarak al haam, vachatzi haddam zarak al hammizbeach, kema deokimna. uchetiv, hinni dam habberit asher karat Adonai immachem. vayyasem baagganot, baagganat ketiv, chaser vav. kema dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 7:3) sharrech agan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg.

(Shemot 24:2) veniggash moshe levaddo el Adonai, zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dehu bilchodoy, zacha lema dela zacha bar nash achara. yisrael zachu hasheta, ma dela zachu ad hahi shaata. vehahi shaata, itkeyyaymu, bekiyyuma illaa kaddisha. uvehahu shaata itbassaru lemeheve benayyhu makdesha, kema deat amer, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham.

(Shemot 24:10) vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach, (Shir hashshirim 7:8) zot komatech damta letamar vegomer, kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, dela mitparsha minnih, kehay tamar, dela parish dechar min nukeba lealmin, vela (37 amud bet) salik, da bela da. kach keneset yisrael, la mitparsha mekudesha berich hu.

Ta chazi, beshaata denadav vaavihu chamu, veshivin savin. ma ketiv behu. vayyiru et elohe yisrael. deitgele alayyhu shechinta. rabbi yehuda verabbi yosi amre, et dayyka. veda et, hu merachok. et leachlela ma di begavveh.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, veha ketiv (yechezkel 10:20) hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael binhar kevar, man chayya da. amar ribbi yosi amar rabbi chiyyay, chayya zuteratti. vechi it chayya zuteratti, in. chayya zuteratti, vechayya illaa. vechayya zutera (Bereshit 11 amud bet) dezutarti.

Vayyiru et elohe yisrael, dayyka, kema daamena. vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir, kechezu even tava, dezammin kudesha berich hu lemivne makdesha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:11) vysadtich bassappirim.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: El bet harechavim. bene yonadav ben rechav (yirmeya 35:6), umibbene yitro hayu (mechilta yitro amalek 2):
targum: Ezel levat bene vet rechav utemalel imhon vetaalinun levet makdesha dayya lachada min lishkata vetashke yathon chamra:

rashi: Hinne anochi sholeach malach. kan nitbasseru sheatidin lachato, ushechina omeret lahem ki lo eele bekirbecha (Shemot 33):

Asher hachinoti. asher zimmanti latet lachem, zehu peshuto; umidrasho el hammakom asher hachinoti kevar mekomi kenegdo, veze echad min hammikraot sheomrim shebbet hammikdash shel mala mechuvvan keneged shel matta (tanchuma):
