ohc: Hinne anochi vegomer. perush, malach ze hu hammalach haggoel et haavot, lo mesharet mimmeshartav, ella malach gadol kayyadua lammaskilim, ki en anu makkirim malach emtzai ella hu yitbarach ushechinat uzzo hammityachedet immo besod (Zecharya 14:9) "Adonai echad ushemo echad".

rashi: Shevuat Adonai tihye. yishshava shekken hu chidvarav, vehu lo shalach bah yad lehishtammesh bah leatzmo, sheim shalach bah yad veachakka neensa, chayyav boonasim (bava metzia 94):
Velakach bealav. hashshevua:
Velo yeshallem. lo hashshomer kelum (bava kamma 106):
ohc: Ben shenehem. yirtze ki yesh onesh lannishba velammashbia, im yada shehu rotze lishshava lashsheker umaskim al haddavar.

rashi: Veim ason yihye. baishsha:

Venatatta nefesh tachat nefesh. rabbotenu cholkim baddavar, yesh omrim nefesh mammash, veyesh omrim mamon aval lo nefesh mammash, shehammitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze patur mimmita, umeshallem leyorshav damav kemo shehaya nimkar bashshuk (sham):
ohc: Venatatta nefesh vegomer. nechleku rabbotenu zichronam livracha bammechilta, yesh omrim mita, hagam shennitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze, veyesh omrim mamon. velidvarav yeduyyak amro venatatta al nachon, shehu davar hannittan miyyad leyad. uleman deamar nefesh mammash amar venatatta lomar ki bimkom netina haamura besamuch keshello yihye ason tihye zo, veen kan netina acheret ki patur middeme veladot, zulat im haya ason vehu bederech sheeno chayyav, kegon sheamdu hammakka sheenah kede lehamit hare ze chayyav, uchemo shekkatavti befasuk (Shemot 21:18) "vechi yerivun".

rashi: Veim livno yiadenna. haadon; melammed sheaf beno kam tachtav leyaadah im yirtze aviv, veeno tzarich lekaddeshah kiddushin acherim, ella omer lah hare at meyoedet li bakkesef shekkibbel avich bedamayich:
Kemishpat habbanot. sheer kesut veona (mechilta):
ohc: Veim livno. perush – lo yeadah hu veyachpotz bah livno, modia hakkatuv ki yachol leyaadah, vehu omer yiadenna, perush, bechesef keniyyatah bo yihye yiudeha o lo o livno veen tzarich kesef kiddushin.
Veamro kemishpat habbanot, perush, ben im yeadah lo o livno, tzarich laasot kemishpat habbanot, shehu ma sheamar besamuch "sheerah" vegomer:

rashi: Ki tire chamor sonaacha vegomer. hare chi meshammesh leshon dilma, shehu mearba leshonot shel shimmushe chi, vecho pitrono: shemma tire chamoro rovetz tachat massao vechadalta meazov lo, bitmiha:

Azov taazov immo. aziva zo leshon ezra, vechen atzur veazuv (Devarim 32), vechen vayyaazvu yerushalayim ad hachoma (Nechemya 3) – milleuha afar laazor ulesayyea et chozek hachoma. kayyotze vo ki tomar bilvavcha rabbim haggoyim haelle mimmenni vegomer (Devarim 7), shemma tomar ken, bitmiha? lo tira mehem. umidrasho kach darshu rabbotenu: ki tire vechadalta, peamim sheatta chodel, ufeamim sheatta ozer, ha chetzad? zaken veeno lefi kevodo vechadalta, o vehemat goy umassao shel yisrael vechadalta (mechilta):
Azov taazov immo. lefarek hammassa; millemishkal leh – millittol massao mimmennu:
Regalim. peamim; vechen ki hikkitani ze shalosh regalim (Bamidbar 22):
Amla lo. letzarko hu amel:
Ki achaf alav pihu. kesheppihu kofehu vetovea lo maachol, az amalo omedet lo, sheachal ma sheamal kevar:
targum: Nefash delaaya leuta tesover demin puma ati lah kefa:

rashi: Ki yitten ish el reehu chamor o shor. parasha rishona neemra beshomer chinnam, lefichach patar bo et haggeneva, kemo shenneemar (pasuk 6) vegunnav mibbet haish, im lo yimmatze haggannav venikrav baal habbayit lishvua, lamadta sheppoter atzmo bishvua zo. ufarasha zo amura beshomer sachar, lefichach eno patur im nigneva, kemo shekkatuv (pasuk 11) im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem, aval al haones, kegon met meatzmo, o nishbar o nishba bechazka al yede listim, veen roe sheyyaid baddavar:
Sefer habberit. mibbereshit vead mattan tora umitzvot shennitztauu vemara:
Vaasher lo tzada. lo arav lo velo nitkavven:

Tzada. leshon arav, vechen hu omer "veatta tzode et nafshi" (Shmuel 1 24); velo yittachen lomar tzada leshon "hatztzad tzayid" (Bereshit 27), shetztzidat chayyot en nofel hei befoal shellah, veshem davar bah tzayid, veze shem davar bo tzediyya, ufoal shello tzode, veze happoal shello tzad. veomer ani pitrono ketargumo – udela cheman le. umenachem chibbero bechelek tzad tzayid, veen ani mode lo; veim yesh lechabbero beachat mimmachlakot shel tzad, nechabberennu vechelek "al tzad tinnaseu" (Yeshayahu 66), "tzidda ore" (Shmuel 1 20), "umillin letzad illaa yemallel" (Daniel 7), af kan asher lo tzada – lo tzidded limtzo lo shum tzad mita; veaf ze yesh lehareher alav, mikkol makom leshon orev hu:
Vehaelohim inna leyado. zimmen leyado, leshon "lo teunne elecha raa" (Tehillim 91), "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven" (Mishlei 12), "mitanne hu li" (Melachim 2 Adonai) – mizdammen limtzo li illa:

Vehaelohim inna leyado. velamma tetze zot millefanav? hu sheamar david "kaasher yomar meshal hakkadmoni mershaim yetze resha" (Shmuel 1 24); umeshal hakkadmoni hi hattora, shehi meshal hakkabba shehu kadmono shel olam; vehechan amra tora mershaim yetze resha? vehaelohim inna leyado. bamme hakkatuv medabber? bishne vene adam, echad harag shogeg veechad harag mezid, velo hayu edim baddavar sheyyaidu, ze lo neherag, veze lo gala, vehakkabba mezammenan lefundak echad, ze sheharag bemezid yoshev tachat hassullam veze sheharag shogeg ole bassullam venofel al ze sheharag bemezid vehorgo, veedim meidim alav umechayyevim oto liglot, nimtza ze sheharag beshogeg gole, veze sheharag bemezid neherag (makkot 10):
Vesamti lecha makom. af bammidbar, sheyyanus shamma, vee ze makom kolto? ze machane leviyya (mechilta):
ohc: Vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal "lo tzada" "vehaelohim" vegomer? veod kashe, lamma yeanne Adonai laadam aven ze? verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru bammechilta uvehaggolin (makkot 10,1) ze hu sheamar hakkatuv "mershaim yetze resha" vegomer (Shmuel 1 24,14), ha ketzad? haya yored bassullam venafal alav vaharago vechulei – hare ze gole, haya ole bassullam venafal alav vaharago – hare ze eno gole vechulei, ba mezid venafal beyad shogeg ad kan. vekashe, hen emet ki mezid ze natal secharo mushlam ki ven mavet hu vahare hu neherag, ella shogeg ze sheggole – galut ze hu al ma sheshshagag atta bappaam hazzot, veal shiggato asher shagag barishon en lo peraon aleha. veim asher hizmin leyado Adonai lo yitchayyev aleha ki Adonai hizminah leyado, im ken muchrach lomar ki bappaam hazzot lo inna Adonai leyado vehanneherag al yado lo haya mechuyyav mita, sheim mechuyyav hare ze yikkanes gam ken begeder ki Adonai inna leyado, veze dochak, ki hakkatuv yaggid inyan shiggat harigat nefesh belo tzediyya velo chillek biktzat mehem.

Vehannachon ki gam neherag rishon nitchayyev mita, vaharago ze bemaamaro yitbarach asher inna leyad ze hahoreg beshogeg. vehinne ze shenneherag nilkad befisho veneherag al asher harag bemezid, aval haya Adonai yachol lehappil alav mappolet belo emtzaut horeg beshogeg, ella letzad shekkadam elav avon mezid [shogeg] sheen alav chiyyuv ella galut veinna Adonai leyado davar ze. vehinne adam ze eno gole al hahariga ella al ma shekkadam lah shessibbev hariga, uchefi ze afillu harag asara eno chayyav ella galut achat ki sibbat haggalut achat hi, veachar sheyyeshallem avono lo yazmin Adonai leyado retzicha acheret. vetimtza shello higbil Adonai shiur haggalut lechol haratzchanim shiur echad, ella kol echad kefi shiur chet hakkadum lo. uchefi ze taam sheamar hashshas sheavon ze hahoreg beshogeg hu al asher harag beshogeg, uchefi devarenu hu chet nelam kadum laharigat harishon, ulay shennaktu hametzaa shava beonesh shenehem shehu al hahariga, vehammaskil al davar levavo yavin yesodan shel devarim.

O efshar ki letzad sheramzuhu min hashshamayim dehammitgalgel al yado sheharag hannefesh, vehaya lo lehikkana ulekabbel alav haggalut meatzmo, hare ze hosif al chattato pesha, velaze hizmin lo od shogeg acher millevad harishon, vetzarich liglot pi shenayim kashshiur hatztzarich lemispar rishuyotav. velaze timtza shennitchakkem Adonai velo gaval shiur galut harotzeach ella ad mot hakkohen haggadol, vedavar ze hinne hu masur laadon kol haaretz vehu yishpot betzedek kamma shiur hatztzarich lo im leachat im lishtayim. ulefi derech ze yityashshev kavvanat amro hainyan, aval adayin en kede leyashshev amro vehaelohim betosefet 6.

Venire ki yechavven hakkatuv ledakdek din haggole ofen shennitchayyev bo al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 6 mehilchot rotzeach, sheen gole ella shogeg sheeno ones, perush, shehammaase hu davar haragil, gam shello haya lo tzad hazada kol ikkar, aval im haya hashshogeg davar sheeno matzuy, o shehaya bo tzad hazada kegon sone shechezkato lemezid vechaddome lo eno gole. ucheneged shenehem dikdek hakkatuv lomar shene devarim: vaasher vegomer vehaelohim vegomer, keneged shogeg bedavar sheeno matzuy amar lo tzada, perush lo tzada lehargo, gam lo tzidded shello lehargo, ki chol shogeg tzad chiyyuva hu, shehaya lo lehaalot al dato leval tavo takkala al yado, aval bemakom shehagam sheyyetzadded hu davar sheeno ragil – anus hu ufatur. ucheneged bechinat mezid shel hassone amar vehaelohim vegomer, perush, lemaet ba shello ba haddavar ella meAdonai velo mimmennu, ki lo chafetz hu hamito ki lo sone lo ella meAdonai yatza haddavar, aval im gam yesh tzad sina mimmennu shehaya sone, eno gole.

rashi: Uveyirat Adonai sur mera. al yede yirat Adonai sur mera:
targum: Betevuta vekusheta mitkapper surechana udechalteh delaha miste min bishta:

rashi: Im adonav yitten lo ishsha. mikkan sheharshut beyad rabbo limsor lo shifcha chenaanit leholid mimmenna avadim. o eno ella veyisreelit? talo haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha, ha eno medabber ella bichnaanit, shehare haivriyya af hi yotza veshesh – vaafillu lifne shesh im hevia simanin yotza – shenneemar achicha haivri o haivriyya (Devarim 15), melammed sheaf haivriyya yotza veshesh (mechilta):
ohc: Im adonav vegomer. kashe lamma hitchil ledabber lenocheach "ki tikne", vetoch kede dibbur chazar ledabber derech nistar "im adonav yitten lo", "tihye ladoneha", "vehiggisho adonav", kol happarasha bederech nistar, umin harauy haya lo lehashelim haddibbur kederech shehitchil "im titten lo", "tihye lecha" vegomer, "vehiggashta oto". vehaya nire lomar ki lo kinna hazziuug lekonehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 68) ki hakkadosh baruch hu mezavveg ziuugim, laze amar im adonav haamitti, ki lo vene yisrael avadim, yitten lo ishsha, ella shello yatzdik perush ze amro "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha". od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vehu yetze vegappo vahalo haddavar muvan sheyyetze vegappo meamro "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha". od tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar amor yomar:

Achen kavvanat hakketuvim hu, letzad ki yetzav hael hishtannut haddin "im begappo yavo begappo yetze", perush sheen rabbo yachol limsor lo shifcha kenaanit ella im haya nasuy, keamram bekiddushin (kiddushin 20,1). veyomar haomer: maddua chakak Adonai chukka zo lehishtannut haddin, ma li haya nasuy o lo? laze ba hakkatuv bechachma latet taam, veamar hattaam hu im adonav yitten lo ishsha shehi shifcha kenaanit kammuvan mehainyan, hammishpat hu shehaishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha vehu haeved yetze begappo, perush, belo ishsha kol ikkar. veleheyot ken, im yitten lo rabbo ishsha vehu panuy meolam, lo yirtze latzet meavdut letzad shete sibbot: haechad – ahavat ishto uvanav, vehashsheniyya – shebbetzeto nishar panuy, ushetayim raot yesh lo bitziato. uletzad ze kol eved ish lo yachpotz latzet meet rabbo, ma sheen retzono yitbarach ken. asher al ken gazar omer shello yitten lo rabbo ishsha ella im hu nasuy, ki baze yekal mealav haferadat ishto uvanav, kevan sheyyesh lo ishsha yisreelit bat chorin yihye beenav kal latzet. uchefi pasuk "im adonav" vegomer nitkavven Adonai lomar beseder haddevarim latet taam bemetek lashon lamma shinna haddin.

Veamro veim amor yomar, perush, millevad amira achat sheasa Adonai lo tikkun kannizkar, od yomar ahavti vegomer, vehiggisho vegomer, veratza vegomer, ki ze meid sheeno choshesh leullo yitbarach vekone adon leatzmo:

Od nire lefaresh happarasha derech remez, ki tetzavve hattora lehaadam lasum lefanav bitmidut kol haddevarim haelle ben enav, vehu amro asher tasim lifnehem, shettamid yasim haadam inyan ze lefanav. vehu ki tikne eved ivri, halo yadata ki haadam nechlak lishnayim: chelek echad ruchani vehu haikkar, vechelek echad gashmi shebbara Adonai lanneshama leshammeshah, shebbeemtzauto mekayyem kamma mitzvot asher tzivva Adonai, velo yikkare shem eved, ki eno ella shammash lannefesh shebbishvilah yikkare adam, kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 30:32) "al besar adam lo" vegomer, shezze yaggid ki lo habbasar yikkare adam, vechen amar (Yechezkel 34:31) "adam attem", attem keruyim adam velo ummot haolam (bava metzia 114,1) sheen lahem nefesh ruchanit. velaze tetzavve hattora lehaadam ki tikne eved ivri, perush ivri – over, ki eno kayyam laad, ki mi gever yichye velo yire mavet, al derech (Tehillim 144:4) "ketzel over". uzeman keviato hu ad shishshim shana, al derech amro (Iyov Adonai:26) "tavo vechelach ele kaver", veamru bashshas (moed katan koach,1) ki ben shishshim shana hu zemanno shel adam lalechet kechushban "bechelach", sheaz hu kaalot gadish. veze hu amro shesh shanim, perush, kol yamav hem shishshim, vahagam sheamar shesh yesh cheshbon sheyyichlol kelalut echad vechan kolel haasiri. uvashsheviit, perush beeser shanim hashsheviit yetze lachafshi haeved, al derech amro (Tehillim 88:6) "bammetim chafshi". veamro tevat chinnam lirmoz al yad mi tihye hayyetzia, al yede chinnam shehu 131 vechelotav, shehem nirmazim betevat chinnam, keamram besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (Zohar 10 128,2) ki bemile demaggana hu zenayyhu dehahi sitra, velaze lo shalte bidvar mitzva sheose haadam bedamim yekarim. vechen timtza shekkol devar tuma ba bechinnam, ma sheen ken devar mitzva ukedushsha tzarich lahem torach gadol vedamim yekarim.
Im begappo yavo. tzarich ledakdek lamma amar lashon ze, velo amar lashon haragil bilshon hakkodesh "im levaddo", keamro (Bereshit 32:25) "vayyivvater yaakov levaddo".

Achen yesh ladaat ki im siggel mitzvot umaasim tovim vekana leatzmo koach, yimtza koach laalot beyom hattechiyya, al derech amro (Tehillim 72:16) "veyatzitzu meir keesev haaretz" (ketuvot ki,1). vezehu sheamar kan im begappo, perush leshon gaf, al derech amro (Mishlei 9:3) "al gappe merome", sheromez el hammitzvot umaasim tovim, keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat mat,1) "nimshelu yisrael leyona" vechulei. veamro yavo, perush al derech amro (uneklos Bereshit 28:21) "ki va hashshemesh" – al shimsha. begappo yetze, perush beoto kanaf yetze min haaretz beet hattechiyya, veachare naflo kima tihye lo. vidiat hahafachim shava hi, sheim baolam hazze lo yishtaddel besiggul hattov, en koach bo laalot. vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki,2) bappasuk (Mishlei 3:18) "etz chayyim" vegomer, sheen gufot amme haaretz omdim zulat lammachazikim bah.

Veamro im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo – kan ramza hattora sod gadol, vehu ki yesh lecha adam shekkana nishmato beemtzaut chozek maasav hattovim venaasa hu balah shel neshama hakkedosha. vetzarich atta ladaat ma sheamru besefer hazzohar (chelek 3 91,1) bema sheamar hakkatuv "shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled" vegomer, ki habbehemot meet ledatam konim sechel sheyyesh lashshor, ma sheen ken haadam – kefi maasav zacha notnim lo nefesh, zacha yattir vechulei, zacha yattir vechulei ad kan. hinne shebbeemtzaut maasav kone hanneshama hannikret ishsha, uchemo chen matzinu shekkerauha chachme emet (tikun 6). velaze amar im baal ishsha hu shekkenaah kannizkar, veyatza ishto – perush afillu achar yetziat ishto af al pi chen odenna immo venishar chay afillu achar moto. vetze ulemad mimmaase shehuva bemassechet shabbat (shabbat kinnev,2) shel hanhu kappulae vechulei nachar behu gavra vechulei shehaya medabber leachar moto, veze hu amram zichronam livracha (berachot 18,1) tzaddikim bemitatan keruyim chayyim.

Od yechavven beamro im baal ishsha hu, lomar im hu adam asher kol machshevotav vigiotav vetarcho baolam hazze, vaafillu maachalo umashkehu, eno ella bishvil hanneshama, al derech amro (Mishlei 13:25) "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho", lehagedil haruchaniyyut, adam kaze lo yikkare baal ishsha, kabbaal hazze shettoreach bishvil ishto lazun ulefarnes ulechalkel ulemalleot retzonah, ken ze haish ose lenafsho. adam kaze shehachomer nizdakkech venaasa meen hatztzura bimtziut ze, tuchal nafsho lisbol ladur immo bimchitzato afillu achar yetziatah.

Veamro im adonav yitten lo ishsha vegomer. perush, im eno baal ishsha al ofen haamur, aval ishsha hiknu lo min hashshamayim, ki timtza kamma bene adam shezzochim linshama tehora besod hazziuug bishat yetzira mitztzad aviv hatztzaddik. "veyalda lo vanim o vanot" – perusho al derech amram (Bereshit Rabba 110) ikkar toldotehem shel tzaddikim vechulei, gam ki al yede maasim tovim yihye nolad malach tov, keamram zichronam livracha (avot 84) haose mitzva achat kana lo peraklit echad vechulei, vechen hu meforash baer hetev besefer hazzohar hakkadosh. laze amar "veyalda lo vanim o vanot" – bechinat habbanim hem mitzvot hannaasim behitatztzemut gadol, uvechinat habbanot hi madrega lematta mibbanim. adam kaze "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha", lishlol ma shezzacha haish asher kana haishsha beemtzaut hitatztzemuto venaasa baal haishsha lihyot immo tamid, lo chen hu ze, ella "tihye ladoneha", ki adam kaze lo kenaah lihyot balah shebbaze lo tippared mimmennu. gam leferush sheni, ze lo zikkech gufo kede sheyyihye rauy shello tippared mimmennu hanneshama, velaze "tihye ladoneha". "vehu yetze" vegomer – perush, uveet yetziato mehakkever beet hattechiyya "yetze vegappo", perush zechuyyotav sheyyesh lo, velo tushelal mimmennu hattechiyya beheader haddavar haamur.

Veamro veim amor yomar haeved vegomer. kan hodia hakkatuv avodat haeved yisrael hammitlahev laavodat kono, veaf achar sheafsu kochotav mitavve taava laavod haadon, vezehu amro ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay, shehem hanneshama vehammitzvot sheose baolam hazze, veeno rotze latzet mehaolam hazze lachafshi kammetim, veze yore al hacheshek vehattaava behaadon. leish kaze mavtiach haadon ki lo yikkare eved Adonai vimalle taavato, taavat libbo natatta lo, ach lo atta, ki atta en lo od baolam ella vaavado leolam – laolam habba yivchar bo Adonai mehammalachim lihyot lo leeved neeman. umatzinu shekken haya lemoshe shekkerao Adonai (Devarim 34:5) eved Adonai, shennitavva lichyot likkanes leeretz yisrael laavod Adonai ulekayyem mitzvotav (sota yad,1). uma sheamar hakkatuv veratza vegomer bammartzea, timtza becheshbon martzea arba meot olamot hakkissuf, kakkatuv besefer hazzohar (chelek 1 123:). veamro vaavado leolam, perush, yachshov alav keillu chay kol yeme olam veavad bah avodat hakkodesh, machshava tova vechulei. od ramaz leolam sod yadua leyode daat kadosh.

rashi: Vehayu neshechem almanot. mimmashma shenneemar veharagti etchem eni yodea shenneshechem almanot uvenechem yetomim? ella hare zo kelala acheret, sheyyihyu hannashim tzerurot kealmanot chayyot, shello yihyu edim lemitat balehen vetihyena asurot lehinnase, vehabbanim yihyu yetomim, shello yannichum bet din lered lenichse avihem, lefi sheen yodim im metu im nishbu (bava metzia 38):
Lev chacham yaskil pihu. libbo melammed et piv ledabber tzachot. (veal sefatav yosif libbo lekach):
targum: Libba dechakkima mistakkal pumeh uvesifvatohi mosif ulefana:

rashi: Ki hiv chesuto. zo tallit:
Simlato. ze chaluk:
Bamme yishkav. lerabbot et hammatztza (mechilta):
Tzuf devash. metok devash, berishka belaaz:
Imre noam. divre tora:
targum: Kavrita deduvesha maamara devusema chalyuta denafsha veasuta legarme:

rashi: Veshochad lo tikkach. afillu lishpot emet, vechol shekken kede lehattot et haddin, shehare lehattot et haddin neemar kevar (Devarim 16) lo tatte mishpat (ketuvot 105):
Yeavver pikchim. afillu chacham battora venotel shochad sof shettittaref dato alav veyishtakkach talmudo veyichhe meor enav (sham):
Visallef. ketargumo umekalkel:
Divre tzaddikim. devarim hametzuddakim, mishpete emet, vechen targumo pitgamin teritzin – yesharim:
Hinni metzavve. veshav chel paro leartzo, vehakkasdim yashuvu alechem (yirmeya 37:5-8):
targum: Ha ana mefaked amar Adonai vaativinun al karta hada vigichun kerava alah veyichbeshunah veyokduna benura veyat kirvaya devet yehuda etten letzadu mibbeli yatev:

rashi: Hatztzira. min sheretz haof, vehayta makka otam beenehem umattila vahem eres vehem metim. vehatztzira lo avra et hayyarden, vehachitti vehakkenaani hem eretz sichon veog, lefichach mikkol sheva ummot lo mana chan ella ellu, vechivvi aappi shehu meever hayyarden vahala, shanu rabbotenu vemassechet sota (daf 36), al sefat hayyarden amda vezarka vahem mara:
Veel atzile. hem nadav vaavihu vehazzekenim:
Lo shalach yado. mikkelal shehayu reuyim lehishtalleach bahem yad (tanchuma, Vayikra Rabba 20):
Vayyechezu et haelohim. hayu mistakkelin bo belev gas mittoch achila ushetiyya, kach midrash tanchuma, veunkelos lo tirgem ken.
Atzile. leshon gedolim, kemo umeatzileha keraticha (Yeshayahu 41), vayyatzel min haruach (Bamidbar 11), shesh ammot atztzila (Yechezkel 41):
ohc: Veel atzile vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "veel atzile" velo hispik lomar "velo shalach bahem yado", vehaddavar muvan sheal hazzekenim vegomer hammuzkarim besamuch hu omer. veulay ki taam hu noten lamma lo shalach yado, letzad shehayu atzile, perush gedole yisrael, veillu asu chen zulatam haya sholeach yado. o al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 15) shello ratza learbev hassimcha, ki chol yisrael yitabbelu alehem letzad heyotam gedolehem vaatzilehem, laze lo shalach yado.

Lo shalach vegomer vayyochlu vegomer. kashe lamma chazar lomar paam sheniyya vayyechezu vegomer, velo hispik ma shekkadam beamro "vayyiru et" vegomer? vehinne rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 20,10) amru ki nitkavven lomar ki al yede machaze shadday nehenu vehirgishu habberiut vehassova keish achal veshata. vaadayin kashe lamma hifsik hakkatuv beemtza hainyan bemaamar "lo shalach yado", ki min harauy haya lo lehakedim lomar maasehem bishlemut veachar kach arichut appayim sheheerich Adonai lahem velo haragam miyyad, al ze hadderech: "vayyiru et elohe yisrael vegomer vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vegomer veel atzile bene yisrael". vegam lo haya tzarich lichtov paam sheniyya "vayyechezu" vegomer, vehaya maspik bema shehitchil lomar "vayyiru et elohe yisrael vegomer latohar vayyochlu" vegomer, uderashat chachamenu zichronam livracha lo zaza mimmekomah.

Veulay shekkavvanat hakkatuv al derech amro (Shemot 33:23) "vahasiroti et kappi veraita" vegomer, hare ki Adonai yaase havedala beyado lannivraim mehabbit el haelohim, vaafillu lemoshe keshennigla elav begilluy shechina sam kappo alav, perush, bechina hammafseket leval yistakkel, vechan hodia hakkatuv ki laatzile yisrael lo shalach yado limnoa mehem hammachaze letzad heyotam chashuvim beenav vehinnicham lazun enehem meoro yitbarach.

Veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyiru et elohe yisrael, perush, rau or gadol shel elohe yisrael, aval lo nistakkelu ella tachat raglav, veachar kach letzad shello shalach Adonai yado, perush, kocho verishyono limnoa mehem, uvaze haya lahem koach lachazot benoam Adonai, venehenu – zo achila, zo shetiyya, vesava battov nafsham.

Velo yikshe lamma lemoshe sam kappo alav umenao mehabbit, velaatzile yisrael lo shalach yado, ki ma shehutzrach Adonai lasum kappo al moshe – lo lishlol mimmennu hassaga shehissigu atzile yisrael, ki hassaga zo hayta lemoshe bitmidut, ella lehabbit behassaga muflet asher kol machaze elyon yecheze. veyesh od leeloah millin beferushan shel devarim, veshomer ani atzmi mehaalot al sefer devarim hayyoshvim beseter elyon, leval yehanu mehem mi sheeno rauy leor beor hachayyim.
Chassalat parashat mishpatim

rashi: Vegunnav mibbet haish. lefi devarav (sham 63):
Im yimmatze haggannav yeshallem. haggannav shenayim labbealim:
ohc: Ki yitten ish. parasha zo heemiduha rabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava metzia tzad:) beshomer chinnam, ki hu levaddo patur miggeneva vaaveda. veamru sheal kol panim chayyav bifshia, velo noda minnayin lahem, kevan shehakkatuv lo chiyyevo ella lishshava shello shalach yado, kol chutz mizze patur. verashi zichrono livracha behashshoel daf 95 katav bedibbur hammatchil ashshomer chinnam veze leshono: dichtiv beh peshia, dichtiv "al kol devar pesha". venishar ladaat al mi samach hakkatuv ladaat ki yedabber beshomer chinnam. veulay ki letzad shehilbish hannetina bechesef o chelim shehem devarim shemmin hassetam sheenam tzerichin sachar leshamram, uveshomer sachar amar devarim shemmin hassetam tzerichin sachar leshamram, shehem chamor o shor o se vechol behema, shekkol min ze yesh bo tippul umin hassetam regilut lishmor besachar.

El reehu. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bava metzia 57.) velo shel hekdesh, venire li latet taam haddavar shehu lattaam atzmo shetztzivva Adonai liftor babbealim, veshappir yikkare haadon bealav shel hekdesh immo shel kol nifkad, sheen lecha shaa varega sheen Adonai ose peulla im haadam, ben bivchinat gufo ben bivchinat tzerachav.

Kesef o chelim. lo haya tzarich lomar ella "ki yitten ish el reehu", vahare hu omer besamuch "al kol devar pesha al shor al" vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha kol peratim sheyyitchayyev alehem im lo shamar ufasha. veim lirshom hakkatuv ki beshomer chinnam hu medabber, haya maspik lomar "ki yitten kesef", [kelim] lamma li. uvammechilta amru: "kesef o chelim" – ma kesef sheddarko limmanot, af kelim sheddarkam limmanot, mikkan amru kol taana sheenah bemidda bemishkal uveminyan enah taana, ad kan. veen setira lidvarenu middivrehem. od nire li taam amro kelim, lomar shehagam sheyyirtze hashshomer leshallem eno niftar, uchemo shekkatav rambam beferek 6 mehilchot sheela ufikkadon, sheim happikkadon hu keli metukkan mashbiin oto, vahagam sheharambam amar mishshum takkanat chachamim, efshar sheyyirmoz hakkatuv laze, viduyyak gam ken ma sheggamar omer hakkatuv im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu, dikdek lomar melechet, lomar hagam sheen taana ella taanat melacha shebbakkelim umeshallem shavyo.

Lishmor. bammechilta rabbi yishmael omer: ad sheyyafkid etzlo veyomar lo "shemor li", aval im amar lo "enecha bo" – hare ze patur. uvehachovel (bava kamma 93,1) darshu "lishmor" – velo leabbed velikroa, "lishmor" – velo lechallek laaniyyim. umiddivre hattosafot sham mashma shello patar hattanna kol shello amar lo "shemor li" ella mippeshia, aval im ibbedo beyadayim eno patur ad sheyyomar lo beferush leabbed velikroa. vekashe li minnayin matzu lidrosh shene miutim bishte haderagot: haachat – im lo amar lo "shemor" patur mippeshia, vehashsheniyya – im amar lo leabbed patur im ibbed. venire ki derashat mechilta derasha gemura hi, uderashat hachovel "velo leabbed" sevara hi, ella sheasmechuha akkera. veteda ki amru od "velo lechallek laaniyyim", vetaam miut haaniyyim muchach mishsham shehu mittaam shehu mamon sheen lo tovim. uchemo sheamar sham behahi maase shehikdish hahu gavra arneke litzdaka, afkedeh rav yosef behahu gavra, atu gannave genavuhu vechayyeveh rav yosef. amar leh abbaye: "vehatanya 'lishmor velo lechallek laaniyyim!" amar leh: "aniyye pumebdita mekatz katz lehu". uferesh Rashi: vahava lehu mamon sheyyesh lo tovim. hare shettamo hu ze, uletaam ze lo haya tzarich miut, deze kevan deakdesheh lemamon ze laaniyyim paka zechuto mimmennu venishar hammamon en lo tovim. venire ki hu haddin im amar lo lishmor lechallekam laaniyyim shehu patur mittaam shehu mamon sheen lo tovim. veharaya mimma shemmakshe abbaye lerav yosef mibbarayta "lishmor velo lechallek", umay kushya? dilma hu amar lo beferush lishmor! ma tomar shello amar lo lishmor? im ken hava leh lehakeshoto mibbarayta delishmor" ad sheamar lo "shemor", vezulat ze yihye patur afillu bemamon sheeno lechallek. od amru sham bammechilta achar divre rabbi yishmael: rabbi natan omer "lishmor" – lehavi kol haddome lechesef vechelim.

rashi: Im lo yimmatze haggannav. uva hashshomer hazze, shehu baal habbayit:
Venikrav. el haddayyanin, ladun im ze velishshava lo shello shalach yado beshello (sham):
Im tarof yittaref. ay chayya raa:
Yeviehu ed. yavi edim shennitrefa veones ufatur:

Hatterefa lo yeshallem. eno omer terefa lo yeshallem ella hatterefa, yesh terefa shehu meshallem veyesh terefa sheeno meshallem; terefat chatul veshual unemiyya meshallem, terefat zeev, ari, vedov venachash eno meshallem; umi lechashcha ladun ken? shehare chatuv umet o nishbar o nishba – ma mita sheen yachol lehatztzil, af shever veshivya sheen yachol lehatztzil (mechilta):
Peles umozne mishpat vegomer. leshallem laadam kefoolo, mishpat yushetitza belaaz, peraon avonot haadam befeles umoznayim:
Maasehu kol avne chis. kaasher yesh beavne chis mishkalot gedolot uketannot, hakkol lefi poolo shel adam:
targum: Rigya umesacha ditritzuta min kodam elaha veovadoy kulehon mitkele dekusheta:

ohc: Veheviacha vegomer vehichchadtiv. yechavven ki beemtzaut hachenasat yisrael yihyu nichchadim haummot hahem, veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bamidbar 14:9) "sar tzillam vegomer vaAdonai ittanu" vegomer, ki hakkedushsha tishav chelek hammechayye vetishshaer kefeger muvas, vehu sod amram zichronam livracha (shabbat lod,1) yahiv eneh beh venaasa gal shel atzamot, ki yevarer veyishav chelek hammechayye mimmekom tachanoto.

rashi: Gol el Adonai maasecha. galgel vehashelech alav tzerachecha veyikkonu machshevotecha. davar acher: gol el Adonai maasecha, hitpallel lefanav al kol tzerachecha:
Veyikkonu. yitbassesu veyitkayyemu:
targum: Geli leelaha ovdach umetaknan machshevatach:

rashi: Ish haelohim. "navi da" (targum yonatan):
Shomer hassaf. "amarkela" (targum yonatan), tereshorir belaaz:
targum: Veaalet yathon levet makdesha dayya lelishkat bar chanan bar yigdalyahu neviya dayya devistar lishkat maaseya var shalum amarkela:

ohc: Lo tichrot vegomer. kashe, im kevar tzivva sheyyaharsu vishabberu otam, ma makom letzauot al keritat berit immahem? veod, ech yutzdak lichrot berit lelohehen? veim al avodat avoda zara hu omer, may irya bichritat berit?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu lomar sheen oser keritat berit im haummot, ella kol od shehem velohehen immahem, aval im kafru belohehen en issur. laze amar lo tichrot lahem velelohehem, perush kesheyyihyu lahem elohehen berit.

Venitkavven gam lomar ki hakkoret berit leoved avoda zara keillu karat berit laavoda zara atzmah mishshene teamim: haechad, ki sofo likkashel, kammaamar hassamuch: "pen yachatiu vegomer ki taavod". vehashsheni, ki bechinat haavoda zara titlabbesh beovdeha, uvaze nimtza shekkoret berit gam lelohehen rachmana litzlan. veen lomar ki laze levad nitkavven, sheim ken haya lo lomar "lo tichrot lahem berit velelohehen", veaz hayinu omrim shehakkavvana hi im karat lahem berit maale alav hakkatuv keillu vechulei. achen meamro hazekarat habberit achar hazekarat elohehen yaggid gam ma shepperashnu, shello asar ella bizman shello kibbel shello laavod avoda zara, aval im en lo eloah muttar lichrot lo berit kemo shekkartu berit laggivonim. vetaam shehikpidu yisrael achar kach, letzad sheamru zichronam livracha (yerushalmi sheviit 6,1) shemmittechilla hayu mehammordim beyisrael bishlichut iggeret yehoshua venitchayyevu kelaya kemitzvat hammelech "lo techayye kol neshama" (Devarim 20:16).

rashi: Vechi yerivun anashim. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar ayin tachat ayin, lo lamadnu ella deme evarav aval shevet verippuy lo lamadnu, lechach neemra parasha zo:
Venafal lemishkav. ketargumo veyippel levutelan – lecholi shemmevattelo mimmelachto:
ohc: Vechi yerivun anashim vegomer velo yamut. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar velo yamut, velo samach lehavin ki belo yamut medabber hakkatuv, ben mimma shekkadam bemishpat im yamut, ben mimma sheggamar omer "im yakum vehithallech" vegomer?

Achen hakkavvana hi lomar sheen chiyyuv latet shevet verippuy ella im lo yamut, aval im yamut lo yitten shevet verippuy, velaze lo amar hakkatuv "shivto yitten" vegomer ella achar sheamad mechalyo vehithallech.

Umistappek ani im amaduhu lemita velo met, im nomar maase nissim naasu lo shello met, kemo sheamru zichronam livracha (chullin 42,1) bitrefa sheenah chayya veim chayta maase nissim naasu lah (chullin mag,1), kemo chen bema shellefanay kan, im lo met – nes hu ze vechiyyuv shevet verippuy kevan sheppaka paka, o dilma hare lo met vechayyav beshevet, umiddivre rambam beferek 4 mashma ki chol shello met hagam sheamaduhu lemita chayyav beshevet verippuy.

Shuv matzati sheamru bammechilta, veze leshonam: "velo yamut venafal lemishkav" – ha im hikkahu hammakke makka sheyyesh bah kede lehamit – patur mehashshevet veharippuy, ad kan. mashma afillu lo met, mimma shettole hattaam bammakka velo amar "ha im yamut".

Venire shekkavvanat hattanna lomar shetztzarich lippater min hashshevet davka im met al yede makka sheyyesh bah kede lehamit, aval im met bemakka sheen bah kede lehamit, sheaz patur hammakke mimmita, yitchayyev latet shevet verippuy, im lo natan lo bachayyim chayyuto letzad ezo sibba, yitchayyev latet leyorshav kol ma shennogea laavihem im chay.

rashi: Uvayyom hashshevii tishbot. af bashshana hashsheviit lo teaker shabbat bereshit mimmekomah, shello tomar, hoil vechol hashshana keruya shabbat lo tinhag bah shabbat bereshit (sham):
Lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha. ten lo niach, lehattir sheyyehe tolesh veochel asavim min hakkarka; o eno ella yachbeshennu betoch habbayit? amarta en ze niach ella tzaar:
Ben amatcha. beeved arel hakkatuv medabber:
Vehagger. ger toshav:
ohc: Taase maasecha. velo "kol maasecha" kemo sheamar baaseret haddibberot, ki besheshet yamim shel shenat hashshemita shealeha chozer tziuuy shabbat kan, eno yachol laasot kol melachto, ki melechet adama asura lo kaamur besamuch.

rashi: Mittemol shilshom. hare shalosh negichot (mechilta):
Vehuad bivalav. leshon hateraa veedim, kemo haed heid banu haish (Bereshit 43):
Vehemit ish vegomer. lefi shenneemar ki yiggach en li ella shehemito vingicha, hemito vinshicha, dechifa, beita, minnayin? talmud lomar vehemit:
Vegam bealav yumat. bide shamayim. yachol bide adam? talmud lomar mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu, al retzichato atta horgo vei atta horgo al retzichat shoro (sanhedrin 15):
ohc: Vehuad bivalav. amar leshon rabbim, nitkavven lomar sheim hayu lo shene bealim – chayyavim shenehem mita, velo yihyu kishnayim shehargu adam keachat sheppeturin leman deamar (bava kamma 26:), ki hatam peturin mimmita bide adam vechayyavim bide shamayim vechan peturin mimmita bide adam vechayyavim bide shamayim. uvechofer, leheyoto mamon, chayyavin afilu bide adam:

rashi: Achare kerot hammelech. bashshana hashsheviit lemalcho. kach shaninu beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 26): "vayhi bashshana hashsheviit… bau anashim mizzikne yehuda lidrosh et Adonai" (Yechezkel 20:1). amru lichezkel: eved kohen shemmecharo rabbo, mahu sheyyochal bitruma? kelomar, lefi shehayu rotzin lomar: lo neenash al hammitzvot, al shehecheziru et haavadim:
targum: Pitgam nevua dahava im yirmeya min kodam Adonai batar digzar malka tzidkiya keyam im kol ama devirushelem lemikre lehon cheru:

rashi: Vayyavo moshe vaysapper laam. bo vayyom:
Et kol divre Adonai. mitzvat perisha vehagebala:
Veet kol hammishpatim. sheva mitzvot shennitztauu vene noach, veshabbat vechibbud av vaem ufara adumma vedinin shennittenu lahem bemara (sanhedrin 56):

Ki tikne eved ivri. eved shehu ivri; o eno ella avdo shel ivri – eved kenaani shellekachto miyyisrael – vealav hu omer shesh shanim yaavod? uma ani mekayyem vehitnachaltem otam (Vayikra 25), belakuach min haggoy, aval belakuach miyyisrael yetze beshesh? talo ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri (Devarim 15), lo amarti ella veachicha:

Ki tikne. miyyad bet din shemmecharuhu vignevato, kemo shenneemar im en lo venimkar bignevato, o eno ella bemocher atzmo mippene dachko, aval mecharuhu vet din lo yetze veshesh? keshehu omer vechi yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach (Vayikra 25), hare mocher atzmo mippene dachko amur, uma ani mekayyem ki tikne? benimkar bevet din:
Lachofshi. lecherut:
ohc: Ki tikne eved ivri. ulay sheyyechavven lomar sheim yihye lefanav liknot eved kenaani veeved ivri yakdim haivri, veze shiur hakkatuv: ki tirtze liknot eved – takdim liknot ivri, velo tomar, ekne eved sheeevod bo ad olam velo ekne eved sheachar shesh shanim ashallechennu.

Vetaam shekkerao ivri, ki chash hakkatuv leyaches shem avdut al yisrael, laze kinna oto beshem ze. od ramaz ki shem avdut al yisrael hu over veeno kavua, mittaam ki laAdonai hem avadim, veyetze mittachat yado bashshana hashsheviit. od yirmoz shello ba lide midda zo ad sheavar al hattora umitzvot, umechuvvan ledivrehem zichronam livracha (kiddushin yad:) ki bimcharuhu bet din bignevato hakkatuv medabber, vegam bemocher atzmo mechamat dochoko shemmatzinu sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 15:12) "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri", gam hu lo ba lide zo ad shekkevar kadmu lo averot, uchemaamar rabbi ame (shabbat noah:) en yissurin belo avon.

Od dikdek lomar ki tikne eved ivri velo amar ivri eved, lirmoz ki kodem shettiknehu eved hu, ucheamram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 22,2) ki bemochrim oto bet din hakkatuv medabber uchevar nitchayyev mehashshamayim. uvaze lo kashya lamma hutzrach lomar tevat eved, shemmizze yatza lanu litot eved shel ivri (mechilta mishpatim 1) ad shehutzrach lefaresh pasuk acher talmud lomar "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri" (Devarim 15:12).
Od nire ki taam shehutzrach lomar "eved", latet taam lema shetztzivva shesh shanim, laze hikdim lomar ki ze sheatta kone kevar hu eved, al derech sheamar (Vayikra 25:55) "ki li vene yisrael avadim":
Shesh shanim yaavod. taam amro chen lidrosh sheal kol panim yaavod shesh vaafillu barach, veamro yaavod velo peresh yaavadcha nitkavven lerabbot sheyyaavod gam bemot hakkone livno:

Uvashsheviit vegomer. perush, velifamim yaavod gam bashsheviit kesheyyimmacher beemtza shenat olam letashlum shana shennimkar bah, kede sheyyihyu shesh shanim shelemim miyyom leyom. od yirtze ki yaavod gam bashsheviit, perush, sheviit lashshanim im tifga betoch shesh shanav. shuv matzati diyyuk ze bedivre rambam beferush hammishna (kiddushin perek 1 mishna 2).

rashi: Lo tizbach al chametz vegomer. lo tishchat et happesach beyd benisan ad shettevaer hechametz (mechilta):
Vela yalin chelev chaggi chutz lammizbeach:
Ad boker. yachol af al hammaaracha yippasel belina, talo al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla (Vayikra 6):
Vela yalin. en lina ella veammud hashshachar, shenneemar ad boker, aval kol hallayla yachol lehaaloto min haritzpa lammizbeach (Megila 20):
Lev adam yechashshev darko. lalechet derech yashar:
VaAdonai yachin tzaado. kemo sheshshaninu (shabbat 104.): habba littaher mesayyein lo:
targum: Libbeh devar nasha mechashev archateh velaha metaken hilcheteh:

rashi: Elohim lo tekallel. hare zo azhara levirkat hashshem veazhara lekillat dayyan (sanhedrin 66):

Vegonev ish umecharo. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav (Devarim 24), en li ella ish shegganav nefesh, ishsha o tumtum o anderoginos shegganvu minnayin? talo vegonev ish umecharo. ulefi shennee kan vegonev ish, en li ella gonev ish, gonev ishsha minnayin? talo gonev nefesh, lechach hutzrechu shenehem, ma shechisser ze gilla ze (sanhedrin sham):
Venimtza veyado. sherauhu edim sheggenavo umecharo, venimtza chevar beyado kodem mechira (sham):

Mot yumat. bechenek; kol mita haamura vattora setam chenek hi (vehifsik hainyan vechatav vegonev ish ben makke aviv veimmo limkallel aviv, venire li hayenu pelugeta, demar savar makkeshinan hakkaa liklala umar savar la makkeshinan 0):
Veanshe kodesh tihyun li. im attem kedoshim uferushim mishshikkutze nevelot uterefot hare attem shelli veim lav enchem shelli:

Uvasar bassade terefa. af babbayit ken, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove – makom shedderech behemot littaref; vechen ki vassade metzaah (Devarim 22), vechen asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layla (sham 23), hu haddin lemikre yom, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove. uvesar ditlish min cheva chayya, basar shennitlash ay terefat zeev o ari min chayya cheshera o mibbehema cheshera bechayyeha:

Lakkelev tashlichun oto. af haggoy kakkelev; o eno ella kelev kemashmao? talo binvela o machor lenachri (sham 14), kava litrefa shemmutteret bechol hanaot. im ken ma talo lakkelev? lelammedcha shehakkelev nichbad mimmennu, velimmedcha hakkatuv sheen hakkabba mekappeach sechar kol beriyya, shenneemar ulechol bene yisrael lo yecheratz kelev leshono (Shemot 11), amar hakkabba tenu lo secharo (mechilta):
Evyoncha. leshon ove, shehu meduldal vetaev lechol tova:
ohc: Lo tatte mishpat evyoncha. ulay shetztzivva Adonai al mishpat haaniyyim, al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 71,1) "aniyyecha vaaniyye ircha vechulei, aniyye ircha vaaniyye ir acheret – aniyye ircha kodmin", velaze ba hammitzva kan belav leval yatte mishpat hakkadum leacharo, vehu amro "evyoncha".

rashi: Ki taavod vegomer. hare ellu ki meshammeshin bimkom asher, vechen bechamma mekomot, vezehu leshon i shehu echad mearba leshonot shehakki meshammesh, vegam matzinu beharebe mekomot im meshammesh bilshon asher, kemo veim takriv minchat bikkurim (Vayikra 2), shehi chova:
ohc: Pen yachatiu otcha li. kan gilla haadon ki hachissaron nogea labbore. vehasekalat haddevarim hi ki yisrael lihyotam bechinat hakkedushsha, beet asher yaavdu avoda zara hinne hem gorim meerech kodesh venechsarim mishsharsham, venimtza hachissaron nogea leshoresh hakkedushsha.

Ki yihye lecha lemokesh vegomer. perush, natan taam minnayin yaale al haddaat sheyyechashdu yisrael al ze lehamir kevodam belo yoil, laze hodia ki haavoda zara mata et ovdeha linnakesh achareha, keamram zichronam livracha (avoda zara noah,1) sheyyesh avoda zara shemmegalla matzpunot umatmonot umaggedet atidot, velaze chash Adonai al banav leval yinnakshu.

rashi: Haegel asher kartu lishnayim. keshechazru vechavshum, kartu kullam berit limrod bammakom, vechartu haegel lishnayim veavru ben betarav, limrod bo. vehi hayta berit chazaka ugemura, lemor: kacha yibbater veyechalek haover aleha (Bereshit 15:9-17):
targum: Veetten yat gavraya daavaru al keyami dela kayimu yat pitgame keyama digzaru kodamay igla difsaku litren vaavaru ben palgohi:

rashi: Meleatcha. chova hammuttelet alecha keshettitmalle tevuatcha lehitbashshel, vehem bikkurim:
Vedimacha. hatteruma – veeni yodea mahu leshon dema.
Lo teacher. lo teshanne seder haferashatan leacher et hammukdam ulehakdim et hameuchar, shello yakdim teruma levikkurim umaaser litruma (mechilta):

Bechor banecha titten li. lifdoto vechamesh selaim min hakkohen; vahalo kevar tzivva alav bemakom acher? ella kede lismoch lo ken taase leshorcha – ma bechor adam leachar sheloshim yom podehu, shenneemar ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde (Bamidbar 18), af bechor behema dakka metappel bo sheloshim yom veachakka notno lakkohen (bechorot 26):
Tov shefal ruach. tov lehitchabber et anavim velihyot ittam shefal ruach, miheyot mechallek shalal et geim:
targum: Tav hu shefal ruach veenvana min hu demaflig adita im gevtane:

rashi: Vaychassehu heanan. rabbotenu cholkim baddavar, yesh mehem o ellu shishsha yamim shemmerch (ad atzeret yom mattan tora):
Vaychassehu heanan. lahar:

Vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii lomar aseret haddibberot, umoshe vechol bene yisrael omdim, ella shechalak hakkatuv kavod lemoshe; veyeo vaychassehu heanan lemoshe sheshet yamim leachar aseret haddibberot, vehem hayu bitchillat arbaim yom sheala moshe lekabbel luchot, velimmedcha shekkol hannichnas lemachane shechina taun perisha shishsha yamim (yoma 3):
Vetzarti. ketargumo veaik:
ohc: Veayavti vegomer. ulay sheyyirmoz ki beemtzaut esek hattora vehammitzva, hinne haadon yaakor shoresh hakkelippa vaanafeha, shehem hammesitim vehammaddichim vehammevakshim lehashepil degel hattora. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat bereshit bemaase kayin behitvakkechut haadon immo (Bereshit 4:9-15).

rashi: Vechi yiggach shor. echad shor veechad kol behema vechayya vaof, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove (bava kamma 54):

Velo yeachel et besaro. mimmashma shenneemar sakol yissakel hashshor eni yodea shehu nevela unevela asura baachila? ella ma talmud lomar velo yeachel et besaro? sheafillu shechato leachar shennigmar dino asur baachila, bahanaa minnayin? talo uvaal hashshor naki, keadam haomer lachavero yatza peloni naki minnechasav veen lo vahem hannaa shel kelum, zehu midrasho (bava kamma Melachim 1). ufeshuto chemashmao, lefi shenneemar bammuad vegam bealav yumat, hutzrach lomar battam uvaal hashshor naki:
ohc: Vechi yiggach vegomer et ish. taam amro et, yitbaer al derech amram baggemara (sanhedrin et,1) nitkavven laharog shimon veharag reuven chayyav, shehare nitkavven laharog mi shechayyav alav. vehu amro et ish lerabbot kol shennitkavven leish, hagam sheharag acher shello nitkavven lo. vedavka nitkavven leish, aval nitkavven livhema veharag haish patur, kidamrinan sham (sanhedrin 78,2).
Vamet. perush, afilu met achar zeman, kol shemmet mechamat negicha, vechen mashma middivre Rashi (bava kamma ma.) beferush sugeyat sikken shelosha bene adam velo metu, yeuyyan sham.
Velo yeachel et besaro. veim achalo loke, aval shear hanaot hannishmaot meamro "uvaal hashshor naki" – hagam sheasur eno loke, velaze lo kalal hakkol bichlalut echad.

rashi: Mechashshefa lo techayye. ella tumat bevet din; veechad zecharim veechad nekevot, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove, shehannashim metzuyot mechashshefot (sanhedrin 67):
Boohalim teshvu. bammidbariyyot. asher attem garim sham. lo haya lahem chelek baaretz, shebbene gerim hayu (sifre Bamidbar 78):
targum: Uveta la tivnun vezara la tizreun vecharmaya la titzvun vela yehe lechon are vemashkenin tetvun kol yomechon bedil detitkaymun yomin sagiin al appe ara deattun dayrin taman:

rashi: Kemohar habbetulot. shehu katzuv chamishshim kesef etzel hattofes et habbetula veshochev immah beones, shenneemar venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef (Devarim 22):

Venaki vetzaddik al taharog. minnayin layyotze mibbet din chayyav veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut shemmachazirin oto? talo venaki al taharog, veaappi sheeno tzaddik, shello nitztaddek bevet din, mikkol makom naki hu middin mita shehare yesh lecha lezakkoto. uminnayin layyotze mibbet din zakkay veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav chova sheen machazirin oto levet din? talo vetzaddik al taharog, veze tzaddik hu shennitztaddek bevet din (sanhedrin 33):
Ki lo atzdik rasha. en alecha lehachaziro, ki ani lo atzdikennu vedini, im yatza miyyadcha zakkay yesh li sheluchim harebe lahamito vammita shennitchayyev bah (mechilta):
ohc: Ki lo atzdik rasha. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin log:) sheppershu "naki" – ze mi sheyyesh alav maggid zechut, vetzaddik" – ze mi sheyyatza tzaddik bedino veyesh alav maggid chova, yechavven hakkatuv lomar taam haddevarim shello tomar ech achar shennigmar dino lechova yachzor haddin lizchut, laze amar ki lo atzdik rasha, perush, mimma nafshach, im ma sheyyatza chayyav hu kefi haemet vehatztzedek – lo atzdik rasha velo yoil hammelammed zechut, veim ma sheyyatza chayyav haya shello kefi haddin – lamma yevulla naki chinnam. ucheneged chalukkat mi sheyyatza tzaddik bedino amar gam ken ki lo atzdik rasha, perush, kevan sheyyatza tzaddik lo hitzdaktihu vehu rasha, ki elohim nitztzav baadat el uvekerev elohim yishpot vehu shofet betzedek, umin hannimna sheyyachtom Adonai al devar sheker chas veshalom. vetze ulemad amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ka:) deasur lemechtam al milleta demitchaze keshikra. veim tomar velamma en anu omrim ken beyatza chayyav, yesh lecha ladaat ki Adonai yinnachem al haraa velo yinnachem al hattova, umi sheyyatza chayyav chazar bo Adonai lezakkoto, aval mi sheyyatza zakkay lo yinnachem Adonai mehattova, velifamim yaspik laadam ze innuy ze sheyyatza mishpato chayyav veemot mavet yaggiuhu biroto ki nigmar dino lamut, velaze achar kach bekerev elohim yishpot lezakkoto.

rashi: El haelohim. levet din; tzarich sheyyimmalech bemochrav shemmecharuhu lo (sham):

El haddelet o el hammezuza. yachol shettehe hammezuza cheshera lirtzoa aleha, talo venatatta veazno uvaddelet, baddelet velo vammezuza, ha ma talo o el hammezuza? hikkish delet limzuza, ma mezuza meomed af delet meomed (sham):

Veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea. hayemanit, o eno, ella shel semol? talo ozen ozen ligzera shava, neemar kan veratza adonav et azno, veneemar bimtzora tenuch ozen hammittaher hayemanit (Vayikra 14), ma lehallan hayemanit, af kan hayemanit; uma raa ozen leratza mikkol shear evarim shebbagguf? amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay: ozen zot sheshshama al har sinay lo tignov, vehalach veganav, teratza. veim mocher atzmo, ozen sheshshama al har sinay ki li vene yisrael avadim, vehalach vekana adon leatzmo, teratza. rabbi shimon haya doresh mikra ze kemin chomer: ma nishtannu delet umezuza mikkol kelim shebbabbayit? amar hakkabba delet umezuza shehayu edim bemitzrayim kesheppasachti al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot veamarti ki li vene yisrael avadim – avaday hem velo avadim laavadim – vehalach ze vekana adon leatzmo, yeratza bifnehem (kiddushin 22):

Vaavado leolam. ad hayyovel; o eno ella leolam chemashmao? talo veish el mishpachto tashuvu (Vayikra 25), maggid shechamishshim shana keruyim olam; velo sheyyehe ovdo kol chamishshim shana, ella ovdo ad hayyovel, ben samuch ben muflag (kiddushin 15):
O ven yiggach. ben shehu katan:
O vat. shehi ketanna; lefi shenneemar vehemit ish o ishsha, yachol eno chayyav ella al haggedolim, talmud lomar o ven yiggach vegomer, lechayyev al hakketannim kaggedolim (sham):

Veim shelosh elle lo yaase lah. im achat mishshelosh elle lo yaase lah; uma hen hashshalosh? yiadenna lo, o livno, o yegarea mippidyonah vetetze, veze lo yeadah, lo lo velo livno, vehi lo haya veyadah lifdot et atzmah:

Veyatza chinnam. ribba lah yetzia lazo yoter mimma sheribba laavadim, uma hi hayetzia? limmedcha shettetze vesimanin vetishhe immo od ad shettavi simanin, – veim higgiu shesh shanim kodem simanin, kevar lamadnu shettetze, shenneemar haivri o haivriyya vaavadcha shesh shanim (Devarim 15) – umahu haamur kan veyatza chinnam? sheim kadmu simanim leshesh shanim tetze vahen. o eno omer shettetze ella bevagrut? talo en kasef lerabbot yetziat bagrut; veim lo neemru shenehem hayiti omer veyatza chinnam zo vagrut, lechach neemru shenehem shello litten pitchon pe levaal haddin lachalok (mechilta):
ohc: Veim shelash elle. hem sheerah, kesutah veonatah, velaze dikdek lomar elle velo hakkodmim lahem shehem yiud vegomer. veamar veyatza chinnam, perush paka zechutam mimmenna, sheenam yecholim lechavshah ad zeman shesh shanim o shear simanim, ella o yekayyem shelosha devarim o yotzienna beget, velaze gamar omer en kasef, lomar kesef hu sheen aval get tzarich ki arusato hi. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) amru shelosha elle: yiud lo velivno vegeron kesef, veyatza chinnam bahavaat simanim, veellu min hahalachot shenneemru behar sinay usemachum.

Venire lefaresh parasha zo derech remez al pi divrehem sheamru (sota 42:) en "ish" setam ella hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Shemot 15:3) "Adonai ish milchama". veamru od (Shir HaShirim Rabba 83) lo zaz Adonai mechabbev lichneset yisrael ad shekkeraah bitto, umatzinu shekkinna hakkatuv inyan haggalut beshem mechira, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 12:9) "vayyimkor otam beyad" vegomer, vehinne lefi ma shekkadam vetzivva hakkatuv al hakkone eved ivri shello yaavod ella shesh shanim, laze kovel hakkatuv bead am bene yisrael, lamma nishtanna dino middin haavadim hayyotzim beshesh, vehu amro vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama, lamma tiggara middin haavadim asher tzivvita shesh shanim vegomer, vehu amro lo tetze ketzet haavadim bashsheviit. velamma nimkera baggalut hammar hazze ze lanu elef vetrv vaanachnu lo noshanu, veten lanu mishpat eved ivri harashum bichtav.

Vechazar hakkatuv vetaan im raa vegomer, perush, im odenna bemadregat resha shebbishvilo nimkera, dichtiv (yeshaya 50:1) "hen baavonotechem nimkartem" vegomer. veamro beene adoneha asher vegomer, perush, ki habbat hayyekara yeshnah gam bemadregat kalla, kemaamar sefer kodesh hakkodashim shir hashshirim (Shir HaShirim 4:8), vehu amro adoneha asher lo yeadah, ki otah yied lechalla. uchetiv beAlef "asher lo yeadah", perush, hen atta lo yeadah letzad maaseha hammechoarim. vetaan hakkatuv al ze vehefdah, perush, ki lo yukkar lah bechinat hara beodah mechura uvoaleha adonim zarim, ki hem yimnauha measot tov veyachrichuha laasot raa beene adoneha, veen teshuvat heyotah raa baggalut teshuva ad shettihye geulla, az yukkar bah im raa im lo. umeatta eno min haddin sheyyimkerenna leam nachri al asher tihye raa beenav kol zeman shehu boged bah, perush, kol zeman mechiratah, ella al asher asta bime shalvatah keshello haya aleha yad moshel nachri.

Veamro veim livno – taan vechazar vetaan, ki matzinu shehakkadosh baruch hu kara leyisrael banim behacheraza leene haammim kullam, veyadu ki yisrael hem umma hammeyuedet beshem ben laAdonai. vehen atta im adayin umma zo meyuedet livchinat beno, min harauy haya lefachot shello tihye gerua mehaummot, kaasher enenu root rum maalot haummot veyishshuvan ma sheen ken yisrael, umin harauy lo tihye gerua mehem, veday lah hashepala zo shello yihye leyisrael madrega gedola mehem. vehu amro kemishpat habbanot, ki gam hem yikkaru banot ella shello yittachnu bemaala zo likkarot bitto shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veamro im acheret, da ki amru zichrono livracha (zohar 10 152:) ki bizman hachurban kol kele hashshefa mashpiin chutz limkoman bishar haummot velo beyisrael, ki mitkalkelim hatztzinnorot umerikim bemakom lo kadosh. vehu amro im acheret yikkach lo, latet middat tuvo kaasher ene chol yisrael root hafelagat hattov beyad lo mibbene yisrael hemma. taan hakkatuv od – lu yihye shekkaas od aleha shello tihye behaderagat hattov vehahashket kivnot haolam, venoten Adonai middat tuvo leumma acheret, lefachot sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra. sheerah – ellu mezonoteha kemaamar rabbi yoshiyya (mechilta), kesutah kemashmao, veonatah – hi sheyyihye one otah batztzar, ushelosha devarim ellu hem devarim hammuchrachim veech yechola lichyot zulatam.

Veamar od veim shelash elle – perush, sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yaase lah, vetihye gerua mehem. veyatza chinnam – perush, hagam shello yihye beyadam lo tora velo mitzvot, vaafillu lo yichsefu lidvar haggeulla, vehu amro en kasef, ki yissureha yaspiku lefidyonah.

O tirmoz happarasha al ze hadderech: vechi yimkor ish – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, et bitto – umma hakkedosha, leama – perush, leheyot shekkevar avru galuyyot al yisrael: galut mitzrayim, galut bavel vechulei, vechullam lo nishtabedu yisrael ella leumma achat, veen davar ze sovev keriat shem avdut al yisrael. aval baggalut hachel sheanu bo atta, mishtabedim yisrael lechol shivim ummot, bechol makom asher sham ivri bazuy hu veshafal, vechol echad bozez vechozer likkute batar likkute, vedavar ze yenasse visammen bahem benissayon gadol vesiman muvhak. vehu amro leama, ki ummatenu begalut ze kanta shem ama, umeatta gam bevo geullatenu ufidyon nafshenu kevar kanta haumma shem avdut. laze amar hakkadosh baruch hu havetacha ki geullat haumma hallaz lo tihye kederech asher hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim mibbet avadim, ella benissim muflagim befirsum bechol haolam. vehu amro lo tetze ketzet haavadim harmuzim battora (Shemot 20:2) "mibbet avadim" vegomer, sheaz lo hifli Adonai pelaav ella beumma achat, veaz bechol haolam vehayu melachim omnayich vesarotehem vegomer veyishtachavu kol malche eretz, kakkatuv besefer yeshaya (49:23).

Veamro im raa vegomer, yitbaer al pi maamar hazzohar ki tishtanne geullat yisrael im tihye beemtzaut maasehem hattovim leim tihye letzad hashelamat ketz hassatum, ki im tihye beemtzaut hachanat yisrael yavo haggoel malach Adonai beammud esh mutztzav artza verosho bashshamayma, veim letzad hakketz veyisrael lo reuyim lo, alav neemar (Zecharya 9,9) "ani verochev al chamor", vehu amro keneged biat haggoel letzad hakketz hagam sheen yisrael reuyim lo im raa vegomer, perush afillu im tihye raa beene adoneha, kesheyyaggia hakketz asher katzav leyaadah, velo beAlef yirtze, sheenah reuya leyiudav ki hi raa, af al pi chen vehefdah, perush pidyon yussag lah al kol panim, aval lo yihye haddavar kederech im lo tihye raa beet haggeulla. veamar leam nachri vegomer, perush, ki lo latztzemitut yihye hammecher leam nachri hagam sheyyivgod bah, kemaamar hakkatuv (Iyov 28,3) "ketz sam lachoshech".

Ucheneged biat haggeulla letzad maasehem hattovim vehachesharatam amar veim livno yiadenna, al derech amram (bava batra 10.) kesheyyisrael osim retzono shel makom nikrau banim. hakkavvana – im yiudim asher yiadenna Adonai beet haggeulla tihye letzad heyotam bemadregat banim, az kemishpat habbanot. davar ze yaggid hafelagat shaashua yisrael bevo haggoel, perush banot hem neshamot hammishtaashim began eden hannikraim benot yerushalayim, umishpat shekkatzav lahem tzeror hammor dodi li lehiggalot lahem oro yitbarach, veze hu michyatam veshaashuam vetachlit maavayyam. amar Adonai ki kammishpat hazze yease lahem beviat haggoel beodam baolam hazze, yegalle Adonai or shechinato al kol hatztzaddikim veyomru kullam "ze eli" vegomer bitmidut kemishpat habbanot.

Veamro im acheret vegomer. ba hakkatuv lehatenot, ematay chillakti lecha ben zeman shehi raa lizman shehi bemadregat beno, ella bizman sheim acheret yikkach lo al derech shepperashnuha lemala, sheerah kesutah veonatah shel habbat hayyisreelit lo yigra, baze hu shechillakti. aval im shelash elle vegomer veyatza chinnam, perush, afillu enam tzaddikim lichsof el yom pedut yetzu afillu kodem zeman haggalut, vahare hem yotzim bizchut yissurin asher kibbelu bemachsor sheloshet haddevarim, veshavim hem lemadregat ben.

rashi: Ach im yom o yomayim yaamod lo yukkam. im al yom echad hu patur al yomayim lo kol shekken? ella yom shehu cheyomayim, veeze? ze meet leet (mechilta):
Lo yukkam ki chaspo hu. ha acher shehikkahu, aappi sheshshaha meet leet kodem shemmet, chayyav:
ohc: Lo yukkam ki chaspo. veim harago shogeg yigle al yado, uvedin ze en bo chilluk beno leven rotzeach leadam sheeno avdo, ki eno chayyav galut ella im harago umet tachat yado mammash, uchemo shekkatavnu befasuk (Shemot 21:12) "makke ish" vegomer, velo hutzrach lichtov ella din shehu meshunne middin rotzeach lesheeno avdo.

rashi: Im begappo yavo. shello haya nasuy ishsha, ketargumo im bilchodohi, uleshon begappo – bichnafo, shello ba ella kemot shehu, yechidi, betoch levusho – bichnaf bigdo:
Begappo yetze. maggid sheim lo haya nasuy mittechilla, en rabbo moser lo shifcha chenaanit leholid mimmenna avadim (kiddushin 20):
Im baal ishsha hu. yisreelit:
Veyatza ishto immo. vechi mi hichnisah shettetze? ella maggid hakkatuv shehakkone eved ivri chayyav bimzonot ishto uvanav (sham 22):
ohc: Im begappo yavo vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha bekiddushin (kiddushin 20.) amru: yechidi nichnas yechidi yetze, mikkan sheen rabbo rashshay limsor lo shifcha kenaanit ella im hu nasuy. venire ki huksha lahem yittur hakkatuv, lamma hutzrach lomar ken? mimma nafshach, im lomar ki davka kesheyyikkanes begappo hu sheyyetze begappo, aval kesheyyikkanes im ishto lo yetze begappo – peshita, ki mi hichnisah shetztzarich lomar ken? vetimtza sheddikdeku rabbotenu zichronam livracha (kiddushin 22.) bemaamar "veyatza ishto" ki lo haya tzarich leamrah, ufershuha lechayyev mezon ishto uvanav. veim al shifcha hannoten lo rabbo eno tzarich, hare hu omer besamuch "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha vehu yetze vegappo". ella vadday lidrasha ba, lomar "im begappo" – perush, belo ishsha yisreelit, mimma sheggilla besof devarav "im baal ishsha" vegomer. begappo yetze – perush, yechidi yetze, perush, yishshaer bechammut shehu yechidi ad yetziato. o al ze hadderech makkish yetzia lehachenasa, keshem shekkeshennichnas nichnas yechidi mammash belo ishsha uvanim, ben hayyotzim immo ben hannisharim bevet haadon, kemo chen bitziato. veim hayta lo ishsha velo hayu lo vanim gam ken en rabbo moser lo shifcha sheanu korim bo "begappo", veen tzarich lomar hayu lo vanim velo hayta lo ishsha.

Veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi sheddiyyek shehaya lo lomar "im begappo vegomer ken yetze". veen devarav nirim, ki adrabba im haya omer ken yihye nishma yoter shello yitten lo shifcha veyishshaer kemot shehu. vehaemet ki taam shello amar ken, ki yesh lachush lidrashot acherim hannishmaim mimmenna, vehammaskil yavin.

Veim tomar minnayin lahem lerabbotenu zichronam livracha (kiddushin 20.) shehosifu habbanim, vahagam ki devarim ellu halacha hem, yesh lomar ki im yikkanes beishsha belo vanim hare ani kore alav "begappo yetze", shello yitten lo shifcha veyihyu lo banim mimmenna, sheaz eno dome gappo shel yetzia legappo shel hachenasa, ki az lo hayu lo vanim veatta yesh lo banim. veim beshaa shennichnas hayta lo ishsha velo vanim veachar kach hayu lo banim, nichnas begeder hetter. veulay ki laze talta hattora haddavar baishsha shehi tzericha lihyot bishat biato leavdut, aval habbanim hagam sheyyihyu achar kach. veim hayta lo ishsha keshekkenao umeta, mashma shemmuttar, ki lo hikpid hakkatuv ella al sheat bia "begappo yavo". vezulat divrehem zichronam livracha hayiti omer ki hakkatuv shalal din ze meamro "im baal ishsha hu", tzarich shettihye ishto immo ad sheat yetzia, uvaze ani mattir lecha – im adonav yitten lo ishsha.

Im baal ishsha vegomer. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta achariti 504) sheen haadon chayyav bimzonot ishto shel eved, ella im tihye ishsha haruya lo laamod immo velo ishsha haasura lo meissure lavin. vehinne bedin mesirat shifcha kenaanit mashma mehashshas vehuva bedivre rambam (hilchot avadim 83 9) shekkol sheyyesh lo ishsha uvanim, vaafillu haishsha meissure lavin, yachol litten lo vechulei. vehu amro im baal ishsha hu, perush, en tzarich shettihye ishto haruya lo legabbe ma sheasarti lecha besamuch "im begappo" sheen rabbo moser lo, aval legabbe mezonot veyatza ishto, perush, haruya lo hu shechayyav haadon bimzonoteha.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta) veze leshonam: yachol yehe chayyav bimzonot arusa veshomeret yavam? talmud lomar "ishto" – lehotzi shomeret yavam, "immo" – lehotzi arusato. vehinne eved shehayta lo ishsha shomeret yavam o arusa muttar latet lo shifcha kenaanit, vehu amro im baal ishsha hu – perush belo tenay, hagam shettihye arusa o shomeret yavam yatza mikkelal begappo sheasarti lecha netinat shifcha. uledivre hashshas (kiddushin 20.) sheddikdeku habbanim gam ken yihye haddin behecha shehayu lo banim meishsha acheret umeta veeras ishsha – yeshno bimsirat shifcha.
Veyatza. amro betosefet vav, ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai al mezonot haishsha, yutzdak lomar vav, ki millevad shechayyav bimzonotav gam kulei.

rashi: Tishmetenna. meavoda:
Unetashtah. meachila achar zeman habbiur. davar acher, tishmetenna – meavoda gemura, kegon charisha uzeria, unetashtah – millezabbel umillekashkesh (socha 44):
Veyitram tochal chayyat hassade. lehakkish maachal evyon lemaachal chayya, ma chayya ochelet belo maaser, af evyonim ochlim velo maaser; mikkan amru en maaser bashsheviit (mechilta):
Ken taase lecharmecha. utechillat hammikra medabber bisde hallavan, kemo sheamur lemala hemennu tizra et artzecha:
Al kol devar pesha. sheyyimmatze shakran bishvuato – sheyyaidu edim shehu atzmo genavo – veyarshiuhu elohim al pi haedim.

Yeshallem shenayim lereehu. limmedcha hakkatuv, shehattoen befikkadon lomar nignav hemennu, venimtza shehu atzmo genavo, meshallem tashlume kefel; veematay? bizman shennishba veachakka bau edim, shekkach darshu rabbotenu: venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim, keriva zo shevua hi, atta omer lishvua o eno ella laddin, shekkevan shebba laddin vechafar lomar nigneva, miyyad yitchayyev kefel im bau edim shehu veyado? neemar kan shelichut yad veneemar lematta shelichut yad – shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem im lo shalach yado – ma lehallan shevua, af kan shevua (sham):

Asher yomar ki hu ze. lefi feshuto asher yomar haed ki hu ze shennishbata alav, hare hu etzlecha, ad haddayyanin yavo devar shenehem, veyachkeru et haedim, im kesherim hem veyarshiuhu leshomer ze, yeshallem shenayim, veim yarshiu et haedim, shennimtzeu zommin, yeshallemu hem shenayim lashshomer. verabbotenu zichrono livracha darshu ki hu ze lelammed, sheen mechayyevin oto shevua ella im ken hoda bemiktzat, lomar kach vechach ani chayyav lecha, vehammotar nignav mimmenni (sham 107):
ohc: Al kol devar pesha vegomer. amru zichronam livracha (bava metzia 57:) "al kol" vegomer – kelal, "al shor" vegomer – perat, "al kol" vegomer – chazar vechalal. ma happerat – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon vechulei, yatzu karkaot sheen mittaltelin, vaavadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot, yatzu shetarot sheen gufan mamon, ad kan. ufasak ken rambam perek 2 mehilchot geneva. hinne peshatan shel devarim yaggidu ki hagam sheppasha shomer chinnam vechulei patur, ki zulat happeshia afillu bechesef vechelim patur hu.

Veraiti larambam shekkatav beferek 2 mehilchot sechirut, veze leshono: yerae li sheim pasha hashshomer baavadim vechayyotze bahem chayyav leshallem, sheeno patur baavadim vekarkaot ushetarot ella middin geneva vaaveda, sheim haya shomer chinnam venignevu o avdu vechulei patur mishshevua vechulei, aval im pasha bah chayyav leshallem, shekkol happoshea mazzik hu, veen hefresh ben din mazzik karka ledin mazzik mittaltelin, vedin emet hu ze lammevinim vechulei, ad kan. vechalku alav rabbevavta zichronam livracha betaana hannishmaat, vehi sheim haya poshea mazzik mammash, lo haya patur im bealav immo sheamar hakkatuv "lo yeshallem" vaafillu im pasha, uchemo shekkatav rambam atzmo beferek 1 mehilchot sechirut, veze leshono: vaafillu pasha vechulei veavad mechamat happeshia patur, ad kan. ufashut sheddin poshea eno kedin mazzik, ki happoshea eno lo shomer velo mazzik, ella shebbehistallekut shemirato hahezzek ba meatzmo, aval hammazzik hu gorem lo hahezzek. veod hikshu, im ken yitchayyev al kol panim shomer chinnam shevua shello pasha kevan sheim pasha chayyav.

Venire lomar ki ma shehikshu mishshemira babbealim shane veshane, ki babbealim gilla hakkatuv beferush ki patur hu hagam shehizzik, kammuvan mehakketuvim uchemo sheddarshu behashshoel, aval ma shemmiet hakkatuv karkaot ushetarot bedin shomer chinnam lo matzinu shemmiatam beferush afillu pasha, ki lo huzekra peshia kelal ella shelichut yad dichtiv "im lo shalach", uma sheanu mechayyevin shomer chinnam al happeshia eno ella letzad din mazzik, veech nefaresh hammiut al davar shello huzekar kelal. veim amro "devar pesha", kevar pershuhu sheyyechavven al pasha bo sheggenavo hu veomer nignav, aval happeshia lo huzekra. vehen emet ki im happeshia lo haya bah mishpat mazzik hayinu omrim ki miet lechol mishpete shomer chinnam hagam shello huzekru, achen lema sheanu roim ki ma shechiyyevu chachamenu zichronam livracha poshea hu middin mazzik, im ken minnayin lanu lehakel baddavar, velaze katav harambam sheen lefatro.

Veim tomar, kevan shepposhea din mazzik yesh lo, im ken baal habbayit shehidlik gedisho shel sachir o kesuto yihye patur, shehare poshea mazzik ufatar rachamana. veulay ki lo hekel hakkatuv ella beshomer. od nire ki gam harambam yode sheen lo din mazzik mammash, veim saraf kesuto hammufkedet etzlo mehabbealim chayyav aleha, ufoshea kemazzik velo mazzik mammash. vetimtza shekkatav rambam perek 21 mehilchot ishut: haishsha sheshshavra kelim beet melachtah petura mittakkanat chachamim, ad kan. hare sheshshevira beyadayim enah petura ella mittakkana, uma shehikshu alav, im ken yitchayyev shevua al happeshia, katav rambam perek 4 mehilchot sheela ufikkadon: hammafkid etzel chavero chinnam venignav vechulei hare ze nishba vechulei im lo shalach yado vegomer umegalgelin alav shello pasha, ad kan. mashma middivre harav ki ikkar shevua deorayta enah ella shennigneva veeno birshuto, aval shevuat shello pasha middin gilgul anu baim aleha, umeatta shevuat shello pasha haamura beshomer chinnam takkanat chachamim hu, shello amra tora ella shello shalach, velaze kol sheyyeshnah lishvua shel tora gilgelu bah chachamim shevuat lo pasha, vechol sheenah shevuat hattora sheppetarattu paka gilgul.

Nimtzenu omrim, shello ba hammiut shel hahekdeshot, hakkarkaot vechulei, ella al shevuat shomer chinnam shello shalach yado davka, veim yitanu sheppasha bah yitchayyev shevuat hesset ketakkanat rav nachman (bava metzia 5,1). ulefi ze ma sheamru besof perek hachovel (bava kamma 93,1) behahu arneke shel tzedaka shehifkido rav yosef etzel hahu gavra, nignav vechiyyevo rav yosef, vehiksha abbaye "lishmor velo lechallek", im ken shessover shemmemaet hakkatuv afillu middin poshea ki hatam shepposhea haya mimma shechiyyevo leshallem vehu shomer chinnam. lefi ma shekkatavti befasuk "lishmor" ki din ze delchallek missevara patur hu belo miuta delishmor, ella deasmechuha akkera o shebba hakkatuv leval tite middevarav lechayyev afillu lechallek. laze shamar lecha hassevara hannishmaat lecha ki chol mamon sheen lo tovim patur hu ki lechol echad yomar vegomer, ma sheen ken din poshea bemamon sheyyesh lo tovim shehassechel noten ki poshea mazzik hu, im lo tihye reaya berura lefatro, kammevoar, keshello bivalim, bedino omed.

rashi: Al tammer bo. leshon hameraa, kemo asher yamre et picha (Yehoshua 1):
Ki lo yissa lefishachem. eno melummad bechach, shehu min hakkat sheen chotin, veod shehu shaliach veeno ose ella shelichuto:
Ki shemi bekirbo. mechubbar lerosh hammikra – hishshamer mippanav ki shemi meshuttaf bo. verabbotenu amru ze metatron sheshshemo cheshem rabbo, metatron begimatriyya shadday (sanhedrin 38):
ohc: Hishshamer mippanav vegomer. kan tzivva al mitzvot ase umitzvot lo taase, keneged mitzvot lo taase amar hishshamer vegomer, ki chol hishshamer vegomer lo taase, ucheneged mitzvot ase amar ushema bekolo:

Al tammer bo. kan ramaz lifullat haadam asher tesovev temurat tov bera veeved molech veshifcha yoreshet gevirtah (Mishlei 30:23), veal yede ze yitnakkem nakam mehaose temura velo yissa lefishachem. gam malach ze yadua hu ki hu bechinat hammishpat velo yissa avon keamro lo yissa vegomer, veamro ki shemi bekirbo hiskilu baddavar hazze ki beemtzaut chet haadam yesovev peredat alluf mikkirbo. veaskilcha ki metatron hakkadosh amru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lach:) shemo keshem rabbo, vehu 314, ki ole mispar atzmo shel hashshem, uvechet haadam yistallek shem 314 mimmennu, vehu sod amro (Yeshayahu 19:5) "venahar yecherav" vegomer, vehiskil lev maskil baddevarim beamro ki im shamoa tishma bekolo kimdabber al zulat, vegamar amro veasita et asher adabber velo amar asher yedabber, lomar ki shemi bekirbo vehaven:

rashi: Et en avdo. kenaani, aval ivri eno yotze veshen veayin, kemo sheamarnu lo tetze ketzet haavadim:

Tachat eno. vechen bechd rashe evarim: etzbeot hayyadayim veharaglayim, ushete aznayim, vehachotem, verosh haggeviyya shehu gid haamma. velamma neemar shen veayin? sheim neemar ayin velo neemar shen, hayiti omer ma ayin shennivra immo af kol shennivra immo, vahare shen lo nivra immo; veim neemar shen velo neemar ayin, hayiti omer afillu shen tinok sheyyesh lah chalifin, lechach neemar ayin (mechilta):
ohc: Vechi yakke vegomer. bekiddushin (kiddushin kad:) peligi rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan, rabban shimon ben gamliel sover tzarich lechavven leshachatah, verabbanan sovrim hagam shello nitkavven leshachatah ella shetztzarich lechavven laayin atzmah. vekashe lerabbanan haya lo lomar "vechi yashchit ish et en avdo". veulay ki hayiti omer ki hashechata sheamar hakkatuv hi legufah, velo hayinu yodim sheyyechavven hakkatuv lomar tenay hu haddavar shetztzarich sheyyechavven lah.

Od nire shennitkavven lomar, shehagam shello shichatah bishat hahakkaa atzmah ella achar zeman, yihye haddin ken. veeno dome leshogeg shekkatavnu lemala shetztzarich sheyyamut bashshaa atzmah. uderashat rabbanan shetztzarich sheyyechavven laayin nishmaat mikkinnuy "veshichatah":

rashi: Himmatze timmatze. birshuto, shello tavach velo machar:

Mishshor ad chamor. kol davar bichlal tashlume kefel, ben sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, ben sheen bo ruach chayyim, shehare neemar bemikra acher "al se al salma al kol aveda … yeshallem shenayim lereehu" (bava kamma 62):
Chayyim shenayim yeshallem. velo yeshallem lo metim, ella chayyim o deme chayyim (mechilta):
ohc: Im himmatze timmatze. taam hakkefel lomar achat legufah shebbau edim sheggenavah, usheniyya lomar shemmetzauha beayin etzlo, aval zulat ze yitchayyev bearbaa vachamishsha shekkol sheenah beyado bechezkat mechura o shechuta, velo amar hakkatuv shenayim levad ella benimtzet. veteda shellav davka machar o tavach ella hu haddin natan o ibbed kol sheyyatzta mershuto, vechen muchach bashshas (bava kamma et:) lehedya, vehu haddin hikdish. veraiti ledayyek mikkan sheim ganav meoved kochavim umazzalot en bo din "veim en lo venimkar bignevato" sheamar besamuch, mimma sheamar samuch levnimkar bignevato" "im himmatze timmatze vegomer shenayim yeshallem", veamar hakkatuv bedin tashlume shenayim – "lereehu" velo leoved kochavim umazzalot kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (mechilta). ha lamadta ki din "venimkar bignevato" haamur bainyan en hakkatuv medabber ella beganav miyyisrael velo meoved kochavim umazzalot velo mehekdesh, vehem divre rambam beferek 3 mehilchot geneva, velo matzu lo sham taam vehinne hu.

rashi: Hares teharsem. leotam elohut:
Matztzevotehem. avanim shehem matztzivin lehishtachavot lahem:
ohc: Lo tishtachave vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letzauot laze achar shehizhir kamma azharot al kiur ze veal haddome lo, uma gam shebbesamuch lemala hizhir afillu al bal yissa et shemotam al sefatav, velo ligrom sheyyizkeru shemam hazzulat, dichtiv (Shemot 23:13) "velo yishshama al picha", im ken ma makom lehazehir od al haavoda. veramban yishshev ki leheyotah chamura yarbe bah haazharot, umin hattema hu sheachar shehishva otah lechol hattora kullah kaamur lemala ben leinyan onesh ben leinyan sachar, hinne haovdah over al taryag azharot, uma gam sheyyesh mitzvot sheyyesh bahem shene lavin veyoter, umitzva zo shekula keneged hakkol.

Venire lomar ki taam hakkatuv hu leshalosh sibbot: haechad, leheyot sheratza lehazehir shello yidme lehaummot bemaasehem, laze im lo haya makdim lomar "lo tishtachave velo taavdem" lo yaale al daat enosh lomar sheyyechavven hakkatuv lomar al maase chol sheen bo avoda zara sheasur, uvehechreach lomar sheeno omer ella al maase issur shehu avoda zara. ach achar sheamar lo tishtachave velo taavdem, baze gilla dato ki ma sheamar lo taase kemaasehem hu afillu davar sheeno nikkar sheyyesh bo avoda zara, vehu shello yidme lahem lo bemalbushehem velo betiglachtam kelal, vechan nichlal kol shehu meyuchad lemaase haggoyim kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat 67,1). vehashsheni, lehodienu ba ki chol maasehem yesh bo avoda zara, ki Adonai yodea machshevot bene adam visod kol davar, veim ken kol haose maase goyim hare ze toem meavon avoda zara. vehashshelishi, leheyot sheratza letzauot al harisatam veshivronam, laze kadam lomar lo tishtachave vegomer, lomar sheim lo haras velo shibber hare hu keoved avoda zara, ki Adonai tofes al hammachshava baavoda zara, utzerichin hekker lishlilat machshevet avoda zara millibbam, veen hekker ella beshabber matztzevotehem, veim lo yaasu chen hare hem keovde avoda zara veze lecha haot. velaze hutzrach lomar lo tishtachave velo taavdem vegomer ki hares, lomar shebbeheder hares hare hu over al lo taavdem. vetimtza shehikpid Adonai al yisrael shello asu chen bichnisatam laaretz (Shoftim 2,2).

rashi: Vayhi baalot nevuchadretztzar. al karchenu banu hair, lechach achshav anu yoshvim babbattim:
targum: Vahava kad salek nevuchadretzar malka devavel al ara vaamarna ato veneul lirushelem min kodam mashiryat kasdae umin kodam mashiryat aram vitevna birushelem:

rashi: Veshatti. leshon hashata, vehattav mudgeshet mippene shebbaa tachat shetayim, sheen shita belo tav, vehaachat leshimmush:
Ad hannahar. perat:
Vegerashtamo. utegarshem:
Im kofer yushat alav. "im" ze eno taluy, vahare hu kemo "im kesef talve" – leshon asher, ze mishpato sheyyashitu alav bet din kofer:
Venatan pidyon nafsho. deme nizzak divre Rabbi yishmael, Rabbi akiva omer deme mazzik (mechilta):
ohc: Pidyon nafsho. nechleku beferek arbaa vachamishsha (bava kamma 40,1) beshel mi shamin, im beshel mazzik im beshel nizzak. vehaya nire ki lehaomer beshel mazzik, im hemit shor shel shene bene adam – chayyavin leshallem deme kol echad mehem, ki kullan nitchayyevu lashshamayim. ulehaomer shel nizzak – enam chayyavin ella deme hannizzak. vekashe, im ken may bae sham rav nachman lerav acha bar yaakov im chayyavin latet kofer kol echad shalem, halo davar ze machloket hattannaim? ella vadday dehen emet lehaomer beshel mazzik vadday shetztzarich leshallem shene kafrim, mide dahava shehemit shor adam gadol sheshshave matayim leadam sheshshave chamishshim, shechayyav leshallem velo yiggara im yechalku lishne gufim, vechayyavim latet deme kofer shenayim. uvaya derav nachman hi allibba dachachamim shessovrin shamin beshel nizzak. vechen mashma middivre rambam sheppasak perek 11 mehilchot nizke mamon bedin deme chofer sheshshamin deme hanneherag, uveshor shene shuttafin pasak (sham perek 10) shechayyavin litten kofer shalem lechol echad, vehaven. vetaam sheppasak rambam lechumera mishshum dehavya sefek kofer nefesh.

Veim kadam goel haddam veharag et ze kodem sheyyitten pidyon nafsho, nire li shenneherag alav, shello patar hakkatuv ella harigat horeg bayyad beshogeg middin yecham levavo, aval im shoro harag en kan yecham levavo kehoreg bayyad.

rashi: Vechi yazid. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar makke ish vegomer shomea ani afillu goy, verofe shehemit usheliach bet din shehemit bemalkut arbaim, vehaav hammakke et beno veharav harode et talmido, vehashshogeg, talo vechi yazid – velo shogeg, al reehu – velo al goy, lehargo vearma – velo sheliach bet din veharofe verode veno vetalmido, sheaf al pi shehem mezidin en maarimin (mechilta):
Meim mizbechi. im haya chohen verotze laavod avoda tikkachenu lamut (yoma 85):
ohc: Vechi yazid vegomer. besifre (mechilta kan) veze leshonam: "lamut" – velo ladun, velo lilkot, velo liglot. veze hu tamo shel yoav shebbarach el hammizbeach vayyachazek vegomer, hagam shello harago shelomo ella bedin, uchemo shekkatvu hattosafot besof perek nigmar haddin (sanhedrin mat,1) shehaya mored bammalchut, hu barach kodem haddin. veamru behaggolin (makkot 12,1) ki tauto haya shello haya mizbach olamim, vegam shettefasam bekarnotav veeno kolet ella gaggo.

Veraiti larambam shekkatav beferek Adonai mehilchot rotzeach ushemirat nefesh, shehammizbeach kolet rotzeach beshogeg leinyan mita miggoel haddam, aval lo miggalut, ad kan. vehu vadday shello raa habbarayta shemmedayyek "lamut" velo liglot velo vechulei. vahagam sheyyesh lidchok beyishshuv amram "velo legalut", shehakkavvana hi lemi shennitchayyev galut shello yahargennu goel haddam, perush ze dachuk hu, vegam tachchishennu ma shellefanav "velo ladun velo lilkot", vehaven. uma meod gadla li hakkushya ledaat harav baal mishne lammelech shekkatav vetama al rambam shechillek ben shogeg lemezid afillu leinyan mita miggoel haddam, veamar ki en lechallek kelal ben shogeg lemezid, ad kan. veen devarav mechuvvarin afillu belo matnita, ki en lanu lomar sheen mizbeach kolet ella bema shemmiet hakkatuv beferush.

rashi: Reshit bikkure admatcha. af hashsheviit chayyevet bevikkurim, lechach neemar af kan bikkure admatcha. ketzad? adam nichnas letoch sadehu, roe teena shebbikkera, korech aleha gemi lesiman umakdishah, veen bikkurim ella beshivat hamminin haamurin bammikra – eretz chitta useora vegomer (bikkurim 81):

Lo tevashshel gedi. af egel vecheves bichlal gedi, sheen gedi ella leshon valad rach, mimma sheatta motze bechamma mekomot battora shekkatuv gedi vehutzrach lefaresh acharav izzim, kegon anochi ashallach gedi izzim (Bereshit 38), et gedi haizzim (sham), shene gedaye izzim (sham 27), lelammedcha shekkol makom shenneemar gedi setam af egel vecheves bemashma. uveg mekomot nichtav battora, echad leissur achila, veechad leissur hanaa, veechad leissur bishshul (mechilta, chullin 115):
ohc: Reshit bikkure vegomer. ulay sheyyirmoz shello yashchit zaro, veshettihye tippa rishona shettetze mimmennu muvet bet Adonai, al derech amram (yoma 2,1) beto zo ishto.
Vediyyek lomar bet Adonai lishlol bet ishsha zona, vehu mitzva shekkiyyem yaakov avinu alav hashshalom, dichtiv (Bereshit 49:3) "kochi vereshit oni".
