Vegamar amro lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo lirmoz sod gadol, ki hammashchitim zaram sovvim mitat hakketannim mibben shede immam, uchemo shepperash haddavar beamro befasuk (Micha 6:7) "haetten bechori pishi peri vitni chattat nafshi", ki kesheadam mashchit zaro nivra mimmennu mashchit ra vehu sholet achar kach babben hayyullad, vehem nefashot haashukot kaamur besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (chelek 1 219.), umi garam ze shello hevi bikkurav bet Adonai.

Uchefi derech happeshat, taam samach lo tevashshel vegomer im habbikkurim, lehaomer (chullin 114:) basar bechalav asur bahanaa shehu ikkar hahalacha, nitkavven lesamcho im habbikkurim leheyot shehem asurim bahanaa (282 hilchot Bikkurim perek 2), veayyen besifri peri toar:

rashi: Et ishti. hashshifcha:

Im anne teanne oto. hare ze mikra katzar, gazam velo peresh ansho, kemo lachen kol horeg kayin (Bereshit 4), gazam velo peresh ansho, af kan im anne teanne oto leshon gizzum, kelomar sofcha littol et shellecha lamma? ki im tzaok yitzak elay vegomer:
ohc: Im anne teanne oto. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar tevat "oto" velo hispik beamro "im teanne" vegomer, vehaddavar yadua shechozer el hassamuch. venire al pi ma sheamru bammechilta befasuk "lo teannun": en li ella yatom vealmana, shear kol adam minnayin? talmud lomar "lo teannun", ad kan. uchefi ze yesh azhara gam lishar kol adam millo teannun", laze amar hakkatuv oto, perush, oto shemmuzekar beferush hu sheansho neshehem almanot uvenehem yetomim, aval hammeanne kol adam en ansho kol kach.

rashi: Im zarcha hashshemesh alav. en ze ella chemin mashal: im barur lecha haddavar sheyyesh lo shalom immecha, kashshemesh hazze shehu shalom baolam, kach pashut lecha sheeno va laharog afillu yaamod baal hammamon kenegdo, kegon av hachoter lignov mamon habben, beyadua sherachame haav al habben veeno va al iske nefashot (sham):
Damim lo. kechay hu chashuv, uretzicha hi im yahargenu baal habbayit:

Shallem yeshallem. haggannav mamon shegganav veeno chayyav mita; veunkelos shettirgem im ena desahadayya nefalat alohi, lakach lo shitta acheret, lomar, sheim metzauhu edim kodem shebba baal habbayit, ucheshebba baal habbayit negdo hitru vo shello yahargehu, damim lo – chayyav alav im harago, shemmeachar sheyyesh roim lo, en haggannav hazze va al iske nefashot, velo yaharog et baal hammamon:
Ki yaver, et beiro uvier. kullam leshon behema, kemo anachnu uveirenu (Bamidbar 20):

Ki yaver. yolich behemotav besade o vecherem shel chavero, veyazzik oto veachat mishshete ellu, o veshilluach beiro o beviur, ufershu rabbotenu "veshillach" hu nizke midrach kaf regel, "uvier" hu nizke hashshen, haochelet umevaeret (bava kamma 2):
Bisde acher. besade shel ish acher:

Metav sadehu … yeshallem. shamin et hannezek, veim ba leshallem lo karka deme nizko, yeshallem lo mimmetav sedotav – im haya nizko sela, yitten lo sheve sela meiddit sheyyesh lo; limmedcha hakkatuv shehannezakin shamin lahem beiddit (mechilta, bava kamma 6):
ohc: Ki yaver ish vegomer. yitbaer al derech ma sheamru behakkones (bava kamma 56:) amar rav hammaamid behemat chavero al kamat chavero vechulei chayyav, veamru sham afillu kam lah beappah vaafillu hikkishah chayyav, vehu amro ki yaver ish perush, afillu im [en] habbeir shello. veamro veshillach et beiro perush, vaafillu lo heemid velo kam lah beappah velo hikkishah ella sheshshelachah lenafshah velo shemarah millechet vehi meatzmah biara bisde hazzulat, im habbehema shello, keamro beiro bechinnuy – chayyav metav vegomer:

rashi: Vechi yinnatzu anashim. ze im ze, venitkavven lehakkot et chavero vehikka et haishsha:
Venagfu. en negifa ella leshon dechifa vehakkaa, kemo pen tiggof baeven raglecha (Tehillim 91), beterem yitnaggefu raglechem (Yirmeyahu 13) uleeven negef (Yeshayahu 8):
Velo yihye ason. baishsha:
Anosh yeanesh. leshallem deme veladot labbaal; shamin otah kamma hayta reuya limmacher bashshuk lehaalot bedameha bishvil heryonah:
Onesh yeanesh. yigbu mamon mimmennu, kemo veanshu oto mea chesef (Devarim 22):
Kaasher yashit alav vegomer. kesheyyitbaennu habbaal bevet din lehashit alav onesh al kach:
Venatan. hammakke deme veladot:
Biflilim – al pi haddayyanim (mechilta):
ohc: Vechi yinnatzu anashim. perush, vechol echad mitkavven laharog et chavero, uvaa hammakka baishsha, baze hu sheamar kol tzidde haddinim haamurim bainyan.
Venagfu vegomer. amar leshon rabbim, lomar sheim shenehem naflu aleha unegafuha, meshalleshin benehem, uchemo shekkatav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot chovel umazzik.

Ishsha hara. perush, hammetzuya sham bidiatam, aval im baa veamda bigvulam unegafuha belo yedia – peturim mikkelum, middin shekkatav bayyerushalmi ufasko rambam beferek 1 mehilchot chovel umazzik, veze leshono: im haya echad yashen uva echad veshachav betziddo, hare ze patur hayyashen gam mehannezek, ki ze ones mikre.
Kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha. perush, letzad ki hu hannotel deme veladot, hu yihye baal dino beonesh ze lakachat mimmennu harauy lo.

rashi: Veel moshe amar. parasha zo neemra kodem aseret haddibberot, bed besivan neemra lo ale (shabbat 88):
ohc: Veel moshe vegomer. mashmaut hakketuvim yaggid ki parasha zo bimkomah neemra achar mattan tora, veen lehaarich bechitte hochachot hammeidim al haddavar, vechen raiti lerava verashbam veramban sheyyachdav hayu tammim bedaat zo.

Ella sheraiti bammechilta sevara been cholek aleha, ki beyom Adonai bachodesh shehayta hafesaka bana moshe mizbeach haamur befarashat hammishpatim, vecharat immahem habberit al kamma mehammitzvot asher kevar kibbelum alehem, lemar al sheva mitzvot ulemar al ma shennitztauu bemara, veyesh merabbotenu sheamru sham sheal mitzvot hanneemarot befarashat behar sinay ad sof im bechukkotay, umashma middevarav ki ellu kadmu kodem mattan tora vaalehem karat berit haamur, lefi shello kartu berit ad atta al shum kabbalat mitzva, uvachan otam moshe im meatzman yekayyemu alehem habberit al ma sheavar hagam shello chiyyevam Adonai alav. veulay ki dibber moshe ken letzad shermazo Adonai beamro (Shemot 19:3) "vetagged livne yisrael", vedarshu zichronam livracha (shabbat paz,1) shennitkavven lomar lo meshoch otam bedivre aggada, vegam ze mikkelal hameshachat hallev shemmeatzmam yishshavu al harishonot. gam missugeyat haggemara (shabbat pach, 1) sheamru shehikdimu yisrael naase lenishma keshebba moshe alehem veyardu shishshim ribbo malachim vekashru lahem shene ketarim vechulei, ze yaggid shekkodem mattan tora hayta parasha zo.

rashi: Maskil al davar yimtza tov. hannoten lev lehitbonen al devarav lefalles et derachav yimtza tov:
Uvoteach baAdonai ashrav. keshehu mefalles derachav veroe bah mitzva sheyyesh bah sakkana o chesron kis, uvoteach behakkadosh baruch hu veose hattov:
Ashrav. hen ashurav shello:
targum: Demistakkal bemilta yishkach tavta vedimsavar velaha tuvohi:

rashi: Vehammoti. kemo vehamamti, vetargumo veeshaggesh. vechen kol teva sheppoal shellah bechefel ot acharona, keshettehafech ledabber bilshon paalti, yesh mekomot shennotel ot hakkefula umadgish et haot venokdo bimlafum kegon vehammoti miggizrat vehamam gilgal eglato (Yeshayahu 28), vesabboti (Kohelet 2), miggizrat vesavav bet el (Shmuel 1 7:16), dalloti (Tehillim 116), miggizrat dallu vecharvu (Yeshayahu 19), al kappayim chakkotich (Yeshayahu 49:16), miggizrat chikke lev (Shoftim Adonai), et mi ratztzoti (Shmuel 1 12:3), miggizrat ritztzatz azav dallim (Iyov 20). vehametargem vehammoti veektal, toe hu, sheillu miggizrat mita haya, en hei shellah befattach velo mem shellah mudgeshet velo nekuda melafum, ella vehematti kegon vehematta et haam hazze (Bamidbar 14:15), vehattav mudgeshet lefi shettavo bimkom shete tavin, haachat nishreshet – lefi sheen mita belo tav – vehaacheret meshammeshet, kemo amarti, chatati, asiti, vechen venatatti hattav mudgeshet, shehi vaa bimkom shetayim, lefi shehaya tzarich shalosh tavin – shetayim lisod, kemo beyom tet Adonai (Yehoshua 10), mattat elohim hi (Kohelet 3), vehashshelishit leshimmush:
Oref. sheyyanusu mippanecha veyahafchu lecha arpam:
ohc: Et emati vegomer. hagam sheamar lemala (Shemot 23:23) "vehichchadtiv", kan gilla ki battechilla lo lakkol yachchid, ella ad sheyyifre yosif Adonai lahum et haam hatztzarich yisrael leartzo, vechen al ze hadderech yihyu kovshim veholchim, uchemo sheggilla levassof beamro lo agarshennu vegomer ad asher tifre vetinchal hakkol.

rashi: Shivat yamim yihye im immo. zo azhara lakkohen, sheim ba lemaher et karbano lo yemaher kodem shemona, lefi shehu mechussar zeman:

Bayyom hashshemini titteno li. yachol yehe chova levo vayyom, neemar kan shemini veneemar lehallan umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze (Vayikra 22), ma shemini haamur lehallan lehacheshir mishshemini ulehallan, af shemini haamur kan lehacheshir mishshemini ulehallan; vechen mashmao: uvayyom hashshemini atta rashshay litteno li (mechilta):
Lo tissa shema shav. ketargumo, la tekabbel shema dishkar, azhara limkabbel lashon hara veladdayyan shello yishma divre vaal din ad sheyyavo baal din chavero (sham):
Al tashet yadcha im rasha. hattoen et chavero teviat sheker, shettavtichehu lihyot lo ed chamas:
Vechag hakkatzir. hu chag shavuot:

Bikkure maasecha. shehu zeman havaat bikkurim, sheshshete hallechem habbain baatzeret hayu mattirin hechadash lammenachot ulehavi vikkurim lammikdash, shenneemar uveyom habbikkurim vegomer (Bamidbar 28):
Vechag haasif. hu chag hassukkot:
Beospecha et maasecha. shekkol yemot hachamma hattevua mityabbeshet bassadot, uvechag osfim otah el habbayit mippene haggeshamim:
ohc: Bikkure maasecha. perush, lemaet deayel beyad goy sheeno maasav, uchemo shemmiet beamro "ketzirchem" (Vayikra 23:10), kemo sheddarshu berosh hashshana (rosh hashshana 13.), shekkol shehevia shelish beyad goy lo yavi mimmenna bikkurim.

rashi: Vechi yiftach ish bor. shehaya mechusse vegillahu:
O ki yichre. lamma neemar? im al happeticha chayyav al hakkeriyya lo chol shekken? ella lehavi chore achar kore shehu chayyav (bava kamma nusach acher):
Velo yechassennu. ha im kissahu patur; uvechofer birshut harabbim dibber hakkatuv:

Shor o chamor. hu haddin lechol behema vechayya, shebbechol makom shenneemar shor o chamor anu lemedin oto shor shor mishshabbat, shenneemar lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha (Shemot 23), ma lehallan kol behema vechayya keshor – shehare neemar bemakom acher vechol behemtecha (Devarim Adonai) – af kan kol behema vechayya keshor, velo neemar shor vachamor ella shor velo adam, chamor velo chelim (bava kamma 53):
ohc: Vechi yiftach vegomer. perush, afillu bishat petichat ucheriyyat habbor, im nafal alav shor o chamor – chayyav baal habbor, vaafillu neherag betoch boro – yorshav yeshallemu, vechidita beferek kamma daarachin (arachin 7,1).

rashi: Venirgan mafrid alluf. veal yede rigguno vetaromto mafrid mimmennu allufo shel olam (Bereshit Rabba 20:2):
targum: Gavra mehappechana yegare tigre vechartana maarik rachameh:

rashi: Im chavol tachbol. kol leshon chavala eno mashkon bishat halevaa, ella shemmemashkenin et hallove keshemmaggia hazzeman veeno forea; (chavol tachbol – kefol lecha bachavala ad kamma feamim; amar hakkabba kamma atta chayyav li, vahare nafshecha ola etzli kol emesh vaemesh venotenet din umitchayyevet lefanay vaani machazirah lecha, af atta tol vehashev tol vehashev):

Ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo. kol hayyom teshivennu lo ad bo hashshemesh, uchevo hashshemesh tachazor vetittelennu ad sheyyavo boker shel machar; uvichsut yom hakkatuv medabber, sheen tzarich lah ballayla (mechilta, bava metzia 114):
ohc: Im chavol tachbol. nire ki yirmoz lehair adam hannirdam asher beyado salmat mi sheamar alav hakkatuv (Mishlei 27:10) "reacha veree avicha" vegomer, vehannefesh tityaches lesalma al derech amram bemassechet shabbat (152:) mashal lemelech shechillek bigde malchut vechulei, uchevar perashnu bo ki letzad shennefesh adam hi meoro yitbarach, shenneemar bo (tehillim 104:2) "ote or kassalma", vaytzav Adonai im mishkenah bechovo, shehem chataav, yesh lo zeman lahashivo ad bo hashshemesh, al derech amro (tehillim 90:3) "tashev enosh ad dakka", veamru zichronam livracha (Kohelet Rabba 82) ad dichduchah shel mavet, ki yesh lo zeman teshuva ad biat shimsho.

Vetaam kefel chavol tachbol, da ki chol adam miyyisrael yesh lo shalosh bechinot: nefesh, ruach, neshama, vechan ramaz hakkatuv al shelashtan. keneged hanneshama amar im chavol, ucheneged haruach amar tachbol, ucheneged hannefesh amar salmat reecha, uchenegdam amar shalosh chalukot: 1 ki hi chesuto levaddah hi hanneshama, 2 hi simlato leoro vehi haruach, 3 bamme yishkav vehi hannefesh asher immo bakkever, ucheamro (Iyov 14:22) "venafsho alav teeval".
Veamro vehaya ki yitzak, perush, chozer leinyan rishon "teshivennu lo" shehi hatteshuva, ki lo yitztarech letzaar lahashivo, ella ki yitzak yishma Adonai vegomer, veyaavor chattotav.

rashi: Kol paal Adonai lemaanehu. hakkol asa bishvil killuso, kemo "enu laAdonai betoda" (tehillim 147:7). davar acher: lehaid alav, kelomar: poolo meid alav al gevurotav. shenehem behaggadat tehillim:
Vegam rasha. asa lehannicho leyom raa, vechol ze lekilluso:
targum: Kulhon ovadin delaha leilen demishtamin leh verashia leyoma visha:

rashi: Mekor chayyim sechel. livalav vechen pitron hammikra: sechel habbealim mekor chayyim hu lo:
Umusar evilim ivvelet. yissure evilim al yede ivvelet baim lahem, vechen mashmao: haivvelet yissurin hu laevilim:
targum: Mabbua dechaye suchela demareh umarduteh deshatye shatyuta:

rashi: Veelle hammishpatim. kol makom shenneemar "elle" pasal et harishonim, "veelle" mosif al harishonim, ma harishonim missinay, af ellu missinay; velamma nismecha parashat dinin lefarashat mizbeach? lomar lecha, shettasim sanhedrin etzel hammikdash (mechilta):

Asher tasim lifnehem. amar lo hakkabba lemoshe: lo taale al datecha lomar, eshne lahem happerek vehahalacha 2 o 3 peamim, ad shettehe sedura befihem kemishnatah, veeni matriach atzmi lahavinam taame haddavar uferusho, lechach neemar asher tasim lifnehem – keshulchan hearuch umuchan leechol lifne haadam (sham):

Lifnehem. velo lifne goyim, vaafillu yadata vedin echad shehem danin oto kedine yisrael, al teviehu vearkaot shellahem, shehammevi dine yisrael lifne goyim, mechallel et hashshem umeyakker shem aza lehashebichah, shenneemar ki lo chetzurenu tzuram veoyvenu pelilim (Devarim 32) – kesheoyvenu pelilim zehu edut leilluy yiratam (tanchuma):
ohc: Veelle hammishpatim. tzarich ladaat taam amro veelle, vehinne nechleku bammechilta rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer: lomar lecha ma elyonim missinay af tachtonim missinay, rabbi akiva omer: veelle yachol shonin velo yodim, talmud lomar "veelle" vegomer, archan lifnehem keshulchan hearuch, ad kan. vehinne lerabbi yishmael shemmefaresh "veelle" shebba lomar shenneemru besinay, behechreach lefaresh shettaam shehutzrach hakkatuv lehodia ze hu lelammed al perate mitzva zo shenneemru missinay, sheim al kelaloteha, hare amar rabbi yishmael beferek batra dizvachim (115:) shekkol hammitzvot neemru kelalotehem besinay uferatehem beohel moed, ad kan, veim ken gam elle hammishpatim bichlal velo haya tzarich lomar "veelle" lelammed al davar ze. ulerabbi akiva shechalak im rabbi yishmael sham babberayta hashshenuya bizvachim ki kol hammitzvot neemru kelalotehem uferatehen besinay, eno yachol lefaresh "veelle hammishpatim" shebba lelammed shenneemru besinay ki eno tzarich lehashemienu ze, vehutzrach lefaresh beofen acher.

Vetzarich iyyun ledivre Rashi shepperesh kan kisvarat rabbi yishmael, uvefarashat behar sinay peresh kerabbi akiva sheamar, ma shemita neemru kelaloteha uferatoteha besinay af kol hattora kullah vechulei, vehem shene perushim chalukim, vehaya lo lefaresh kan "veelle hammishpatim" mosif al inyan rishon ma shetztzivva beinyan sheni, shetztzarich lasum lifnehem keshulchan hearuch, ben mishpatim tachtonim ben mishpatim shekkadmu lahem.

Uma sheraiti shekkatav harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shellimmud rabbi yishmael hu shenneemru hammishpatim bekolot uverakim, en devarav nirim velo mitkabbelim lomar ki dibber Adonai yoter measeret haddibberot. hagam shehaya rabbi yishmael omer beferush ken, haya tzarich koach ureaya lidvarav, umikkol shekken shello amar rabbi yishmael ella "ma elyonim missinay" velo amar "ma elyonim bekolot uverakim", udevarim ellu en lishmoa lahem. veim mechamat hakkushya shehikshenu, kevar yishshavnu otah yishshuv nachon shebba hakkatuv al haddikdukim, kemo shebba bedin hashshemitta sheamar hakkatuv behar sinay. uvehechreach lerabbi yishmael sheyyode bashshemitta shenneemru kelaloteha uferateha besinay kamvoar battora beferush, ella shello savar lilmod mimmenna lechol hattora kullah. veulay ki tamo mimma shebbaa hazekarat har sinay bearba mitzvot lo ratza lilmod mehem al kol hattora, vehaikkar kemo shekkatavnu. veyoter nachon lehanniach haddavar betzarich iyyun ledivre Rashi millefaresh bo ki hevin bedivre rabbi yishmael sheamar Adonai elle hammishpatim kederech sheamar aseret haddevarim.

Veim kavvanat harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi lomar shenneemru bekolot levad velo keseder aseret haddibberot, gam ze eno, ki ze yihye binyan shelishi beseder haddibbur: haechad hu seder asher dibber Adonai bo aseret haddibberot, sheni, seder shehaya ragil ledabber immo kol haarbaim yom kol mitzvot hattora, shelishi, seder dibbur elle hammishpatim, umi yatte azno lishmoa devarim ellu livnot metziut shello matzinu lo kayyotze vo battora. veod yesh lehakeshot ella shehaddevarim peshutim.

Od nire lomar ki taam amro veelle lirmoz divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 86:) ki tzarich lasum dayyanim lifne hammikdash, laze amar veelle mosif al inyan rishon shehizkir besamuch mekom shechunat hakkodesh shekkullam bemakom echad.

Asher tasim lifnehem. taam amro belashon ze, hagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu derashot (sanhedrin 7,1) tzarich ladaat peshatan shel devarim. veulay ki leheyot sheyyesh chalakim battora shehem chovat gavra ladaat et asher yaavodu, vezulat ze enam bene berit hattora, hammashal baze, im lo yada sheasur leechol terefa hare hu ochlah, vechen haddam vechelev, uvemitzvot ase – pesach matztza umaror, shevitat yamim hammekuddashim, hen elle yitchayyev ledatam, veyesh bechina acheret, kemo shettomar dine toen venitan, hilchot kiddush hachodesh, hilchot karbanot vechaddome. haemet ki chovat yediat hattora lechol ish yisrael, aval lo yigra mitztzaddik eno im yechsar yediatam kol sheyyesh beyisrael gedolim sheyyishpetu vikaddeshu veyoru mishpatim leyisrael. venitchakkem Adonai lomar kan asher tasim lifnehem lomar ki dinim ellu yitchayyevu bishmiatam kol ish yisrael, shezzulat ze en hakkone makkir bishat hakkinyan ladaat et asher yikne, vegam en hannikne yodea ki Adonai shichrero achar shesh shanim litboa hattovea, vegam hashshoftim lo yedu kol kone eved lehodio ki chayyav leshallecho. velaze amar asher tasim lifnehem, ki mishpat ze hu mehammishpatim asher tzerichin lasum lifne kullam. velaze timtza sheddibber hakkatuv bederech nocheach, ki tikne vegomer, ki yodia haddavar lechol kone.

Od yirtze lehasebir hammitzvot shettitkabbel lakkol, velaze amar asher tasim lifnehem, perush, hagam ki davar ze yesh bo chesron haratzon, shehakkone avdo yemaher leshallecho achar shesh shanim, tasim haddevarim lifnehem ki mitzva zo lizchut kol echad mehem hi, kesheyyihye eved lo yaavod bo leolam, uvaze yitratztze baddavar, ki kol echad yaarich haddavar shehu lizchuto letzad ki kol ivri hannimkar eno ella letzad dochoko, o ganav umecharuhu bet din, veze yesovvo haoni, uveoto matztzav kullam ashirim hayu, veen ze ella ledavar hammitgalgel, vechol echad yasim lefanav sheelav nogea hachesed dilma yitgalgel alav haggalgal, veze zechut hu lo.

rashi: Veger lo tone. onaat devarim, 776 belaaz, kemo vehaachalti et monayich et besaram (Yeshayahu 49):
Velo tilchatzennu. bigzelat mamon:

Ki gerim heyitem. im honito, af hu yachol lehonotcha velomar lecha, af atta miggerim bata, "mum shebbecha al tomar lachavercha"; kol leshon ger adam shello nolad beotah medina, ella ba mimmedina acheret lagur sham:
ohc: Veger lo tone vegomer ki gerim vegomer. Rashi zichrono livracha peresh: af hu yachol lehonotcha "ki gerim" vegomer, verabbi avraham [ibben ezra] peresh: zechor ki heyitem kemoto. veramban dacha shete hadderachim uferesh: ki tedu sheeshma tzaakat dallim kaasher shama tzaakatcha vegomer.

Venire lomar al pi hahakdama hayyedua, ki nishmot bene yisrael hem shoresh hakkedushsha, bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov chevel nachalato yitbarach, vechol zulatam hem chelek ra. velaze lo yakpidu bezilzul adam sheeno mehem uveonaato, letzad sheyyachshevuhu sheppachut hu mehaderagot hakkedushsha, umizze yivvaled anfe haonaa. laze kaasher tzivva alehem leval yonum velo yilchatzum, amar hattaam sheani metzavvecha leval tonehu, sheen lecha lomar shehu bechinat shoresh hara, o kevan shehu mutba bivchinat hakkelippa hare nigra meerkecha. ki attem gerim heyitem bemitzrayim, perush, al derech ma shepperashti (Bereshit 46:3) "ki legoy gadol asimcha sham" uvefasuk (Shemot 20:2) "asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim" befarashat yitro, shennishmot yisrael atzmam hayu tevuot bakkelippa, veim ken yihye ger ze keechad mikkem been hevdel, velaze lo tonehu velo tilchatzennu.

rashi: Veel hazzekenim amar. betzeto min hammachane:
Shevu lanu vaze. vehitakkevu kan im shear haam bammachane, lihyot nechonim lishpot lechol ish rivo:
Chur. benah shel miryam haya veaviv kalev ben yefunne, shenneemar vayyikkach lo chalev et efrat vatteled lo et chur (20 2), efrat zo miryam kidita besota:
Mi vaal devarim. mi sheyyesh lo din:

ohc: Veim shen avdo. taam shello kalal hakkatuv shen veayin vechillekam bishte mitzvot, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha bekiddushin (kiddushin kad:) amar rabbi sheshet: hayta eno semuya vachatatah – yotze lecherut. ulefi ze yesh baayin shene dinim shel shichrur: haechad – im kiha eno, hagam shello chatatah, kammuvan sham bekiddushin shehagam shello nechteta, kol shechisser meorah veeno yachol lehishtammesh bah – yatza lecherut. vehashsheni – shehagam shehayta kehuya, im chatatah – yatza lecherut. veim haya hakkatuv kolel otam bedin echad, hayinu lomdin baayin kedin hashshen: ma shen bittulah hu nefilatah, gam ayin bittulah hu nefilatah, aval kihuy sheeno mechasser kelal mehaayin – lo yatza lecherut.
Vaavadtem et Adonai. ulay shehu nimshach im ma shellemala (Shemot 23:24), ki kesheyyeshabber koach haavoda zara veyaharos mivtzareha, baze oved et Adonai veyashpia lo tova vivarech lachmo.

Veamro veet memecha, perush, leheyot shemmehammayim yullad hakkechishut vetoldot hacholaim velechot haraot, laze hivtiach sheyyevarech memav sheyyitzmechu tzemach haadam betachlit habberiut, kayyadua lammaskilim behavechanat hammemot, ki achare mayim chayyim yeshotet haadam lishkon sham. vehavetacha gedola hivtiach habbore baruch hu baze, velaze samach levirkat hammayim "velo tihye meshakkela" vegomer. vetze ulemad ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (berachot 59:) beme ferat.

Vahasiroti vegomer. rasham Adonai havechanat habberacha bishlosha devarim: ha – sheyyihye haadam bari lehitadden betuv Adonai, vehu amro vahasiroti vegomer, shezzulat ze kol ochel tetaev nafsham. 2 – yarbe lo banim, vehu amro lo tihye meshakkela vegomer. 3 – sheyyashlim yamav orech yamim ushenot chayyim, vehu amro et mispar yamecha vegomer. gam baze hera Adonai hafelagat habberacha, ki zulat shelosha devarim ellu en hekker labberacha, sheim hayu haochlim muatim umeshullele habberiut veshanim muatot – kol shehu sheyyitten Adonai yaspik lesippuk tzarkam, venimtza berach lachmo umemav, veen behavetacha zo davar gadol ella beemtzaut shelosha devarim ellu.

rashi: Hinni kore lachem deror. meitti, sheeni adon lachem lehatztzil, vetihyu hefker el hacherev veel haraav:
targum: Bechen kidnan amar Adonai attun la kabbeltun lememri lemikre cheru gevar laachohi ugevar lechavreh ha ana machle lechon cheru amar Adonai min charba umin mota umin kafna veetten yatchon lezia lechol malkevat ara:

rashi: Shalosh peamim vegomer. lefi shehainyan medabber bashsheviit, hutzrach lomar shello yistarsu regalim mimmekoman:
Kol zechurecha. hazzecharim shebbecha:
Im bealav immo. ben shehu beotah melacha ben shehu vimlacha acheret, haya immo bishat sheela eno tzarich lihyot immo bishat shevira umita (sham):

Im sachir hu. im hashshor eno shaul ella sachur, ba bischaro leyad hassocher hazze, velo vishela, veen kol hanaa shello, shehare ay secharo nishtammesh, veen lo mishpat shoel lehitchayyev boonasin; velo peresh ma dino, im keshomer chinnam o cheshomer sachar, lefichach nechleku vo chachme yisrael socher ketzad meshallem, rabbi meir omer keshomer chinnam, Rabbi yehuda omer keshomer sachar (bava metzia 95):
ohc: Im bealav immo vegomer. yesh lanu ladun bemishpat ze, haim nishshafta bedin ze laolam habba, kesheyyavo baal happikkadon hu adon haolam asher hifkid hannefesh beyad haadam lishmor, dichtiv (Devarim 4:9) "ushemor nafshecha meod", kesheyyavo litboa pikdono mikkol echad venimtza nignav o nishbar o nishba o met, ki chol bechinot ellu yeshnam metzuyot beovre avera. yesh mi shennafsho nignevet mimmennu bemikre lo tahor, veyesh shehu mezid baavera veevar meevre hanneshama hameyuchad keneged hammitzva sheavar aleha hu nifgam, velifamim baasot avon mehakkeretot umitot bet din gorem mita lannefesh, keamro (Bereshit 17:14) "venichreta hannefesh", velifamim yigrom lah shivya, al derech amram (zohar 10 95:) hannefashot haashukot vegomer. uvaamod baal happikkadon veyiton taana hannishmaat "ten li hannefesh kemo shennetattiha lecha", keamro (Kohelet 12:7) "veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah", vedarshu zichronam livracha (shabbat kinnev:) "tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha", haim yecholin hannifkadim lippater betaanat bealav immo? ki amru zichronam livracha (bava metzia 97.) afillu amar lo "hashekeni mayim" veshaal mimmennu cheftzo hare zo sheela bivalim, vehu haddin kol hashshomrim. vehen haadon kadam lazun ulechalkel miyyom heyot haadam, vehu hannofeach beaf haadam nishmat chayyim umitassek betzarche adam, millevad asher yaase lichlalut haolam mechaddesh bechol yom maase vereshit. laze yikkare "bealav immo" mittechilla vead sof, vahare shomre hannefashot peturim hagam shello yashivu hannefesh kemo shennittena.

Veomar lenefesh adam: al tivtechi beoshek mishpat ze, ki lishte sibbot lo yippater betaana zo. haechad, ki kan peresh beferush sheyyitchayyevu hashshomrim vechol tenay shebbishmira kayyam, ucheamram behassocher et happoalim (bava metzia tzad,1), matne baal happikkadon al shomer chinnam lihyot chayyav keshoel. vehattaam ki chol tenay shebbemamon kayyam, vehu haddin sheyyachol lehatenot hammafkid al hashshomer sheyyitchayyev hagam shehu bivalim, veen ze matne al ma shekkatuv battora bederech ze, kammuvan mehahi deamar shemuel bemassechet makkot (makkot 3,1) al menat shello teshammetennu sheviit en sheviit meshammatto, veamru zichronam livracha shehattaam hu shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam. uvammetziut shellefanenu keillu hitna beferush al haddavar mimma shekkava onashin lechol haover al happekudim, veod lo shehosif lehashebiah al haddavar.

Shenit: yesh lach ladaat ki shofte eretz lo yishpetu kol hachiyyuvim ella meat meharebe, vechol hammishpatim hashshofet kol haaretz yishpot betzedek. umi yomar ki happoshea benichse reehu vehu bivalim shello yishpetehu hashshofet, kemo shehu shofet kamma vechamma sheppeturin bedine adam vechayyavim bedine shamayim vechulei, uchemo shepperashti lemala befasuk (Shemot 21:12) "mot yumat" ki lo lechol mechuyyeve mita yetzav Adonai leshofte eretz laharog vechulei. vetimtza kayyotze baze shetztzivva Adonai ki shomer chinnam veshomer sachar veshoel peturin bahekdeshot, vaafillu pashu. vaafillu larambam shechillek lechayyev bifshia bekarkaot vaavadim, nire middevarav ki yode bahekdeshot sheppatur gam bifshia, mittaam ki ba hammiut bechol hashshomrim. umimmenna atta lamed ki lo patur umuttar hu, veadrabba ansho gadol hu shezzilzel nichse shamayim, ella shello kava Adonai mishpato ledayyane eretz vesillek dino lefanav. veyesh od leeloah millin kefi penimiyyut hattora veen kan mekoman.

rashi: Al mishanto. al buryo vechocho (mechilta):

Venikka hammakke. vechi taale al datecha sheyyehareg ze shello harag? ella limmedcha chan shechovshim oto ad shennire im yitrappe ze; vechen mashmao: keshekkam ze veholech al mishanto az nikka hammakke, aval ad shello yakum ze lo nikka hammakke (ketuvot 33):

Rak shivto. bittul melachto mechamat hacholi; im kata yado o raglo, roin bittul melachto mechamat hacholi cheillu shomer kishshuin, shehare af leachar hacholi eno rauy limlechet yad varegel, vehu chevar natan lo mechamat nizko deme yado veraglo, shenne yad tachat yad regel tachat ragel:
Verappo yerappe. ketargumo – yeshallem sechar harofe:
ohc: Rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe. perush, afilu achar shekkam vehithallech bachutz, im hu adayin batel mimmelachto veeno yachol laasotah, o sheadayin hu tzarich lerofe leshiyyure hacholi mechamat hammakka, hare ze chayyayv latet.

Veamro "rak" yitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam (hilchot chovel umazzik 2): meshaarin et harippuy vechulei, vechen hashshevet omdin vechulei, veim vechulei, vearach hacholi yoter al ma sheamaduhu eno mosif lo kelum vechulei, bamme devarim amurim kesheratza hammazzik shezzo takkana hi lo vechulei, ad kan. velaze amar "rak" vegomer, perush, lemaet ba sheyyesh zeman shello yitten shivto urefuato, vehu im kadam vekatzav vechulei, aval belo kitzba yitten ad sheyyitrappe lachalutin.

Verappo yerappe. yitbaer al derech ma shekkatav rambam (hilchot chovel umazzik 2 14): amar lo hannizzak pesok vechulei vaani arappe et atzmi – en shomin lo, vehu amro verappo yerappe velo amar yitten keamro beshivto hassemucha, shehaya lo lomar shivto urefuato yitten. veharebe derashot neemru bechefel ze.

rashi: Kol shochev im behema mot yumat. biskila, rovea kannirbaat, shekkatuv bahem demehem bam (Vayikra 20):

Vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama. biktanna hakkatuv medabber; yachol afillu hevia simanim, amarta kal vachomer, uma mechura kodem lachen yotza vesimanin – kemo shekkatuv veyatza chinnam en kasef, sheanu dorshin oto lesimane naarut – sheenah mechura eno din shello timmacher (arachin 29):

Lo tetze ketzet haavadim. kitziat avadim kenaanim sheyyotzim beshen vaayin, aval zo lo tetze beshen vaayin ella ovedet shesh, o ad hayyovel, o ad shettavi simanin, vechol hakkodem kodem lecherutah, venoten lah deme enah o deme shinnah. o eno ella lo tetze ketzet haavadim beshesh uvayyovel? talo ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya, makkish ivriyya leivri lechol yetziotav, ma ivri yotze veshesh uvayyovel, af ivriyya yotza veshesh uvayyovel, umahu lo tetze ketzet haavadim? lo tetze verashe evarim kaavadim kenaaniyyim; yachol haivri yotze verashe evarim? talo haivri o haivriyya, makkish ivri leivriyya, ma haivriyya enah yotza verashe evarim, af hu eno yotze verashe evarim (mechilta):
ohc: Vechi yimkor – hilbish haddavar bammocher velo bakkone, lomar ki zo en metziut liknotah ella meaviha, ki enah nimkeret al yede atzmah, gam en bet din mochrin otah (mechilta). veamro betosefet vav, lomar ki millevad reshut hannetuna lo lizkot bekiddusheha shehi niknet bahem, od zoche hu bah lemachrah leama.

Ish et bitto. amru zichronam livracha (sota 23.) "ish" – lehotzi ishsha shello timkor bittah. veamro tevat et titparesh al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta) haish rashshay limkor atzmo velo haishsha. vehu amro vechi yimkor ish perush, et atzmo veod bitto, veim haya omer ki yimkor ish bitto lo haya nishma ella mecher bitto velo kannizkar.

Leama. yitbaer al derech amram bemassechet kiddushin (kiddushin 4.) sheafilu habbat aylonit yesh leaviha reshut lemachrah. vehu amro leama, perush, hagam sheenah reuya lehinnase kol sheruya leama. o yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (tosefta bikkurim 4) ki hattumetum vehaanderoginos lo yimmachru lo mimkeret eved ivri velo ama haivriyya. velaze amar leama, perush, im hi berura ama velo tumetum veanderoginos:

Lo tetze ketzet haavadim. rabbotenu zichronam livracha (kiddushin 16.) pershu kitziat eved kenaani beshen veayin, ad kan. vetamam ki lo yikra hakkatuv eved setam ella lichnaani, ki yisrael en lo shem avdut setam. ufeshat hakkatuv nire li shehakkavvana hi lo tetze ketzet haavadim sheenam yotzim ad sheyyaavdu shesh shanim, veim met haav yaavdu lifne habben, ella met haadon hare zo yotza lecherut afillu lo shahata shesh.

O yechavven lomar lo tetze ketzet haavadim haamurim besamuch, shebbashshana hashsheviit yetze, ella sham kanta mekomah sheyyissaenna haadon (kiddushin yad,2), velo tetze afillu achar mea shana ella bemitat haadon o beget. velaze gamar omer im raa vegomer. vekashe, ad sheyyazkir hakkatuv yiudeha veaz yutzdak lomar "im raa asher lo yeadah". velidvarenu yavo al nachon, ki beamro lo tetze sham ramaz hayyiud, veal ze amar im raa vegomer. gam lo chash letaut sheshshalal zechuyyot asher rasham Adonai baavadim, shehem yetziat shenat sheviit ushenat hayyovel, ki mimma sheggamar omer "im raa" vegomer baze hera baetzba ki leyiude habbaal amar shekkanta mekomah. vehosif lehasir hattaut bema sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 15,12) "achicha haivri o haivriyya", hare hishva haama haivriyya laeved haivri litten et haamur baivri baivriyya.

Veen beferush ze hachechasha ledivre rabbotenu leinyan halacha, zulat beyishshuv hakkatuv reshut netuna lanu mehem lemisbar kerae beofen sheyyihye, levad mehachechashat hahalachot ki chullan missinay bau lahem. vechan baa hahalacha ki din shen veayin eno ella bichnaani velo beyisrael, vehattaam nire ki zechut yesh leeved ivri shello yetze beshen veayin, ki chayyav leshallem lo adono deme eno veshinno ushear haddevarim, veyaale beyoter, uma gam kesheyyihye haddavar achar avor shanim mishshesh shanim shel avodato, velifamim yihye haddavar bassof. laze kava Adonai sheyyittol eved ivri deme eno, ma sheen ken eved kenaani sheggufo kanuy lo, asa bo haadon minhag havvatranut hayyedua livchinat hakkedushsha, vehaddevarim attikin.

rashi: Umakke aviv veimmo. lefi shellimmedanu al hachovel bachavero shehu vetashlumin velo vemita, hutzrach lomar al hachovel beaviv shehu vemita, veeno chayyav ella vehakkaa sheyyesh bah chabbura (sanhedrin 85):
Aviv veimmo. o ze o ze:
Mot yumat. bechenek (mechilta):
Toavat melachim asot resha. davar tauv hu laddayyanin veen hagun lahem laasot resha:
targum: Merachakteh demalchin deavdin risha metul divtzidkuta takin kuresaya:

rashi: Ayin tachat ayin. simme en chavero noten lo deme eno kamma sheppachatu damav limkor bashshuk, vechen kullam; velo netilat ever mammash, kemo sheddarshu rabbotenu beferek hachovel (bava kamma daf 83):

Umekallel aviv veimmo. lamma neemar? lefi shehu omer ish ish asher yekallel et aviv (Vayikra 20), en li ella ish shekkillel et aviv, ishsha shekkillela et aviha minnayin? talo umekallel aviv veimmo setam, ben ish uven ishsha, im ken lamma neemar ish asher yekallel? lehotzi et hakkatan (mechilta):
Mot yumat. biskila; vechol makom shenneemar damav bo biskila, uvinyan av lechullam baeven yirgemu otam demehem bam (Vayikra 20), uvimkallel aviv veimmo neemar damav bo:
Yad leyad lo yinnake. miyyad leyad ba lo gemul gova libbo:
targum: Merachakteh delaha kol deram belibbeh min bishta la nidke:

rashi: Kol almana veyatom lo teannun. hu haddin lechol adam, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove, lefi shehem teshushe choach vedavar matzuy leannotam (mechilta):
Lo tehdar. lo tachalok lo chavod lezakkoto vaddin velomar dal hu azakkennu vaachabbedennu:
ohc: Vedal lo tehdar berivo. yirmoz betevat berivo al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 34) ki heani ose meriva im kono lamma zan lakkol vehu beraav uveerom, vechol hannoten peruta leani umefarneso hare ze mashbit riv ani meal hashshamayim, uvizman sheen chonen dallim taanat ani hi taana hannishmaat umehudderet, velaze yetzav Adonai shello yesovvu hiddur leriv heani im kono ella yechonnuhu kemishpat chonen dallim.

rashi: Vechi yakke ish et avdo o et amato. beeved kenaani hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella beivri? talo ki chaspo hu, ma kaspo kanuy lo olamit, af eved hakkanuy lo olamit; vahare haya vichlal makke ish vamet? ella va hakkatuv vehotzio min hakkelal, lihyot nadon bedin yom o yomayim, sheim lo met tachat yado veshaha meet leet patur (mechilta):

Bashshevet. kesheyyesh bo kede lehamit hakkatuv medabber. o afillu en bo kede lehamit? talo beyisrael veim beeven yad asher yamut bah hikkahu (Bamidbar 35), vahalo devarim kal vachomer: ma yisrael chamur en chayyav alav ella im ken hikkahu vedavar sheyyesh bo kede lehamit veal ever shehu chede lamut behakkaa zo, eved hakkal lo kol shekken (mechilta):
Nakom yinnakem. mitat sayif, vechen hu omer cherev nokemet nekam berit (Vayikra 26):
ohc: Bashshevet. katav rambam beferek 2 mehilchot rotzeach veze leshono: yerae li davka beshevet, aval besayif vesakkin o even veegrof vechayyotze, vaamaduhu lemita, afillu met leachar shana hare ze neherag alav, ad kan. vekashe li, im lo harago bedavar sheamaduhu lahariga, lamma im lo yaamod yom yitchayyev? hare afillu leadam acher sheeno avdo patur hu afillu lo yaamod yom. veulay sheal shear umedanot hu omer, shehagam sheamaduhu sheyyamut bimkom hammakka ushear umedanot. veli nire sheamro bashshevet, lomar sheim maasav mochichim ki leyassero beshevet musar hu shennatan Adonai zechut yom echad vechulei, aval im maasav mochichim shemmitkavven lehargo, kegon shettochev lo sakkin bevitno uvesimanav, shezze maggid sheeno meyassero ella memito, umet afillu achar shana chayyav alav.

rashi: Ki tetze esh. afillu meatzmah (bava kamma 22):
Umatza kotzim. karedavenash belaaz:
Veneechal gadish. shellichacha bakkotzim ad shehiggia laggadish o lakkama hamechubberet bakkarka:
O hassade. shellichacha et niro vetzarich lanir otah paam sheniyya (bava kamma 60):
Shallem yeshallem hammavir. aappi shehidlik betoch shello, vehi yatza meatzmah al yede kotzim shemmatza, chayyav leshallem, lefi shello shamar et gachalto shello tetze vetazzik:
ohc: Ki tetze esh vegomer. perush, hagam shehidlik betoch shello, kesheyyihye baesh hannidleket shiur latzet lemakom sheeno shello. veshiur tevat tetze hu shettihye reuya latzet, aval hidlik betoch shello velo haya shiur latzet lachutz veyatzta – patur, shezzo makka bide shamayim, vechidita baggemara (bava kamma 61:). veamro umatza kotzim, perush, vahagam shezzulat hakkotzim lo hayta masseget mekom kama vegadish lehaveiram, uveemtzaut hakkotzim neechal gadish vegomer, shallem yeshallem – perush, shallem haggadish o hakkama, yeshallem deme haetzim, hagam shehem adrabba hayu sibba lekilkul. vedavka shemmetzaatam, aval ba adam vehinnicham achar shehivir – hashsheni chayyav leshallem.
Hammavir. vechafal lomar habbeera, lirmoz gam el haetzim shehem hem hammavirim et haggadish vehakkama.

Od nitkavven beamro umatza, hagam shello yada hammavir shehayu sham kotzim, o afillu lo hayu sham bishat hahavara, uva adam vehinnicham bemachoz shello velo yada ki yesh haveara – hare hammavir chayyav.

Uvederech remez tirmoz hattora et asher yesovvu harshaim berisham, kede sheyyitorer haadam mittardemat shenat sichlo behabbito hafelagat haraot asher yaviu laolam, ki lo levaddam yareu ella yesovvu ra lechol haolam. vehu amro ki tetze esh, halo yadata ki tzarat haam titkanne beshem esh. vetze ulemad mishsheliach gavriel (yoma oz,1) asher shaal esh mibben habbaddim (hakkeruvim), vehu bechinat tigboret haddinim.

Veamar umatza kotzim – hem harshaim sheenam ella kotzim machivim. veamro leshon matza al derech amro (Devarim 31:21) "vehaya ki timtzena oto" vegomer, vehattaam mishshum sheharasha en lo bealim, ki haadon baruch hu hinne hu pakar bo vehesir adnuto mealav, vaAdonai histir panav mimmennu, umeatta hare hu kimtzia vechol happogea bo yaase bo retzono. vehodia hakkatuv od ki achar shennittan reshut laesh haddinim lehaveir, lo lakkotzim levad hem mavirim, ella veneechal gadish – kan ramaz el tinokot shel bet rabban sheadayin en lahem koma ella gedushim shibbolet im chavertah, ki baavonot hem hannitpasim betzarat olam. gam amru zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:4) befasuk (tehillim 8:3) "mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz", ki hayu arevim bishat kabbalat hattora, uchesheyyarshiu bene adam hinne harshut netuna laesh levaer bahem.

Veamro o hakkama, kan modia ki lifamim cherev ad tzavvar higgia, mofte haddor yesode olam nilkachim baavonam kede lehatztzil al kelalut haddor, keamro (Shir HaShirim 1:14) "eshkol hakkofer" vegomer, velahem yikkare kama al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 7:8) "zot komatech damta letamar", shehem hatztzaddikim hannimshalim letamar, keamro (tehillim 92:13) "tzaddik kattamar" vegomer. velifamim yigdal hachet velo yatztzilu hatztzaddikim levad, vechema shefucha al kol sone yisrael, vehu amro o hassade, shezze yirmoz el kelalut yisrael velo yaspiku lo tinokot velo tzaddikim lehatztzil.

Vehodia hakkatuv ki yesh yom lael ayom lavo bemishpat im hassovvim et haddavar lemitat hatztzaddikim ugeone olam lehishtallem mehem, vehu amro shallem yeshallem hammavir hem harshaim hakkotzim et kol asher hargu, veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 100,1) ki Adonai yitten koach barshaim lisbol shiur hammaggia lahem bechetam, oy larasha ra lashshamayim velabberiyyot kamma yisbol bead kilkulo. vetimtza (Bereshit Rabba 63,10) shehatztzaddikim keshehayu benehem maggiim lichlal shanim sheenam nilkadim baavon avihem, hayu semechim veomrim baruch hammakom sheppetaram meonesh ze, hare ki yaanish Adonai laggorem onesh bishvilo lazzulat, uveemet ki yecherad enosh vichabbe shalhevet yitzro hammachati oto beesh hammishpat behaaloto al levavo naharot hoonashim asher yaggiuhu al kamma nefashot ketannim ugedolim en ketz shekkullam hu haratzchan haggadol lahem beemtzaut taavato hasserucha. vehinne amru zichronam livracha (kiddushin 40,2) leolam yire adam keillu kol haolam kullo chetzyo zakkay vechulei, asa avera achat oy lo shehichria et kol haolam lechova, vedam kol haolam vedam zariyyotehem al tzavvaro veal nafsho amusim, veyisbol mar hammavet bead kol nefesh achat mehem, uvechol tzaratam lo tzar kaasher asa, vehu amro shallem yeshallem vegomer, taam kefel shallem vegomer hammavir vegomer kan ramaz hakkatuv ki lo laish harasha levad yaase Adonai mishpat hattashlumin ella gam lehammachatio, vehu yetzer hara bechina hammachatiato, ki gam lo mishpat charutz bayyom hahu yigdal hammisped alav baasot bo Adonai din, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (socha nov,1) shemmevio Adonai veshochato, velo yimmalet bevarcho levatzra vaafilu levetzer (makkot 12,1) ki mezid hu, umelech hammishpat yishpot betzedek lehishtallem mimmennu venisgav Adonai levaddo. uvekamma (bava kamma 60,1) ramzu beofen acher.

rashi: Lachacham lev yikkare navon. shellamad chachma merabbo:
Yikkare navon. sofo sheyyihye navon bidvarim, mefulpal bechachmato, veyikreu oto navon:
Umetek sefatayim yosif lekach. kesheadam matim devarav letalmid umamtik devarav bitamim, yosif lekach:
targum: Chakkim libba yitkere suchelatana udechalyan sifvateh mosif ulefana:

rashi: Beor pene melech chayyim. mi shehakkadosh baruch hu masbir lo panim, chayyim hu lo, lechach tzarich adam leyashsher darko lefanav:
Uretzono keav malkosh. mi shehu merutztze lo, retzono tov lo keav hammevi et hammatar:
targum: Binhora defartzofeh demalka chaye vetzivyoneh hech anana bivriruta:

rashi: Betoch heanan. anan ze kemin ashan hu, veasa lo hakkabba lemoshe shevil betocho (sham 4):
Vechi yiggof. yidchof; ben bekarnav, ben begufo, ben beraglo, ben shenneshacho veshinnav, kullan bichlal negifa hem, sheen negifa ella leshon makka:
Shor ish. shor shel ish:

Umachru et hashshor vegomer. beshavim hakkatuv medabber – shor shave matayim shehemit shor shave matayim – ben shehannevela shava harebe, ben shehi shava meat, keshennotel ze chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, nimtza chol echad mafsid chatzi nezek shehizzika hammita; limmedanu shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek, shemmin hashshavin atta lamed lesheenan shavin, ki din hattam leshallem chatzi nezek – lo pachot velo yoter. o yachol af besheenan shavin bidmehen keshehen chayyim amar hakkatuv yechetzu et shenehem? im amarta chen, peamim shehammazzik mistakker harebe, keshehannevela shava limmacher lenachrim harebe yoter middeme shor hammazzik, vei efshar sheyyomar hakkatuv sheyyehe hammazzik niskar; o feamim shehannizzak notel harebe yoter middeme nezek shalem – shechatzi deme shor hammazzik shavin yoter mikkol deme shor hannizzak – veim amarta chen, hare tam chamur mimmuad. al karchacha lo dibber hakkatuv ella beshavin, velimmedcha shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek, umin hashshavin tilmod lesheenan shavin, shehammishtallem chatzi nizko shamin lo et hannevela, uma sheppachatu damav bishvil hammita, notel chatzi happechat veholech. velama amar hakkatuv ballashon hazze velo amar yeshallem chetzyo? lelammed, sheen hattam meshallem ella miggufo, veim nagach umet, en nizzak notel ella hannevela, veim enah maggaat lachatzi nizko yafsid; o shor shave mane, shennagach shor shave chamesh meot zuz, eno notel ella et hashshor, shello nitchayyev hattam lechayyev et bealav leshallem min haaliyya (bava kamma 33):
ohc: Shor ish et shor reehu. amro et, yirtze sheshshenehem shavim bechayyehem keshenneerchu otam yihyu shavim, vehu amro shor ish et shor perush, hanneerach itto, aval im haya gadol hannogef en lannizzak ella chatzi nizko, vechen mevoar bedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava kamma lod,1). veim en shiur hammazzik kannizzak en lomar sheyyittol yoter mechetzyo shel chay, sheim ken lo haya hakkatuv tole bimchirat hashshor hachay ella haya lo lomar yitten lo chatzi nizko shel met veyechetzun hammet, umimma shettala bachatzi shor hachay shema minnah sheen lo ella chatzi hachay hagam sheyyaale lefachot mechatzi nezek, velo chash alay litot sheafillu yoter mimma sheshshave. veim tomar kelach lederech ze ma shettala haddavar bachatzi hachay hu afillu yihye bechetzyo yoter mechatzi nezek veamar hahashvaa bashshevarim lehecha shello haya shave sheyyittol yoter mechatzi, ze eno delichshettomar ki niggaf yittol chatzi mazzik hare lo chillakta, im ken lifamim yiggach shor shave matayim leshor shave chamishshim velichshettadun kisvara zo hare hu notel kiflayim mehezzeko, venire lemi dome din ze shennaskim alav.

rashi: Im bammachteret. keshehaya choter et habbayit:

En lo damim. en zo retzicha, hare hu chemet meikkaro; kan limmedatcha tora "im ba lehargecha, hashekem lehargo" veze lehargecha ba, shehare yodea hu sheen adam maamid atzmo veroe shennotlin mamono befanav veshotek, lefichach al menat ken ba sheim yaamod baal hammamon kenegdo yahargennu (sanhedrin amud bet):
Haolim mealechem. mippene chel paro sheyyatza mimmitzrayim, kemo shemmeforash besefer ze (yirmeya 37:5):
targum: Veyat tzidkiya melach shivta devet yehuda veyat ravrevohi emsar beyad baale devavehon uveyad devaan lemiktalhon uveyad mashiryat malka devavel deistalka minchon:

rashi: Chodesh haaviv. shehattevua mitmallet bo beibbeha. aviv leshon av, bechor verishon levashshel perot:
Velo yerau fanay rekam. keshettavou lirot panay bargalim, haviu li olot (mechilta):
ohc: Kaasher tzivviticha. lefi sheyyesh harebe pirte mitzvot shello nitparshu kan, ha shetztzarich lihyot matztza middavar habba lide chimmutz (fesachim la:), 2 shello yetze yede chovato bemaase kedera, 3 shello yihye chametz miyyom tov rishon, vechol ze meforash befarashat bo kammevoar bammechilta, laze amar kaasher tzivviticha lirmoz litnae hammitzva hannizkarim.

rashi: Birtzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto. yeratze lo sheyyihyu shelemim immo:
targum: Kad itree elaha bearchateh degavra af levaale devavoy nashlim leh:

rashi: Veasafta et tevuatah. leshon hachenasa labbayit, kemo vaasafto el toch betecha (Devarim 22):
ohc: Veshesh shanim vegomer. samach mitzva zo lema shellefaneha, lomar kede shello titamu taam gerut od, al derech amro (Vayikra 26:34) "az tirtze haaretz et shabbetoteha" vegomer:

rashi: Yesh derech. shehu yashar lifne ish:
targum: It archa demitchazya veanye vene nesha ditritza hi vesofa archata demota inun:

rashi: Veniggash moshe levaddo. el haarafel:
Makke ish vamet. kamma chetuvim neemru befarashat rotzchin, uma shebbeyadi lefaresh lamma vau chullam, afaresh:

Makke ish vamet. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam (Vayikra 24), shomea ani hakkaa velo mita, talmud lomar makke ish vamet – eno chayyav ella behakkaa shel mita; veim neemar makke ish velo neemar veish ki yakke, hayiti omer eno chayyav ad sheyyakke ish, hikka et haishsha veet hakkatan minnayin? talo ki yakke kol nefesh adam – afillu katan vaafillu ishsha; veod, illu neemar makke ish, shomea ani afillu katan shehikka veharag yehe chayyav, talo veish ki yakke, velo katan shehikka; veod ki yakke kol nefesh adam afillu nefalim bemashma, talo makke ish, eno chayyav ad sheyyakke ven kayyama harauy lihyot ish (mechilta):
ohc: Makke ish vamet. perush, en tzarich shettihye hammita bishat hahakkaa atzmah, kemo shettomar sheyyishchatennu o yisrefennu o yachnekennu shemmotzi nishmato mimmennu beyado mammash, ella afilu met achar kach bechoach hahakkaa chayyayv, ella im ken amad mechalyo, dichtiv (Shemot 21:19) "im yakum". vechiddush mashmienu ma sheen haddin ken behoreg beshogeg, sheeno chayyayv liglot ella davka im met beyado, kidtanya beferek mi sheachazo (gittin 70,1): shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim hare ze eno gole, mishshum dechayyshinan shemma haruach bilbelattu o hu pirkes vekerav mitato vechulei, ad kan. vechatvu hattosafot ki davka behoreg beshogeg anu danim din ze, divhachi talya, dichtiv "vayyappel alav vayyamot" (Bamidbar 35:23), mashma leh lealtar, af al pi shebbemezid chayyayv afilu lo met lealtar, yesh chilluk ben mita legalut, ad kan. vehem devarenu sheddiyyaknu beamro bemezid makke ish vamet velo amar horeg ish vegomer, lomar afilu harago atta umet achar kamma yamim. uveshogeg dikdek lomar inna leyado, perush, sheharago beyado mammash. vechen mashma middivre rambam beferek Adonai mehilchot rotzeach, velo chen daat haraavad sheeno mechallek, yeuyyan sham divrehem, veen devarav nirim beshum ofen baolam, veen kan mekom pilpul happoskim.

Mot yumat. taam hakkefel bedin ze uvedin makke umekallel yoldav uvignevat ish uvehakkaat avdo vechaddome. da ki mishpete Adonai hu hashshofet kol haolam lehamit leose risha, ella shebbachar latet ketzat mehem leshofte eretz lehamit harshumim betorat Adonai, litamim rabbim, mehem niglu lanu mehitbonnut hattora, vechahenna vechahenna yishpot hu haadon lemala kevoel nidda umechallel yom kippur ucheochel chelev vechaddome, hu yishlach malacho lifgoa bo. velaze amar hakkatuv mot yumat, perush oto shehu ben mavet yumat al yedchem, ki ven mavet hu hagam shello yumat mikkem. velaze amru zichronam livracha (ketuvot 30,1) hagam sheyyivtelu haddayyanim, dinam lo batel veyishpetehu hashshofet leolam. velaze bedin shor shennagach adam vehuad bivalav amar "vegam bealav yumat", ki sham en mita ella bide shamayim velo mesaro levet din, keamram zichronam livracha (mechilta) "yumat" – bide shamayim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava metzia lo,2) amru od baze davar.

rashi: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe. leachar mattan tora:
Ale elay hahara vehye sham. arbaim yom:

Et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva asher katavti lehorotam. kol shesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot bichlal aseret haddibberot hen, verabbenu seadya peresh baazharot sheyyasad lechol dibbur vedibbur mitzvot hatteluyot bo:
Vechi yefatte. medabber al libbah ad sheshshomaat lo, vechen targumo vaare yeshaddel, shiddul bilshon arammi kefittuy bilshon ivri:
Mahor yimharenna. yifsok lah mohar kemishpat ish leishto – shekkotev lah ketubba veyissaenna (mechilta):
Uvechol asher amarti alechem tishshameru. laasot kol mitzvat ase beazhara, shekkol shemira shebbattora azhara hi bimkom lav (menachot 36):

Lo tazkiru. shello yomar lo shemor li betzad aza pelonit, o taamod immi beyom aza pelonit; davar acher — uvechol asher amarti alechem tishshameru veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru, lelammedcha sheshshekula aza keneged kol hammitzvot kullan (horayot 8), vehannizhar bah keshomer et kullan:
Lo yishshama min hagoy al picha. shello taase shuttafut im goy veyishshava lecha baaza shello nimtzeta sheatta gorem sheyyizzacher al yadcha (sanhedrin 67):
ohc: Uvechol asher amarti vegomer. taam amro uvechol vegomer tishshameru velo amar vechol asher vegomer tishshameru, yechavven lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (makkot 23:) ki minyan mitzvot ase hem 248 keneged 248 evarim shel adam veshs lo taase hem keneged 365 gidav (zohar 9 170:), vehu ma sheramaz shello yomar adam akayyem kach vechach mitzvot veyaspiku lishmirati, laze amar uvechol asher vegomer perush bechol hammitzvot tihyu nishmarim uvechesron echad mehem techsar hashshemira leoto evar hamechuvvan lah.

Veshem elohim vegomer. ba lomar, keshem sheshshemirat kol hammitzvot toil lechol adam leminyan evarav veshs gidav, kemo chen yesh shemira lichlalut haadam bichfirat avoda zara, shekkol hakkofer baavoda zara kemode bechol hattora, veyachzik beshomer veose kol asher timtza yado asot, veyihyu nishmarim beemtzaut kefirat avoda zara kol evarav vegidav, hagam shello asa hammitzva hahi velo baa leyado haavera venishmar mimmenna. vedavka min hassetam, aval im mevattel lehedya ketzat mehammitzvot – lo yihye nishmar beoto evar hamechuvvan leotah mitzva shemmevattel letzad kefirato baavoda zara.

rashi: Shemama. rekanit mibbene adam, lefi sheattem meat veen bachem kede lemallovt otah:
Verabba alecha. vetirbe alecha:

Vayyiru et elohe yisrael. nistakkelu vehetzitzu venitchayyevu mita, ella shello ratza hakkabba learbev simchat hattora vehimtin lenadav vaavihu ad yom chanukkat hammishkan, velazzekenim ad vayhi haam kemitonnim, vattivar bam esh Adonai vattochal biktze hammachane (Bamidbar 11) – bakketzinim shebbammachane (tanchuma):
Kemaase livnat hassappir. hi hayta lefanav bishat hashshibud, lizkor tzaratan shel yisrael shehayu meshubadim bemaase levenim (Vayikra Rabba):
Ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar. mishshennigalu haya or vechedva lefanav:
Ucheetzem. ketargumo, leshon mare:
Latohar. leshon barur vetzalul:
Im raa beene adoneha. shello nasa chen beenav lechansah:

Asher lo yeadah. shehaya lo leyaadah ulehachnisah lo leishsha, vechesef keniyyatah hu chesef kiddusheha; vechan ramaz lecha hakkatuv shemmitzva beyiud, veramaz lecha sheenah tzericha kiddushin acherim (kiddushin 18):

Vehefdah. yitten lah makom lehippadot velatzet – sheaf hu mesayyea befidyonah; uma hu makom shennoten lah? shemmegarea mippidyonah bemispar hashshanim sheasta etzlo keillu hi sechura etzlo. ketzad? hare shekkenaah bemane veasta etzlo shete shanim, omrim lo, yodea hayita sheatida latzet lesof shesh, nimtza shekkanita avodat kol shana veshana beshishshit hammane, veasta etzlecha shete shanim, hare shelishit hammane, tol shene shelishiyyot hammane vetetze meetzlecha:
Leam nochri lo yimshol lemochrah. sheeno rashshay lemachrah leacher lo haadon velo haav (sham):
Bevigdo vah. im ba livgod bah, shello lekayyem bah mitzvat yiud, vechen aviha meachar shebbagad bah umecharah laze:
ohc: Asher lo yeadah vegomer. taam lo beAlef ukeri beVav, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 19.) sheen yiud ella lirtzonah, vedarshuha bekiddushin mittevat "yeadah", shetztzarich lirtzonah, velaze keneged ikkuv habba mimmennu amar im raa beene adoneha, ucheneged ikkuv habba mitztziddah im lo titratztze baddavar amar asher lo yeadah ki lo haya haddavar middatah, achat mehenna meakkevet. veamro vehefdah perush az hu sheyyeshnah befidyon umegaraat mippidyonah, aval zulat ze im yeadah en metziut latzet kannizkar.

Leam nachri. perush, hagam sheamarti lecha ki yachol ish limkor bitto, lo leam nachri yachol lemachrah. hagam shekkevar asa haddavar uvagad bah umecharah, en mimkaro mimkar, vehu amro lo yimshol vegomer bevigdo vegomer, ufaka zechut kone umakne.

Od yirtze al derech amram (kiddushin 19.) sheyyesh laav limkor bitto lifsulim, almana lechohen gadol vechulei, vehu amro leam nachri, perush leam nachri hu shello yimshol, aval ish nachri lah vehu meam sheeno nachri – rashshay:

rashi: Keviyya tachat keviyya. michvat esh; vead achshav dibber bechabbala sheyyesh bah pechat damim, veachshav besheen bah pechat damim ella tzaar, kegon kevao vishfud al tzipparnav, omdim kamma adam kayyotze vaze rotze littol lihyot mitztaer kach (bava kamma 83):

Petza. hi makka hammotzia dam, sheppatza et besaro, naberaveraa belaaz; hakkol lefi ma shehu – im yesh bo pechat damim, noten nezek, veim nafal lemishkav, noten shevet verippuy uvoshet vetzaar; umikra ze yater hu, uvehachovel derashuhu rabbotenu lechayyev al hatztzaar afillu vimkom nezek – sheaf al pi shennoten lo deme yado, en potrim oto min hatztzaar, lomar, hoil vekana yado yesh alav lechatchah bechol ma sheyyirtze, ella omrim, yesh lo lechatchah besam, sheeno mitztaer kol kach, veze chatachah bevarzel vetziaro:

Chabbura. hi makka shehaddam nitzrar bah veeno yotze, ella shemmaadim habbasar kenegdo, uleshon chabbura 110 belaaz, kemo venamer chavarburotav (Yirmeyahu 13), vetargumo mashkofe, leshon chavata, batedaveraa belaaz, vechen shedufot kadim (Bereshit 41), shekifan kiddum – chavutot baruach, vechen al hammashkof, al shem shehaddelet nokesh alav:
Vayyizrok. inyan hazzaa, vetargumo uzerak al madbecha lechappara al amma:
O noda. o lo haya tam, ella noda ki shor naggach hu, hayyom umittemol shilshom hare shalosh negichot:
Shallem yeshallem shor. nezek shalem:
Vehammet yihye lo. lannizzak; vealav yashlim hammazzik ad sheyyishtallem nizzak kol nizko:
ohc: Velo yishmerennu. yitbaer al derech amram beferek arbaa vachamishsha (bava kamma ma:): rabbi eliezer omer en lo shemira ella sakkin. amar rabba: may tama? deamar kera "velo yishmerennu" – shuv en lo shemira laze. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta "velo yechassennu" nammi shuv en lo vechulei ad kan. venire ki diyyuka derabba kae vekae, ki yesh hefresh ben "velo yechassennu" shehakkatuv lo shinna shiur haddibbur shehitchil lomar "ki yiftach" leshon atid, "ki yichre" vegomer "velo yechassennu" leshon atid, ma sheen ken "velo yishmerennu" shehitchil hakkatuv lomar leshon avar "o noda" vegomer vegamar omer leshon atid "velo yishmerennu", shehaya lo lomar "velo shemaro" venachon. vehatam lo chash rabba lehashiv leabbaye, velisvarat rabbi yehuda sheppotro bishmira afillu pechuta amar hakkatuv keseder ze "velo yishmerennu" lidrosh laze velo leacher, veayyen sham besof happerek.

Yeshallem shor. ulay shehagam sheamru (bava kamma 5.) muad yeshallem meidit shebbinchasav, im haya levaal hammazzik iddit yoter binchasav yachol lesalleko beshave keshoro, velo amru iddit ella leappoke pachot mizze.

rashi: Lo tihye meshakkela. im taase retzoni:
Meshakkela. mappelet nefalim o koveret et baneha keruya meshakkela:
Kore raa. belibbo choresh hara:
Veal. sefatav keesh tzaravet haraa keesh sorefet al sefatav, ad shemmotziah befiv vegomrah:
Keesh tzaravet. sorefet, kemo "venitzrevu vah kol panim" (Yechezkel 21:3):
targum: Gavra taloma chafar bishta uvesifvateh nura yahava zelike:

rashi: Lo tihye achare rabbim leraot. yesh bemikra ze midreshe chachme yisrael, aval en leshon hammikra meyushshav bahen al afnav. mikkan darshu sheen mattin lechova behacheraat dayyan echad, vesof hammikra darshu achare rabbim lehattot, sheim yesh shenayim mechayyevin yoter al hamezakkin hatte haddin al pihem lechova – uvedine nefashot hakkatuv medabber – veemtza hammikra darshu lo taane al riv – al rav, sheen cholkin al mufla shebbevet din, lefichach matchilin bedine nefashot min hatztzad – lakketannim shebbahem shoalin techilla sheyyomru et datam – ulefi divre rabbotenu kach pitron hammikra: lo tihye achare rabbim leraot. lechayyev mita bishvil dayyan echad sheyyirbu mechayyevin al hamezakkin, velo taane al harav lintot middevarav – ulefi shehu chaser yod darshu vo ken – achare rabbim lehattot, yesh rabbim sheatta note acharehem, veematay? bizman shehen shenayim hammachriin bamchayyevin yoter min hamezakkin; umimmashma shenneemar lo tihye achare rabbim leraot shomea ani aval heye immahem letova, mikkan amru dine nefashot mattin al pi echad lizchut veal pi shenayim lechova. veunkelos tirgem la titmena milleallafa ma demitbee lach (divenach) al dina, uleshon haivri lefi hattargum kach hu nidrash: lo taane al riv lintot. im yishalucha davar lammishpat lo taane lintot letzad echad ulesallek atzmecha min hariv, ella heve dan oto laamitto.
Vaani omer leyashshevo al afnav kifshuto chach pitrono: lo tihye achare rabbim leraot. im raita reshaim mattin mishpat, lo tomar, hoil verabbim hem hinni note acharehem:

Velo taane al riv lintot vegomer. veim yishalcha hanniddon al oto hammishpat, al taanennu al hariv davar hannote achare otan rabbim lehattot et hammishpat meamitto, ella emor et hammishpat kaasher hu vekolar yehe taluy betzavvar harabbim (sanhedrin 7):
ohc: Lo tihye achare rabbim vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha hirbu lidrosh befasuk ze, aval en hammikra mityashshev lefi peshuto. venire lefaresh hakkatuv lefi ma sheamra hattora "veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu" vegomer (Bamidbar 35:24-25), veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 2,1) eda shofetet veeda matztzelet, aval im patchu kullam lechova patur (sanhedrin 17,1).

Uva hakkatuv kan lehasir shene michsholin asher yikkashel bahem chacham meemtzaut din ze. haechad behaggia mishpat kaze veyire chacham echad mehashshoftim shekkol chaverav patchu lechova, vehu choshev bedato ki hu zakkay, veyitchakkem lomar: "im nomar zakkay hinne hu yetze chayyav, ki yesh sham eda shofetet veeda matztzelet, venimtzeu devaray osim hefech dati. laze etchakkem veomar chayyav, shebbaze tihye sevarati mitkayyemet sheyyetze zakkay mittaam patchu kullam vechulei, vegam ehye mekayyem hammusar levattel dati lifne daat hamerubbin sheomrim chayyav venomar chayyav immahem". laze ba hakkatuv vetzivva al ze bediyyuk leval asoto, veamar lo tihye achare rabbim leraot, perush, keshettihye sover sevara achat shebbeamrecha datecha yetze ze hanniddon chayyav bedino, uchegon shekkullam amru chayyav veatta choshev zakkay, lo titchakkem lihyot achare rabbim sheomrim chayyav, vehu amro leraot, vetomar atta kedatam chayyav hefech ma shennire lecha kede sheyyetze zakkay kedatecha, ella emor datecha kefi ma sheyyadata bemishpete hattora, veen lecha lehitchakkem al hammishpat ki Adonai hu haelohim, vehu sheamar patchu kullam lechova zakkay, lo amar Adonai sheyyizke ze ella im lecha yerae chayyav velo sheyyerae lecha zakkay, sheaz chayyav hu kemishpat haelohim.

Od yesh michshol sheni bemishpat ze beofen acher, vehu im yerae beene chacham shehu chayyav kechol haddayyanim sheamru chayyav, veroe sheim yomar chayyav hinne hu yotze zakkay hefech devarav sheomer chayyav, laze yitchakkem lomar zakkay kede sheyyutte hammishpat achare rabbim sheomrim chayyav veyetze chayyav kefi sevarato, veyesh baze gam ken kefiyyat rosh bigmar hammishpat lintot achare rabbim. laze amar velo taane al riv vegomer, perush lo taane maane al riv lintot achare rabbim, perush, shettihye kavvanatcha bemaancha kede sheyyihye kemishpat yachid verabbim, veze yaggid sheim yegalle dato kemot shehu en kan hattaya achare rabbim ella kullam bedaat achat. uveer hakkatuv taam hakepadato al haddavar veamar lehattot, perush keshettihye kavvanatcha lehattot mimma shebbedatecha beiyyun mishpat hattora shehu chayyav veatta matte lomar zakkay kede sheyyetze chayyav lintot achare rabbim veyetze chayyav, ella emor datecha hagam sheyyetze zakkay hefech datecha – Adonai zikkahu. vetaam mishpat ze letzad ki Adonai yoshev bimsibbat haddayyanim vehu yishpot befihem, uchesheyyire mishpat merumme veen bo metziut lezakkot hazzakkay yitchakkem liftoach kullan lechova vetzivva sheyyetze zakkay baze:

rashi: Vayyakom moshe vihoshua mesharto. lo yadati ma tivo shel yehoshua kan, veomer ani, shehaya hattalmid melavve larav ad mekom hagebalat techume hahar sheeno rashshay lelech mishsham vahala, umishsham vayyaal moshe levaddo el har haelohim, vihoshua nata sham oholo venitakkev sham kol arbaim yom, shekken matzinu kesheyyarad moshe vayyishma yehoshua et kol haam bereo (Shemot 32:17), lamadnu shello haya yehoshua immahem:
Baal habbor. baal hattakkala; aappi sheen habbor shello – sheasao virshut harabbim – asao hakkatuv bealav lehitchayyev alav binzakav:
Kesef yashiv livalav. yashiv lerabbot sheve chesef vaafillu subbin (sham 7):
Vehammet yihye lo. lannizzak; shamin et hannevela venotlah bedamim umeshallem lo hammazzik aleha tashlume nizko (bava kamma 10):

Chamishsha vakar vegomer. amar Rabbi yochanan ben zakkay chas hammakom al kevodan shel beriyyot – shor sheholech beraglav velo nitbazza bo haggannav lenaso al ketefo, meshallem chamishsha, se shennoshoo al ketefo, meshallem arbaa hoil venitbazza vo. amar rabbi meir bo uree kamma gadol kochah shel melacha – shor shebbittelo mimmelachto chamishsha, se shello vittelo mimmelachto arbaa (mechilta, bava kamma 79):
Tachat hashshor, tachat hasse. shenaan hakkatuv, lomar sheen middat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha noheget ella beshor vese bilvad (bava kamma 67):
ohc: Utevacho vegomer. perush leshor vase, aval tale ugedi vegadlu birshuto venishtannu beyado – eno chayyav, shekkenao beshinnuy, veshello machar o tavach. vechen muchach middivrehem (bava kamma 65.).

Hashshor. bammishna (bava kamma sav:) amru: en chayyav bearbaa vachamishsha ella davka shor vase, velo chayya vaof. vetamam, shehaya lo lomar "ki yignov ish shor utevacho o mecharo chamishsha vakar yeshallem vearba tzon tachat hasse", vedoresh achat mehem lemaet kol chutz mehem, uveyittur shel echad haya nishma hamechuvvan sheyyishtanne haddin ben hashshor lasse.

rashi: Kesem al sifte melech. al sifte chacham hayyoshev bedin:
targum: Kisma al sifvateh demalka uvedina la nidgul pumeh:

rashi: Laelohim. laaza; illu haya nakud lelohim, haya tzarich lefaresh velichtov "acherim", achshav sheamar laelohim, en tzarich lefaresh acherim, shekkol lamed uvet hameshammeshet berosh hatteva im nekuda bachataf, kegon lemelech, lemidbar, leir, tzarich lefaresh leeze melech, leeze midbar, leeze ir, vechen limlachim velirgalim tzarich lefaresh leeze, veim eno mefaresh, kol melachim bemashma, chen lelohim kol elohim bemashma – afillu kodesh, aval keshehi nekuda pattach, kemo lammelech, lammidbar, lair, noda beeze melech medabber, vechen lair noda beeze ir medabber, vechen laelohim – leotan shehuzhartem alehem bemakom acher; kayyotze vo en kamocha vaelohim, lefi shello peresh, hutzrach linnaked pattach:

Yochoram. yumat; lamma neemar yochoram vahalo chevar neemra vo mita vemakom acher vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahiv vegomer (Devarim 17)? ella lefi shello peresh al ezo avoda chayyav mita – shello tomar kol avodot bemita – ba uferesh lecha kan "zoveach" laelohim, lomar lecha, ma zevicha avoda hannaaset bifnim lashshamayim, af ani merabbe hammaktir vehamenassech shehem avodot bifnim, vechayyavim alehem lechol aza ben sheddarkah leavdah bechach, ben sheen darkah leavdah bechach. aval shear avodot, kegon hamechabbed vehamerabbetz vehamegappef vehamenashshek eno bemita:
Chamat melech. hu kemalache mavet, kishluche mitatam:
Veish chacham yechapperenna. yefayyesenna:
targum: Chemteh demalka malache demota inun vegavra chakkima nidachineh:

rashi: Im kesef talve et ammi. rabbi yishmael omer kol im veim shebbattora reshut chutz mishshelosha, veze echad mehen (mechilta):

Et ammi. ammi vegoy ammi kodem, ani veashir ani kodem, aniyyecha vaaniyye ircha aniyyecha kodmin, aniyye ircha vaaniyye ir acheret aniyye ircha kodmin; veze mashmao: im kesef talve – et ammi talvehu velo legoy, uleeze meammi? et heani, uleeze ani? leoto sheimmach. (davar acher, et ammi, shello tinhag bo bizzayon behalevaa shehu ammi:
Et heani immach. heve mistakkel beatzmecha keillu atta ani:
Lo tihye lo kenoshe. lo titbaennu bechazka. im atta yodea sheen lo, al tehi dome alav keillu hilvito ella cheillu lo hilvito, kelomar lo tachlimehu:

Neshech. ribbit, shehu chinshichat nachash shenoshech chabbura ketanna beraglo veeno margish, ufitom hu mevatbet venofeach ad kadkodo, kach ribbit eno margish veeno nikkar ad sheharibbit ola umechassero mamon harebe (tanchuma):
ohc: Im kesef. bammechilta rabbi yishmael omer: kol "im" shebbammikra reshut, chutz mizzo vechulei. vetzarich ladaat lamma yedabber Adonai bederech safek bimkom vadday. veulay ki ba hakkatuv lehodia ulehashiv gam ken laasher yishal hashshoel biroto ki yirbe chevod adam bezahav larov veotzrotav meleim hon atek lelo tzorech bo, veyomar adam: "ma henna otzrot zahav leadam lelo davar? lamma lo hispik Adonai latet lo mezonotav hatztzerichin velo yihye ze gadol miyyaakov avinu asher shaal (Bereshit 28:20) lechem leechol uveged lilbosh". hen emet ki ma sheyyechsar leadam mikkede tzarko yesh taam baddavar leyassero al avono, ma sheen ken otzrot hon lamma leish en lo tzorech bahem? laze hodia hakkatuv ki hassovev davar hu otam sheenam reuyim lekabbel chukkam letzad maasehem, ki Adonai bechasdo noten shefa hatztzarich berevach lechol ish veish de machsoro. vehaya ki yecheta adam veeno rauy lekabbel parnasato bechavod meel hakkavod, hachelek hammaggio lo yittelennu elyon, ella hare hu mitkabbetz el makom acher, vetihye parnasat hallaz im adam acher habba lo derech sham parnasato, veyitparnes bifchitut uvevizzuy kaasher gazar haggozer betzedek. veyaase Adonai bederech ze lishte middot tovot: haachat – lehishtallem adam baolam hazze poolo hara, vehashsheniyya – kede sheyyizke hannoten beemtzaut netinat tzedaka vachesed lereehu.

Veze hu amro im kesef talve et ammi, perush, im raita shehaya lecha kesef yater al ma sheatta tzarich leatzmecha sheatta malve leammi, teda lecha sheen ze chelek hammaggiacha ella chelek acherim, shehu heani, immach, uvaze ramaz ki tzarich liftoach lo mishshello. veulay ki ramaz lo gam ken shello yitnasse veyitgaddel al heani biroto ki hu hannoten lo, vehu amro lo tihye lo kenoshe, leshon nesiut umaala, ki mishshello hu noten lo. vechazar lomar keneged hahalvaa lo tesimun alav vegomer:

rashi: Et naare. habbechorot:
Vechi yishal. ba lelammed al hashshoel shehu chayyav boonasin:
Bealav en immo. im bealav shel shor eno im hashshoel bimlachto (bava metzia 95):
Ad asher tifre. tirbe, leshon peri, kemo peru urevu (Bereshit 1):
Im eved, o ama. kenaaniyyim:
Sheloshim shekalim yitten. gezerat hakkatuv hu, ben shehu shave elef zuz ben sheeno shave ella dinar. vehashshekel mishkalo arbaa zehuvim shehem chatzi unkiya lemishkal hayyashar shel kolonya:
Vayyichtov moshe. mibbereshit vead mattan tora, vechatav mitzvot shennitztauu vemara:
Vayyashkem babboker. bachamishsha besivan:
Vayyikkach moshe et chatzi haddam. mi chilleko? malach ba vechilleko (Vayikra Rabba 6):

Baagganot. shete agganot, echad lachatzi dam ola veechad lachatzi dam shelamim lehazzot otam al haam. umikkan lamdu rabbotenu shennichnesu avotenu labberit bemila utevila vehazzaat damim, sheen hazzaa belo tevila (keritut 9):
Im acheret yikkach lo. aleha:
Sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra. min haama sheyyaad lo chevar:
Sheerah. mezonot:
Kesutah. kemashmao.
Anta. tashmish (ketuvot 47):
Veger lo tilchatz. beharebe mekomot hizhira tora al hagger mippene shessuro ra (bava metzia 59):
Et nefesh hagger. kamma kashe lo keshellochatzim oto:
ohc: Veattem yedatem et nefesh vegomer. ayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Shemot 22:20) "veger lo tone", ufasuk ze yatzdik lecha kol ma shekkatavti lecha.

targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elaha deyisrael ana gezaret keyam im avahatchon beyoma deafket yathon meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta lememar:
Ushemau chol ravrevaya vechol ama dealu bikyama leshalacha gevar yat avdeh ugevar yat amteh bene chorin bedil dela yiflechun behon od vekabbilu ushelachu:
Kodam tavra gevtanuta vekadam takla ramat rucha:
Ravreve yehuda veravreve yerushelem veravrevaya vechahanaya vechol ama deara daavaru ben palge egla:
Veamsar yathon beyad baale devavehon uveyad devaan lemiktalhon utehe neveltehon meshagra lemechal leofa dishmaya velivira deara:
Shevila ditritze miste min bishta udemazhar nafsheh natar archeh:
Uvedil dela lemivne vattin lemitbena vecharmin vechaklin vezarin la yehe lana:
Vetavtun veachaltun yat shemi vaatevtun gevar yat avdeh ugevar yat amteh di fetartun bene chorin lenafshathon ucheveshtun yathon lemeheve lechon leavdin uleamhan:
Misof sheva shenin tishlechun gevar yat achuhi var yisrael deyizdavan lach veyiflechinach shit shenin vetifterineh bar chorin meimach vela kabbilu avahatchon lememri vela archinu yat udenhon:
Vetavu batar ken veativu yat avdin veyat amhata diftaru bene chorin uchevishunun leavdin uleamhan:
Vaamaru la nishte chamra are yonadav bar rechav avuna paked alana lememar la tishtun chamra attun uvenechon ad alma:
Vekabbelna lememar yonadav bar rechav avuna lechol defakedna bedil dela lemishte chamra kol yomana anachna neshana benana uvenatana:
Leshalcha gevar yat avadeh ugevar yat amteh bar yisrael uvat yisrael bene chorin bedil dela yiflechun behon gevar baachuhi yehudaa:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai im yirmeya min kodam Adonai lememar:
Pitgam nevua dahava im yirmeya min kodam Adonai beyome yehoyakim bar yoshiyahu melach shivta devet yehuda lememar:
Vetavtun attun yoma den vaavadtun yat dechashar kodamay lemikre cheru gevar lechavreh ugezartun keyam kodamay beveta deitkere shemi alohi:
Reuteh demalka sifvata detzidketa umilta ditritze rachem:
Dekane chachmeta tava leh min dahava senina udekane veyuna tav min sanya gavya:
Tav kalil betzidketa min sagia daalalta dela vedina:
Udebaret yat yaazanya var yirmeya bar chavatzinya veyat achohi veyat kol benohi veyat kol bene vet rechav:
Vihavit kodam bene bet rechav kalidin melan chamra vechasin vaamaret lehon shetu chamara:
Vitevna bemashkenin vekabbelna vaavadna kechol defakedna yonadav avuna:

bart: Sheavor. sheevror veevchar:
Borer veochel. tolesh achat achat veochel, aval im talash vetzeref shetayim chayyav:
Megarger. melakket garger garger veochel:
Poret. beod harimmon bimchubbar poret mimmennu garger garger veochel:
Uvaavattiach sofet veochel. garsinan, kelomar chotech chatichot dakkot veochel:
Metappeach. meassef et hashshemen betefach shello, kelomar mekannecho veetzbeotav:
Ellu chelim. kele gelalim. shel tzefie vakar:

Kele avanim uchele adama. dechol hane en lahem tuma lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim, ulechach matztzilin betzamid patil. veaf al gav dechol keli fatuach, bichli cheres mishtae kera, bichli shettuma kodemet lefitcho dehaynu cheli cheres shemmittamme meaviro, mikkol makom shear kelim nammi merabbinan shemmatztzilim, middichtiv vechol:

Veatzmot haddag. im asa cheli meatzmot beriyyot shebbayyam, matztzilim, lefi sheen mekabbelim tuma, keditnan lekamman beferek 17 kol shebbayyam tahor. vechol kelim meatzmot haof tehorim, dichtiv (Bamidbar lo) vechol maase izzim, perat laofot:

Kele etz hattehorim. kegon kelim gedolim habbaim bemidda shemmachazikim arbaim sea velach shehen korayim beyavesh, delo mekabbele tuma, devainan dumeya desak shemmittaltel male verekan, vechevan shehen gedolim kol kach en mittaltelim meleim, umatztzilim betzamid patil:
Mippihen. shehatztzamid patil befihen:
Mitztziddehen. im nikkevu vetziddehen vehikkifan tzamid patil:
Rabbi eliezer metamme. kasavar kafuy eno matztzil, vaafillu mercho lematta vakkarka. shenneemar tzamid patil alav, velo tzamid patil al gabbo. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Al hakkol matztzilim. kol hane kelim ditnan bematnitin, matztzilin al kol ma shebbetochan ben hayu vetochan kele shetef ben kele cheres ben begadim ben ochalim umashkim:

Chutz mikkele cheres. sheen matztzilim ella al ochalim umashkim uchele cheres shebbetochan, devarim sheen lahen tohora vammikve, velo al kele mattachot uvegadim sheyyesh lahem tohora vammikve. vetama fareshna befirkin dilel. umishna zo leachar chazara shechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
Mi sheachazo kurdeyakos. shennitbalbela dato mechamat shed hashsholet al hashshote yayin chadash:
En bidvarav haacharonim kelum. veen tzarich lachzor uleshaalo achar shennityashsheva dato, ella chotvin hagget vesomchim al devarav harishonim. umihu kol zeman sheddato mevulbelet en kotvin hagget:
Hirkin. hitta:
Bodkin oto. bidvarim acherim:
Hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. im hirkin al hagget harekanat hen:
Liktzot bitenim. laasot ketziot. yesh mefarshim leshatchan leyabbesh, veyesh mefarshim lechatchan bemiktzoot shergilim lachtoch bahem hatteenim:

Veamar lo al menat sheochal teenim. velo haya tzarich litnay ze, divlav hachi ochel bedin tora dichtiv (Devarim 23) ki tavo becherem reecha veachalta anavim vegomer, uvefoel hakkatuv medabber, hilkach lo have kemikkach veeno kovea lammaaser:
Al menat sheochal ani uveni. achilat beno have mikkach vekovea:
Uleachar hakketzia. sheggamar kevar peullato, eno ochel bedin tora, uva leechol mikkoach hattenay, vahave kemikkach:

Haochel min hattora patur. uveferek hassocher et happoalim [bava metzia daf paz] mefaresh ellu ochlim min hattora, haose vimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha, uvetalush ad shello nigmera melachto:
Meematay happerot chayyavim bammaasrot. ditchillatan eno ochel, vetzarich litten shiur lechol peri uferi meematay yaggia zemanno lihyot rauy laachila:
Mishsheyyavchilu. techillat bishshulam karuy bochal, vedugma lazo techillat yeme hanneurim beishsha karuy bochal. umefaresh baggemara mishsheyyalbin rashehem zehu hatechalat bishshulam:
Hoovashim. min mimmine haanavim haraim kemo vayyaas beushim (yeshaya 5):
Mishshehivishu. shennitbashshelu kol kach ad shehachartzannim shebbifnim nirim mibbachutz mittoch hakkelippa. veeshkol sheyyesh bo garger echad shehiggia leshiur ze have chullo chibbur lammaasrot:
Vehaog. ilan shepperotav adummim, vekorin lo belaaz 413:
Vehattutim. baaravi 806 uvelaaz 547:
Mishsheyyimmassu. mishsheyyitmaech haochel mittachat yado. veim higgia afillu pereda achat shel rimmon leshiur ze kol harimmon chayyav bammaasrot:
Mishsheyyattilu seor. mishsheyyippatchu kisor sheyyesh bo sedakim:
Mishsheyyattilu gidim. keshemmatchilim lehitbashshel nirim bahem kemin gidim adummim:
Mishsheyyaasu megura. mishsheyyibbadel haochel min hakkelippa hachitzona veyihye haochel keillu munnach bimgura dehaynu otzar:
Mishsheyyaasu kelippa. hakkelippa hattachtona hassemucha laochel, veenah naaset ella achar gemar bishshul happeri. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hammotzi poalav lassade. limlacha acheret velo lilkot perot, dehashta en ochlin min hattora:
Ochlin ufeturin. im natan lahem, demattana enah kemecher:
Veim yesh lahen alav mezonot. shekkatzatz lahen:
Ochlin achat achat vechulei. delo have keva:
Velo min hammuktze. keri shel teenim:
Megura. otzar sheogrim tevua letocho:
Mechabbed kedarko. kederech shergilim lechabbed haotzarot beet shemmefannim otan:
Lo tityached immo. ze shennatan get veamar lah mehayyom im matti, lo tityached immo, shemma yavo aleha utehe tzericha get sheni, dechayshinan shemma baal leshem kiddushin:

Ma hi veotan hayyamim. lav aresha kae beomer mehayyom im matti, dehahi vadday lechi mayet iggallay milleta dahave get mishsheat netina, vehabba aleha fatur. ella beomer lah bimsirat hagget hare ze gittech vehitgarshi vo meet sheani baolam im matti, rabbi yehuda savar samuch lammita hu dahave get umikkame hachi eshet ish hi. verabbi yose savar mikki yahev lah gitta kol shata mesafka lan dilma zo hi shaa hassemucha lammita vehave get safek, veaf al gav dechay tefe, en berera, hilkach sefeka hi vehabba aleha beasham taluy:
Veamar telu lachem teenim. baal hashshaar o vaal hachanut amar ken:
Uvaal hashshaar uvaal hachanut chayyavin. deveto shel adam tovel lo, aval lo laacherim:
Verabbi yehuda poter. mishshum deshaar vachanut adam bosh leechol betocho. vechatzer hakkovaat lammaaser hi kol sheen adam bosh leechol betochah:

Ad sheyyachazir panav. bammakom sheyyoshev umocher hu bosh leechol belo chazarat panim, aval bemakom sheeno yoshev umocher eno vosh, vekayma lan makom shehu bosh patur, makom sheeno vosh chayyav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Garine teruma. garinim shennimtzeu betoch perot shel teruma keshehakkohen ochlam:

Bizman shehakkohen machnisan. vedato alehem velo hifkiran asurim. uchegon shehen rakkin ureuyin laachila, kegon garine hattappuchim vehachavushin vehaaggasim, o shennishar bahem lachluchit shebbene adam motztzim otan, kegon garine hattemarim vechayyotze vahem. aval enam reuyim kelal, afillu hakkohen machnisan hare ellu muttarim:
Atzmot hakkadashim. baatzamot haruyin ketzat laachila mayre, kegon rashe chenafayim vehassechusin:
Hammursan. shel teruma, vehen subbin haggassin, muttar lezarim:
Subbin. shel chittin chadashot shel teruma asurim lezarim, lefi shehachadashot hen lachot veenam nitchanim hetev, venishar kemach harebe meorav bassubbin:
