Veshel yeshanot. shel chittin yeshanot shehen yeveshot venitchanot hetev, muttarot, sheen kemach meorav bahen kelal. vead sheloshim yom nikraim chadashot:
Venoheg batteruma. behotzaat hassubbin vehammursan:
Kederech shennoheg bachullin. veen kan mishshum meabbed teruma keshemmashlich ma sheeno rauy laachila:
Hamesallet. shekkolet et hassolet kede laasot pat nekiyya beyoter, velo verer missea achat shehi shishsha kabbin ella kav o kabbayim:
Lo yashlich et hashshear. shehare hu rauy laachila, venimtza meabbed et hatteruma:
Ad shello nigmera melachtan. shello higgia garnan lammaaser, kol peri uferi kefi ma shemmeforash leel:
Rabbi eliezer oser leechol mehen aray. ad sheyyafrish kol maasrotehen, ditruma tovelet:
Vachachamim mattirim. desavre en teruma tovelet ella im ken taram mittoch hakkalkala:
Kalkalat teenim shetteramah. ad shello higgia garnan lammaasrot:
Rabbi shimon mattir. afillu taram mittoch hakkalkala:
Vachachamim osrim. vahalacha kachachamim, ditruma kovaat lammaaser keshettaram mittoch hakkalkala, uleachar shettaram asur leechol aray meotah kalkala ad sheyyafrish kol hammaasrot:
Eno get. dechevan delo amar meachshav, mashma leachar shenem asar chodesh yehe get, vahare met betoch hazzeman, utzericha leyavam:
Machat o tabbaat. tame:
Shennimtzeu vinchushto shel tannur. beritzpat hakkarka shehattannur mechubbar bah:
Nirin. battannur:
Aval lo yotzin. bachalal hattannur. kegon shebbeluim boovi haritzpa shel hakkarka venirin baaviro shel tannur aval en boltin letocho:

Im ofe hu et habbatzek. im beshaa shemmadbik happat letocho nogea habbatzek bammachat o vattabbaat, nechshav kaaviro shel tannur vetimmeuhu. veim lav, tahor, detocho katav rachamana, vehay lav tocho hu. uchegon shehayu sham beluim baritzpa kodem shechibberu hattannur sham, deim hichnisu otam derech piv shel tannur, mishshennichnesu laaviro nitma hattannur:
Bevatzek habbenoni. lo shebbelilato rakka, sheyyered lematta lassedakin. velo shebbelilato kasha, sheeno nidbak:
Bitfelat hattannur. hi hattefela shel tit sheosim seviv hattannur leabboto kede sheyyachazik chummo:
Mukkaf tzamid patil. umunnach beohel hammet:
Betame. im hattannur tame:
Temeim. hammachat vehattabbaat hannimtzaim battefela shel tannur:
Uvetahor tehorim. dechevan shehattannur mukkaf tzamid patil venitztzol, gam hem nitztzolim immo, divtile legabbe tefela:
Nimtzeu vimgufat hechavit. battit shergilin laasot bo chissuy al pi hechavit:
Mitztziddeha. shel chavit:
Temeim. sheen tzidde hechavit tzerichim lattit:
Mikkeneged piha. im hammachat vehattabbaat nimshachim keneged pi hechavit:
Tehorin. uvilvad sheyyihyu vetoch hattit shel megufa velo yachnisehu laavir hechavit. veaf al pi shehem nirim mittochah, hoil veen nichnasin laavirah, tehorin:

Shokim betochah vetachtehen kiklippat hashshum. im haya ven hammachat vehattabbaat uven avir hechavit mechitztza dakka chiklippat hashshum shennimtza shehen beluim letoch hammegufa veen nichnas laavir hechavit kelal, tehorim, divtile legabbe hammegufa. aval im nichnasim letoch hechavit, temeim, sheen tzamid patil matztzil beohel hammet ella al kele cheres voochalim umashkim, devarim sheen lahem tohora vammikve, aval al kele mattachot kegon machat vetabbaat sheyyesh lahen tohora vammikve, en tzamid patil matztzil bahen, hilkach im nichnasim betoch avir hechavit, sheen betelim legabbe megufa, en nitztzolim betzamid patil. kach niret beenay perush mishna zo. verabbotay lo fershuha kach. uferusham lo yadati lehaamido mechuvvan ulechach lo chetavtiv:
Hameare. yayin o shemen shel teruma mikkad lechad, veachar sheira kol ma shebbetocho natfu mimmennu shalosh tippin, tippa achar tippa, kederech hakkelim leachar sheira kol ma shebbetochan:
Noten letochah chullin. veen tzarich lekannechah yafe kodem sheyyitten hachullin letochah:
Hirkinah. hitta otah al tziddah lechavit shehaya vah teruma achar sheira kol ma shebbetochah, umitztza hayyayin o hashshemen shehaya vah venira kanus betochah:
Hare zo teruma. velo amrinan chullin hen, hoil veira kol ma shebbetochah venatfu mimmennu shalosh tippin:

Bitrumat maaser shel demay. shehammaaser shello, venoten terumat maaser lakkohen, veim yesh beyado echad mishshemona shebbishminit hallog tzarich leholichah lakkohen, aval pachot lo. vehanne mile betame, aval betahor afillu kol shehu tzarich lechazzer bidmay, aval bevadday ben tame ben tahor ben rav ben meat tzarich lechazzer achar kohen:
Shemen serefa. shemen teruma shennitmet. veammay kare leh shemen serefa, hoil velisrefa omed:
Birshut kohen. hayenu kesheyyesh sham kohen, dener leechad ner lemea:
Madlik birshutah. keshehi sham:

Madlikin bevet hammishte. mittoch sheomdim bivgadim nekiyyim en regilin letaltel nerot shel shemen mimmekoman, shemma yetannefu et bigdehem, hilkach lekka lemechash shemma yetaltelu hanner mimmakom shehakkohen sham lemakom sheen sham kohen, aval bevet haevel shellovshin begadim tzoim chayshinan:

Bevet haevel aval lo vevet hammishte. bevet haevel mittoch shellibban nishbar venichna lo chayshinan shemma yotziu hanner lemakom sheen sham kohen, aval bevet hammishte shehen semechim umittoch simchatan regilim lehitassek uletaltel hannerot mimmakom lemakom chayshinan:
Oser kan vechan. detofes sevarat shenehen lechumra:
Haishsha shennataf chalav middaddeha. vehi temea, vechalav hannotef middaddeha have kemashke shennaga bah venaasa techilla:

Shehammashke metamme leratzon veshello leratzon. veaf al gav dechalav hannotef middaddeha shello lirtzonah haya, delo nicha lah, afillu hachi nitma hattannur. dilinyan hechsher zeraim davka vainan denicha leh, aval lo letamme:
Hayta gorafto. shehayta gorefet hattannur hattame lehotzi efro:
Vehikkah kotz veyatza mimmenna dam. vedam hammakka chashiv mashke:
Venatna etzbaah letoch piha. kederech hannichvim beetzbaam shennotnim etzbaam befihem:
Nitma. garsinan. kelomar nitma hattannur mechamat harok vehaddam:
Vehalchu alehen temeim. bene adam temeim:
Tehorim. shello nitmeu vidrisatan, kevan shello nikra alehem shem tuma vaolam:
Kush. pelech shehaishsha tova vo veyesh barzel akom berosho ushemo tzinnora, ufeamim nishka habbarzel betoch haetz vechullo mechusse vaetz:
Malmad. makkel aroch uverosho keen masmer dak, umadrichim bo happara litlameha, lechach hu karuy malmad habbakar. vehammasmer shebberosho karuy darban, kemo divre chachamim kaddarvonot (Kohelet 12):
Ulevena shebbala et hattabbaat. sheggibbel hattabbaat betit hallevena venitzrefa immah vakkivshan:
Nichnesu leohel hammet. keshehen beluim utemunim betoch hakkush o vetoch hammalmad o vetoch hallevena:
Nitmau. sheen matztzil beohel hammet vechen miyyad kele cheres ella cheli sheyyesh lo toch, vehay lo dame ella leetzem kasseora hakkaruch besiv:
Hesitan hazzav. af al pi shello naga bahen ella shehichrian:
Nitmau. shehazzav metamme vehesset. afillu hammukkaf tzamid patil mittamme vehesset, kol shekken hay:
Naga bahen kikkar shel teruma. keshehen beluin:

Tahor. hakkikkar. veaf al pi shehu shel teruma vesheni fosel bo. vaafillu habbarzel habbalua hu av hattuma lo amrinan naasa haetz hamechasse oto rishon o sheni veyihye hakkikkar shelishi venifsal, aval metammeim et hattannur veaf al pi shehen beluin, lefi shehattannur mittamme meaviro vaafillu lo naga hattuma vo, vetuma velua metammeato kidfareshna befirkin dilel:

Hazzorek. hare zo megoreshet. dichtiv (Devarim 24) venatan beyadah, vemiddelo chetiv uveyadah yittenennu, mashma venatan mikkol makom, ben bachatzerah ben begannah ben bekarpifah. vehu shettehe omedet betzad betah o betzad chatzerah:
Kaltah. keli shehannashim notnot bo matve umechatin:
Hare zo megoreshet. vaafillu hi vetoch beto, demkom chekah vekaltah kanuy lah, sheen adam makpid lo al mekom chekah velo al mekom kaltah:
Uktze teenim. shebbahem teenim mechubbarim lailan:
Hakkelisin. rambam peresh shehem min mimmine hatteenim:
Amru lo. labbari o lishchiv mera chacham:
Nichtov get leishtecha. shello tizzakek leyavam:

Amar lishnayim tenu get leishti. af al gav delo amar kitvu utenu, hare ellu yichtevu beatzman. velo yomru lesofer acher sheyyichtov, velo leedim lachtom, delav bet din shavvinhu letzauot al acherim ella edim shavvinhu, vehen hen sheluchav hen hen edav. veim amar lishlosha kitvu utenu get leishti, af al pi shehen reuyin leasot bet din, kevan divhedya amar lehu kitvu, lav bet din shavvinhu ella edim:
Amar lishlosha tenu. velo amar kitvu:
Hare ellu yomru. leedim acherim, lichtov velachtom velitten, mippene sheasaan bet din:
Mibbet haasurim. mishshemo shel rabbi akiva shehaya chavush bevet haasurim:
Numenu lashshaliach. amarnu lerabbi chanina shennaasa shaliach bahalacha zo leamrah bevet hammidrash:
Yilmedu. im enam yodim lichtov. yilmedu lichtov ad sheyyichtevuhu hen beatzman:
Bilvasim. min mimmine hatteenim haraim:
Bivnot sheva. min shel teenim levanim vetovim:

Lo yochal bivnot sheva. dichtiv (Devarim 23) ki tavo becherem reecha veachalta anavim, ma talmud lomar veachalta anavim, vechi lo yadanu sheen bakkerem ella anavim, mikkan sheim haya ose vitenim lo yochal baanavim:
Aval monea hu et atzmo. poel rashshay lihyot monea et atzmo shello leechol beshaa sheose baraot ad shemmaggia layyafot, veochel min hayyafot ma shehaya lo leechol baraot:
Ze leechol veze leechol. echol atta batteenim shelli vaani ochal beshellecha:
Ze liktzot veze liktzot. echol atta bakketziot shelli hashshetuchot leyabbesh o hachatuchot bammiktzoot vaani ochal bakketziot shellecha:
Ze leechol veze liktzot. echol atta batteenim hallachim shelli vaani ochal bakketziot shellecha, bechol ellu have mikkach vekovea lammaasrot:
Hammachalif leechol chayyav, liktzot patur. deen mikkach kovea bedavar shello nigmera melachto, hilkach ketziot hallalu shello nigmera melachtan en hammikkach kovea bahen. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Nimtza vimkom hannachat haetzim. nimtza hashsheretz bammakom shemmannichin bo esh veetzim bakkira, vehu hammakom shemmashlichin mimmennu haesh mishshefal [missefat bet] hammoked:
Min hassafa hachitzona velifnim tame. doovi chatle hakkira nechshav kelifnim ucheillu hu toch hakkira:
Vachachamim omrim. en ovi chatle hakkira nechshav ella chelachutz veeno chetochah shel kira. vahalacha kachachamim:
Mikkeneged shefitat hakkedera. mimmakom shemmatchil listom avir hakkira:
Nimtza. hashsheretz:
Mekom yeshivat habballan. bemakom sheyyoshev hamechammem et hammayim lammerchatz:

En tame ella min hassetima velifnim. missetimat hakkedera sheyyesh bo hammayim o hatztzeva o shelikat hazzetim. uvattosefta muchach deen tame ella min hassetima velifnim dekaamar hacha, hayenu keshennitla hashsheretz baavir velo naga, aval betumat magga metamme afillu min hassetima velachutz:

Beget yashan. shekkatav legaresh et ishto veachar shennichtav hagget nityached immah. bet shammay savre lo amrinan gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah, shemma yashhe et hagget shana o shenatayim ben ketiva lannetina veyihyu lah banim mimmennu betoch zeman ze, veachar kach yegarshenna bo, uchesheyyiru zeman hagget kodem leledat habben yihyu sevurim shennatan lah get mishsheat ketiva, vehave fegam sheyyomru min happenuya nolad. ufesak hahalacha, lo yegaresh adam et ishto veget yashan. veim geresh vehalach habbaal limdina acheret, tinnase vo lechattechilla:
Haya over bashshuk. am haaretz hechashud al hammaasrot:
Ochlin ufeturim. deemur lo rau pene habbayit velo hukbeu lammaaser. veaf al gav demecher kovea lammaaser, hay mattana yahev lehu, umattana enah kovaat:

Metakkenim vadday. shehannoten lo isser, desavar hu sheyyochlu bashshuk velo vae issure, vechevan dehichnisum labbayit hukbeu. vedavka shennatan lahem davar muat sherauy leachlo bashshuk, aval im natan davar merubbe, o shehaya hamekabbel adam sheen darko leechol bashshuk, o haddavar hannittan eno neechol kach kemot shehu, bechol ellu have keomer hachenisu levattechem, veasur leechol mehem aray demissetama kevar hukbeu lammaaser:
En metakkenim ella demay. venoten terumat maaser lakkohen, umaaser rishon veani notel leatzmo:

Kelal amru bammaasrot kol shehu ochel. lemiute sittis shekkorin baaravi 90, vekotza shekkorin baaravi 477, sheellu enan ochel, af al pi shehen neechalim al yede haddechak, veenam chayyavim bammaasrot:
Venishmar. lemiute hefker sheen lo bealim sheyyishmeruhu:

Vegiddulav min haaretz. lemiute kemehin ufitriyyot. vechol hanne yalfinan mikkera, dichtiv (Devarim 14) asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha vechulei. et kol tevuat, dumeya ditvua shehu ochel. zarecha, hammeyuchad lecha, perat lahefker sheen lo bealim meyuchadim. zarecha davar shezzorim oto umatzmiach, perat lichmehin ufitriyyot sheenan nizraot:
Kol shettechillato ochel vesofo ochel. kegon yerakot, shemmiyyad keshehen gedelim reuyin laachila, umeshammerin oto ad sheyyigdal veyosif ochel:
Chayyav katan vegadol. shehare reuyin laachila ben gedolim ben ketannim:
Vechol sheen techillato ochel. kegon mine ferot:
Eno chayyav ad sheyyease ochel. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz, ad sheyyigdal veyaase peri:
Nittal achad mehen. hayu shelosha venittal echad mehen, akkatti chazu ketzat lihyot shofet alehem et hakkedera vachashiv kenatutz velo kenatutz, hilkach mittammeim bemagga veen mittammein baavir:
Verabbi shimon metaher. shehaya rabbi shimon omer kol pitpute chira sheen mittammein baavir en mittammein bemagga. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Asa shenayim. asa haumman mittechillatah hakkira vishne fitputin:
Mittammeim bemagga uvaavir. dahavu lehu chishte avanim sheasaan kira, ditnan leel shehi temea:
Hayu gevohim. happitputim:
Verabbi shimon metaher. oto haodef al shalosh etzbaot ulemala, ben bemagga ben baavir. dechol pitput lemala mishshalosh etzbaot la chashiv kechira:

Hayu meshuchim min hassafa. kemin belitot asuyin beguf hakkira, umeotan belitot nimshachin happitputin shehen ragle hakkira, vehasheta nimtzaim happitputim chutz min hassafa, uma sheyyesh mehen betoch shalosh lassafa nechshav kakkira atzmah umittamme bemagga uvaavir, uvema sheyyesh mehen michutz leshalosh, beha felige rabbi meir verabbi shimon. uvechullehu halacha kerabbi meir:

Amar lo baal chovo zerok li chovi. baggemara mokminan la beomer zerok li chovi betorat gittin, dechevan deamar leh hachi hava leh lechov ze din get, veim zarak oto hallove karov lammalve veavad, zacha hallove veeno chayyav leshallem. veim karov lallove, hallove chayyav vechulei. aval im amar lo zerok li chovi vehippater, mikkevan shezzerako lo vechol inyan, patur:
Laavir haggag. lefachot mishshelosha samuch lekarkait haggag, dichlavud dame:
Mershut haggag. yatza mimmechitztzat haggag venichnas letoch mechitztzat hammakom shehi omedet bo:
O nisraf hare zo megoreshet. vehu shekkadma zerikat hagget bechatzer kodem shettehe haddeleka baavir hechatzer. sheim hayta haddeleka bechatzer techilla, meikkara lasserefa kaazel veenah megoreshet:
Hakkol mashlimin alav. vaafillu eved, vaafillu pasul leedut mechamat avera:

Ella karov shehu rauy lehaid beedut acheret. sheen alav pesul edut ella kurva. aval eved o gazlan lo. eved dilma ate leassoke leyochasin. vegazlan dilma atu lememar avad teshuva. aval karov, kulle alma yade leh dekarov hu. vahalacha keven nannas shehakkol mashlimin alav. umikkol makom en chotem alav ella ed echad pasul bilvad, vehashshear tzarich sheyyihyu chullam kesherim:
Venafal laavir hattannur tahor. kol zeman shehattarnegol chay. detuma velua hi veenah metammea:
Veim met tame. vehu shello shaha chede ikkul mishshaa shebbala ad shemmet. veshiur kede ikkul baofot, meet leet:

Happat shebbetocho sheniyya. delo chazinan lattannur keman demale tuma ucheillu naga hashsheretz bappat, ella hattannur techilla, shehashsheretz [she]hu av hattuma nafal el tocho vaasao rishon, vechazar hattannur shehu rishon vetimme et happat venaaset sheniyya:
Haiggul shel devela. regilin lehachalik panav bemashkin, vehu gemar melachto lammaaser:
Bitenim uvaanavim shel tevel. bammashkin hayyotzim mitteenim vaanavim shel tevel machalikim bahem haiggul shel devela, velo chashive kevan deazle leibbud:
Verabbi yehuda oser. demashkin chashuvin hem vaasurim mishshum tevel. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda vechullah matnitin:
Hammachalik baanavim. meshafshef haanavim al iggul shel devela:
Lo huchshar. haiggul lekabbel tuma, delo chashiv mashke ze sheyyotze min haanavim. uvemashke haomed letzachtzeach pelige [vah] tanna kamma verabbi yehuda i chashiv mashke i lo:
Mishsheyyadush. meyabbeshim hatteenim veachar kach dashim otam bemaklot letoch hechavit, o meaggelin otam bayyadayim letoch haotzar. vedishat hechavit veiggul hammegura hu gemar melachtan:

Lo yochal mehen aray. deka savar lo elyon tzarich lattachton velo tachton tzarich laelyon uchevar nigmera melachtan. verabbi yose savar adayin tzerichin ze laze velo nigmera melachtan. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Magga teme met. adam shennaga bitme met venaasa rishon, ditme met have av hattuma veose hannogea bo rishon, umashkin shebbetoch piv metammein et hattannur keshennichnesu laaviro. veaf al gav dehu atzmo eno metammeo deen keli mekabbel tuma ella meav hattuma, hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani, keditnan bemassechet para, derabbanan gazru al hammashkim sheyyihyu metammeim kelim, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava chidamrinan bemassechet shabbat. voochalim denakat hacha, kedi nasva, shehare en ochel metamme cheli, ella mashkim bilvad metammeim kelim. ukefitzat piv enah matztzelet, deen tzamid patil matztzil al hattuma shebbetocho milletamme acherim keditnan leel, uvar min den ha tanya vattosefta dechelim hakkol matztzilim miyyad kele cheres afillu chele gelalim uchele adama chutz min haadam. hilkach, tahor shehayu ochalim umashkim letoch piv vehichnis rosho laavir hattannur shehu tame, nitmeu, deen haadam matztzil betzamid patil miyyad keli cheres:
Beyadayim mesoavot. yadayim shehem sheniyyot lattuma ufoslot et hatteruma:
Hichnis yado letoch piv. littol et hatztzeror shebbefiv, o kol midi:
Rabbi meir metamme. haddevela. lefi shehayyadayim mesoavot timmeu et harok lihyot techilla mippene shehu mashke, veharok timme et haddevela, derishon ose sheni vechullin:
Verabbi yehuda metaher. savar kol zeman shello yatza harok min happe la chashiv mashke.
Verabbi yose metamme. keshehafach haddevela mitztzad ze letzad ze vetoch piv, shenneekar harok. umetaher belo hafach, shekkol zeman shello neekar lo nechshav mashke. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Gufo shel get. ikkar ketav hagget, kach yichtevu bo:

Veden di yeheve lichi minnay. shetztzarich lehochiach betocho sheal yede sefer ze hu megarshah. vei lo katav beh hachi, atu lememar divdibbur bealma gershah ushetar reaya vealma. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sereda. kemin areva ketanna shehannachtom mishtammesh lalush bah, veen lah bet kibbul. verambam omer shehu luach shel cheres nekuva asuya cheen sevacha. maase reshet, metargeminan ovad seradta:
Gappayim. oganim veaznayim:
Sheen matztzilim miyyad keli cheres. millittamme vaavir keli cheres,
Ella chelim. vezo hoil veen lah aznayim enah chashuva cheli:
Nechushto shel tannur. karkaito vetachtito. vedome lo vichezkel yaan hishshafech nechushtech:

Hechavit vehammashkin tehorim. delo nichnesu laaviro, deha lematta minnechushto kayme. vaafillu mechubbar avir hattannur baavir hechavit vaafillu hechavit petucha venichnas meavir hattannur befiha, lo nitma hayyayin bechach, sheen avir keli cheres metamme lo lemala velo lematta ella vetocho:

Hayta chefuya. hechavit al piha unetuna al piv shel tannur sheyyesh bo sheretz, veyesh beshule hechavit lachluchit yayin sheyyesh bah tofeach al menat lehatepiach, lo nitmet otah hallachluchit mippene avir hattannur shennichnas letoch hechavit, kevan shello hayta lachluchit hayyayin betoch hattannur:
Hammaavir teenim. derech chatzero, leholicham lemakom sheosim hakketziot:

Ochlin ufeturin. dechatzer enah kovaat bedavar shello nigmera melachto, aval hu asur leechol ella bemakom sheosim hakketziot, mishshum devimkomo nikkar shello nigmera melachto, veshello vimkomo eno nikkar. uvanav muttarin afillu bemakom sheen osin bo hakketziot, sheen taluy vahem limmalech, vechevan sheddaat avihen laasot mehen ketziot muttarin, aval hu shebbeyado limmalech eno muttar ella bammakom sheosim hakketziot:
Aval im yesh lahem alav mezonot. shekkatzatz lahen, deenan ochlin min hattora, kevan sheeno gemar melacha delo secharan ella lehaaviran ad makom sheosim hakketziot:
Hare ellu lo yochelu. dahave mikkach, ulegabbe lokeach chashive kenigmera melachtan, shehallokeach enav bemikcho:
Mishsheyyinnakdu. mishsheyyihye vahem nekudot shechorot. ki vigmar bishshulam hem matchilim lehashechir:
Vechol hashshechorim. kegon inve hadas veinve sene:
Agasim. baaravi 64, uvelaaz 591:
Kerustomelin. tappuchim ketannim haddomim laafatzim shekkorin milin:
Parishin. 536 belaaz, uvaaravi 373:
Uzradin. baaravi 287, uvelaaz 568:
Mishsheyyakrichu. perot hallalu bekatnan mechussim searot dakkot kemin notza, uchesheyyatchilu lehitbashshel nikrachim meat meat, uvigmar bishshulam nofel hakkol:

Hattiltan mishsheyyetzammeach. mishshehaya nigmar bevishshulo ad sheim hayu zorim oto haya tzomeach. vesiman leda matay higgia leshiur ze, noten oto letoch hammayim, vechol pereda sheshshokaat rubbah bammayim beyadua sheim yizreenna tatzmiach. vedarshinan la middichtiv (Devarim 14) asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha, davar shehu nizra umatzmiach:
Mishsheyyachnisu shelish. shennitgaddelu shelish mimma sheatidin lehitgaddel. i nammi keshebba leatzran ulesachatan motzi mehen achshav shelish mimma shemmotzi keshennitbashshelu yafe:
Hayta mufreshet. shello bana haumman mittechilla hechatzer vehakkira mechubbarim yachad, ella zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah:
Chalaka. belo vet kibbul kelal. vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane:

Pitpute chira. ragle hakkira, shehem shelosha raglayim vehem gevohim shalosh etzbaot, nechshavim kechira umittammeim bemagga uvaavir kakkira atzmah, vechol shekken im hen pechutim mishshalosh etzbaot shehem niddonim kechira:
Vaafillu hen arbaa. raglayim, niddonim kechira:

Hamegaresh. rabbi eliezer mattir. taama derabbi eliezer, dichtiv (Vayikra 21) veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu, afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah, deamar lah hare at megoreshet mimmenni vei at mutteret lechol adam, pesula lakkehunna. alma get hu, vehacha desharyah lechol adam chutz mizze, mutteret laacherim:

Vachachamim osrin. deamre issur kehunna shane, sheribba bahem hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot, veaf al gav dahava get lefaslah lichhunna, lo have get lehattirah laacherim. vahalacha kachachamim. velo asre rabbanan ella chesheamar hare at mutteret lechol adam ella lifloni, o chutz mippeloni. aval i amar lah hare ze gittech al menat shello tinnasi lifloni, modu rabbanan dahave get, shehare hittirah lechol adam bimsirat hagget ella shehitna immah shello tinnase leoto feloni, vahava chishar tenay vealma. veasre rabbanan lammegaresh lomar hare ze gittech al menat shettinnasi lifloni, shello yomru neshotehen notnim ze laze bemattana. vechol tenay shemmatne adam bagget kodem ketivat hagget, af al pi shello nichtav hattenay vetocho, hagget pasul. ella achar shennetano leyadah matne ma shehu rotze lehatenot:

Hare zo megoreshet vetitten. megoreshet meachshav mishsheat kabbalat hagget, vechayyevet litten ma shehitna immah. veim avad hagget o nikra kodem shettitten, enah tzericha get acher, dechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav:

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel maase vetzayyedan. baggemara mefaresh dachasure michassera vehachi katane, im amar lah al menat shettitteni li itzteliti veavda itztelito, davka kaamar lah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer titten lo et dameha, shello nitkavven habbaal ella leharevacha dideh, umaase nammi betzayyedan beechad sheamar leishto vechulei‏ veamru chachamim titten lo et dameha. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Bor sheyyesh bo vet shefita. hachofer bakkarka vetach betit vehattiach yachol laamod meelav, kegon tannuro shel ben dinay ditnan leel beferek tannur techillato arbaa. veit degarse kur bechaf, vehu keli shemmattichin bo hazzahav vehakkesef vehammattachot, leshon kur habbarzel. veli nire shehu tannur shel nappachim:
Purena. tannur gadol shel cheres ufitcho vetziddo cheen shellanu. vetahor, mishshum dimshammesh im hakkarka, kidkatane vattosefta:
Lizbez. safa ava:
Istegiyyot. nekavim keen otan sheosim letannurim:

Sefayot. safa dakka. vahalacha ketanna kamma. verabbotay pershu, delizbez veistegiyyot usefayot hakkol echad, velo felige ella shekkol echad haya shone chefi hallashon sheshshama merabbo, shechayyav adam lomar kilshon rabbo:
Ad sheyyeasser. demikkach tovel:
Veim tzeraf. shellakach baal hagginna shetayim keachat venatan lo, chayyav. aval bizman shehakkone likket veachal, mode rabbi meir deochel achat achat:

Amar rabbi yehuda maase veginnat veradin vechulei. vehatam baal hagginna haya melakket, shello hayu mannichim likkanes sham adam mippene havveradim, veaf al pi chen lo hufrash mimmenna teruma umaaser meolam. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shennikkav meeno. ayin shel tannur, hu hannekev sheosim bo chede sheyyetze mimmennu heashan. umerchu eno vetit usetamuhu venikkav achar kach bimkom hammeruach:
Nichnas veyotze dolek. shehannekev rachav vehakkush nichnas veyotze berevach:
Nikkav mitztziddo. shel ayin:
Vechen haya omer bimgufat hechavit. vechen haya rabbi shimon omer bechol hane, dedinam min haemtza nichnas umin hatztzad eno nichnas. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Melo mitza sheniyya shel shifon. melo kesher sheni shel kane shel shifon, shehashsheni dak min harishon veave yoter min hashshelishi, shehakkane av millematta umitdakdek veole. shifon, 77 belaaz:
Lishar mashkin. kegon shemen devash vechalav:
Afillu chol shehen temeim. afillu nikkav kol shehen en matztzilin betzamid patil utemeim:
Shello naasu vide adam. shello nikkevu vemitkavven ella mealehen:
Nikkevu, heasuy loochalim shiuran bezetim. hasheta mayre beshennifchat hakkeli atzmo venikkav. vechol hanach shiurim dilel keshennifchata setima shebbefitcho:

Shiuran bezetim. im nifchat bemotzi zayit bae meruach, uvefachot mikkan lo vae meruach. uvaggemara vemassechet shabbat [daf tzav] mochiach dichli gadol shennikkav bemotzi rimmon, ucheli katan shennifchat berubbo, en meruach usetima moilin bo, veshuv eno matztzil betzamid patil kevan devatal mittorat keli. veim mercho, naase choochalim sheggibbelan betit, sheen hattit matztzilan:
Shiuran bemashkin. bechones mashke:
Heasuy lechach ulechach. lemashkin uleochalin:
Mattilin oto lechumro. veim nikkav bechones mashke eno matztzil betzamid patil ad sheyyumrach:
Hayta shelema. hakkavveret:
Hattannur tahor. dichtiv (Vayikra 11) asher yippol mehem el tocho, velo el toch tocho. uvefiha lemala min hattannur ayre, dei chullah meshukkaat battannur, kechad toch dame:
Ochalin shebbetochah tehorin. dichtiv (sham) kol asher betocho yitma, velo shebbetoch tocho:
Nikkevu. nekev hametaher otan mide tumatan, shuv en torat keli alehen veenan chotztzim ben hattannur uven ma shebbetochan. vechamma hu nekev hametaher otan mittumatan,
Heasuy loochalim. shiuro chemotzi zetim:
Heasuy lechach ulechach. leochalim ulemashkim:
Mattilin oto lechumro. veim nikkav keshiur shel mashkin shehu fachut mishshiur heasuy loochalim, shuv eno matztzil mippene hattuma:
Bechones mashke. keshemmesimin hakkeli mitztzad hannekev al hammayim nichnasim hammayim derech hannekev betoch hakkeli. vehu gadol mimmotzi mashke:

Shene gittin shekketavan. bishne dappin ze betzad ze, ushene ivrim chatumim mittachat hagget harishon letachat hashsheni, shem haed tachat harishon veshem aviv tachat hashsheni. vechen ed sheni tachtav, vechazru vechatmu tachtehem shene yisraelim haddarim beeretz yavan, vechatmu bichtav yevani, vederech hakketav yevani sheholech min hassemol el hayyamin, nimtza shem haed tachat hagget sheni, veshem aviv tachat harishon:

Et shehaedim harishonim nikraim immo kasher. im haivrim chatumim lemala, shedderech ketav ivri sheholech min hayyamin el hassemol, venimtza shem haed tachat hagget hayemani, veshem aviv tachat hagget hassemali, hayemani kasher. veim hayyevanim chatumim lemala, hassemali kasher. sheshshemot haedim tachat hassemali hem. vetama, dechayshinan shemma haedim haacharonim hafchu et ketavam lasseder shekkatvu haedim harishonim, sheim haivrim hayu chatumim lemala shehem holchim min hayemani el hassemali vechatmu al hagget hayemani, keshebbau shene hayyevanim lachtom tachtehem halchu gam hem min hayemani el hassemali keseder ketivat haivrim, venimtza shearbatam chatmu al hagget hayemani. vechen im hayyevanim chatumim lemala, shemma hafchu haivrim shebbau acharehem seder ketav ivri, vehalchu min hassemali el hayemani venimtzeu arbatam chatumim al hassemali:

Hachi garsinan ed echad ivri veed echad yevani, veed echad ivri veed echad yevani baim mittachat ze letachat ze shenehem pesulin. vetama, dechayshinan shemma haed ivri harishon chatam al hagget hayemani harishon kefi seder ketav ivri, vehaed hayyevani hashsheni chatam al hagget hassemali hashsheni kefi seder ketav yevani shemmatchilin min hassemol, vehaed hashshelishi haivri hafach ketav haivri vehitchil gam hu mehassemol kemo hayyevani shellefanav, venimtza gam hu chatum al hagget hassemali, vehaed hayyevani haacharon chatum kedarko min hassemol el hayyamin vegam hu chatum al hassemali, venimtzeu shelosha edim chatumim al hassemali, veechad bilvad chatum al hayemani. o behefech shehaed hashsheni hayyevani hafach ketavo leseder ketav ivri vehitchil min hayyamin el hassemol kemo shechatam haed ivri harishon, vehaed ivri hashshelishi chatam kedarko min hayyamin, venimtzeu shelashtan chatumim al hagget hayemani harishon, vehaed hayyevani haacharon levaddo chatam kedarko al hagget hassemali. umishshum delo yadinan behe minnayhu chatimu telata uvehe minnayhu lo chatim ella chad, shenehem pesulin:
Almana lechohen gadol. kevan dekiddushin tofsim bechayyave lavin ulehay lo tafse mishshum issur ishut shebbah, ishtakkach deshiyyer begitta:
Kira shennechleka learkah tehora. kira mekom shefitat shete kederot. ucheshennechleka learkah batlu shete shefitot, veim nechleka lerachbah, shete shefitot kayyamot zo levaddah vezo levaddah:
Kuppach. mekom shefitat kedera achat. uven shennisdak learko ben shennisdak lerachbo batal mekom hashshefita:
Chatzar hakkira. keen machavat gedola shel cheres vehakkira yoshevet baemtza mechubberet lechatzer:

Shalosh etzbaot. shekkatle hechatzer gevohim shalosh etzbaot. keshem sheshshiur kira techillatah shalosh, keditnan leel beferek hattannur, kach shiur chatzar hakkira gavho en pachut mishshalosh, ufachut mishshalosh en avir shellah chashuv. umihu mittammea vemagga midderabbanan. i nammi, mishshum dahave kemo yad lakkira, veyad yesh lo magga veen lo avir:
Ketzad meshaarin otah. mishshum dechira gevoha mechatzer harebe utzerichim anu leshaer ma nechshav avir hechatzer:

Noten et hashshappud. rosho echad al kotel hechatzer hannamuch verosho acher al kotel hakkira haggavoah, vechol shellematta min hashshappud im nitla sham sheretz af al pi shehu lemala mikkatle hechatzer keillu nitla lematta, dechol ze nechshav avir hechatzer:
Lo nitmet hakkira. dechatzer tefela lakkira, veen kira tefela lechatzer. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:
Katav sofer get laish. legaresh bo ishto:
Veshover laishsha. shettimsor levalah kesheyyifra lah ketubbatah:
Vetaa. hassofer, keshemmasar lahen hashshetarot:

Venatan get laishsha veshover laish. vehem masru ze laze. vehalcha zo venisset kassevura shezze get shemmasar lah balah veze savur shemmasra lo ishto shover. verambam garis venatan get laish veshover laishsha. uferesh venatan, shechashav shennatan get laish veshover laishsha, aval hu lo asa ella bahefech. vedachuk hu:
Im lealtar. kol zeman shello nisset yatza get mittachat yad habbaal:
Eno get. utzericha get acher:
Veim leachar shennisset. hare ze get:
Lo chol hemennu. en hakkol kidvarav shel ze harishon lehaamino:
Leabbed zechuto shel sheni. shennesaah. deamrinan kenuneya hi venehem vehechlifu hashshetarot leachar shennisset. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Katav bichtav yado veen alav edim. lerabbi meir deamar ede chatima charte, ketav yado kemea edim dame. ulerabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karte, hoil uchetav yado hu, vechatav venatan karinan beh, veaf al gav delekka ede mesira kasher middeorayta, vachachamim pesaluhu dilma ate leachshore bichtav sofer:
Veen bo zeman. dizman takkanta derabbanan hu, i mishshum perot, i mishshum shemma yechappe al bat achoto, kidamrinan beferek sheni:

Veen bo ella ed echad. ikka leman deamar akketav yado kae, veresha ashmeinan daafillu en bo ed, havvalad kasher, vehacha ashmeinan daafillu yesh bo ed echad lechattechilla lo. veikka leman deamar akketav sofer kae, vaafillu hachi havvalad kasher, desofer hava leh bimkom ed sheni:
Tikkun haolam. shemma yamutu ede mesira veyavo habbaal viarer lomar lo gerashtiha. vahalacha kerabbi elazar:
Ze gittech im matti. lo amar kelum. demashma lichsheamut, veen get leachar mita:
Mecholi ze. mashma mecholi ze vaelach, vechevan shemmet mittoch hacholi nimtza sheen hagget chal ella leachar mita:

Mehayyom uleachar mita get veeno get. mesafka lan i tenaa have mehayyom im amut, vechevan shemmet nitkayyem hattenay venimtza shehu get mishsheat netinato. i chazara have shechazar bo mimmay deamar mehayyom, veamar leachar mita yehe get, veeno kelum kevan delo amar mehayyom im matti:
Choletzet. shemma eno get:
Velo mityabbemet. shemma get hu vehaveya la gerushat achiv vekayma aleh beissur karet:
O shemmetzaato meachorav. shehaya hagget al gabbo veikkem gabbo lah kede shettittelennu:

Eno get ad sheyyomar teli gittech. ulechi amar teli gittech mihat have get. aval im haya hagget al gabbe karka o al gabbo o vegufo velo ikkem gabbo o lo himtzi gufo lah kede shettittelennu, afillu amar teli gittech eno get:
Kora vahare hi gittah. keshehi kora vo roa shehu gittah:

Karov lah megoreshet, karov lo enah megoreshet. kol shehi yechola leshamro vehu eno yachol leshamro, zehu karov lah. vechol shehi enah yechola leshamro vehu yachol leshamro zehu karov lo. shenehem yecholim leshamro o shenehem enam yecholim leshamro, zehu mechetza al mechetza. uleinyan pesak halacha enah megoreshet ad sheyyaggia get leyadah o lirshutah:

Velana immo befundeki. veyesh sham ede yichud veen sham ede via. bet hillel savre hen hen ede yichud hen hen ede via, veen adam ose beilato beilat zenut vahare kiddeshah babbia. uvet shammay savre lo amrinan hen hen ede yichud hen hen ede via ad sheyyiruha shennivala:

Get kereach. shekkesharav merubbin meedav. detakkun rabbanan get mekushshar mishshum kohanim kappedanim shehayu chotvim get pitom linshotehem umitchartim velo hayu yecholim lehacheziran, vetiknu lahem get mekushshar sheeno noach likkatev mehera, shemma vetoch kach yitpayyes. vechotev shita achat o shetayim vechorchan al hechalak vetofer, veed echad chotem al hakkerech mibbachutz, vechozer vechotev shene shittin o yoter mibbifnim vechorchan al hechalak vechotem ed sheni al hakkerech mibbachutz, vechen ed shelishi. veim yesh kesher karuch veen ed chatum meachorav, zehu kereach ufasul, demistama leminyan kesharav hayu edav mittechilla, vechayshinan dilma habbaal amar lehu kullechem chatomu, vahare echad shello chatam. veim nisset ishsha veget ze, tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. umatnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar kol hammeshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin havvalad mamzer. veenah halacha:

Al menat shetteshammeshi et abba, al menat shetteniki et beni. baggemara muchach dechol setam shello kava zeman kamma teshammesh et aviv o kamma tenik et beno, kimfaresh yom echad dame, venitkayyem hattenay im teshammesh et aviv o tenik et beno yom echad bilvad:
Kamma hi menikato. kelomar kamma hu zeman hayyenika, sheim henikato yom echad beze hazzeman, nitkayyem hattenay:

Shete shanim. rabbi yehuda omer shemona asar chodesh. aval im henika oto achar sheshshalmu shete shanim lerabbanan ushemona asar chodesh lerabbi yehuda, en zo yenika, velo nitkayyem hattenay. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Met habben. velo henikato kelal:
O met haav. velo shimmeshatto:
Hare ze get. delav letziura ikkavven bitnao, ella leharevacha dideh, veha lo itzterich, veim haya yodea sheyyamut aviv o veno lo haya matne:
Shello vehakepada. af al pi shehi lo hichisato, veen haakkava mimmenna, eno get. vechol shekken im haya vehakepada:
Kaze get. hoil velo hikpidato veen haakkava mimmenna. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Hakkedera tehora. vehu shello raa hashsheretz avir hakkedera keshennafal battannur:
Nitma. hammashke, vechazar vetimme et hakkedera, kedin kol mashkin temein shemmetammeim kelim:
Metammeecha lo timmeuni. hakkedera omeret lammashkin, avir keli cheres shekkibbalta mimmennu hattuma lo timmeuni, deen keli cheres mittamme meavir keli cheres:
Veatta timmetani. shennitmet hakkedera mechamat mashkim temeim:

Uvayyarak hakkishshuim vehaavattichim. hachi kaamar arbaa minim hallalu bayyarak, shehen hakkishshuin vehaavattichim vehaddeluin vehammelaffonot, uveferot hailan hattappuchim vehaetrogim, chayyavim ben gedolim ben ketannim, lefi shettechillatan ochel vesofan ochel, vehen neechalim ben gedolim ben ketannim:
Rabbi shimon poter et haetrogin bekatnan. disvira leh sheen neechalim ketannim, velo have techillatan ochel. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shekedim hammarim. neechalim bekatnan veen neechalim begadlan. ushekedim metukim ippecha:
Happered. regilin hayu lefared barimmonim uleyabbeshan, veotan haggargerim yeveshim keruyin pered al shem shemmafridim otan kede shettikkanes bahen [hachamma] mikkol tzad:
Mishsheyyefakkel. kemo mishsheyyekallef, kelomar mishsheyyasir mealehen hakkelippot haraot:
Mishsheyyemareach. achar shemmenakkin hattevua min hammotz shellah tzovrim otah bemakom echad baggoren, umeyappe pene hakkeri umachalikin oto, vehu hannikra meruach:
Misheyyichbor. lefi shergilim laakor hakkitnit im heafar tzarich lechavram bichvara:
Kuttaim. shibbolim ketuim shello niddoshu:
Min hatztzedadim. tzidde hakkeri shello nitmarach:
Umimma shebbetoch hatteven. shello nizra min hammotz:
Hammaale ferot min haggalil. likket perot baggalil kede lemachran bihuda, lo hukbeu lammaaser afillu lan badderech, ad sheyyaggia lihuda sheddato lemachram sham:
Vechen bachazara. im kodem shehiggia lihuda nimlach lehachaziran laggalil, ochel mehen aray badderech ad sheyyaggia laggalil:
Ad shehu maggia limkom hashshevita. lammakom shehu rotze lanuach sham bashshabbat, umiyyad kesheyyaggia sham hukbeu ferotav lammaaser af al pi sheadayin lo higgia shabbat. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Veharochlin hamechazzerin baayarot. limkor besamim vetamruke hannashim, umolichin immahem perot, ochlim mehen aray ad sheyyaggiu limkom hallina, ucheshemmaggiim sham hukbeu happerot lammaaser:

Rabbi yehuda omer bayit rishon. shebbair shehu lan sham, kovea lammaaser, vaafillu hu lan bakkatze haacher shel hair, lefi sheadam rotze lefannot kelav bevayit rishon shehu pogea kede lalun sham. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Laasot bezetim. laador ulekashkesh tachat hazzetim, velo lilkot, dehashta eno ochel min hattora:
Veim tzeraf. shenayim beyachad chayyav dahave keva:
Lenakkesh bivtzalim. litlosh haasavim haraim haggedelim betoch habbetzalim:
Mekarsem. mechattech, vedome lo yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar (tehillim 80):

Karshine teruma. ikkaram lemaachal behema, dei ikkaram lemaachal adam haya asur lehaachilan labbehema. umikkol makom chazu ketzat lemaachal adam, dei lo havo chazu kelal laadam, lo hayu mafrishim alehem terumot umaasrot, demide delo chaze laadam en mafrishin alav terumot umaasrot:
Maachilin otan. kohanim livhemtan:

Maachilah karshine teruma. hoil veguf habbehema lakkohen, af al pi shemmezonoteha al yisrael. veen kan mishshum gazel, sheim haya rotze haya noten hatteruma levaal happara, vaanan sahade denicha leh levaal happara sheyyitten lah karshine teruma kede sheyyaachilenna berevach, vahave keillu zacha vahen kohen vehu maachilan livhemto:

Lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. kevan shegguf happara leyisrael, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo, venefesh afillu nefesh behema bemashma. veamar rachamana kinyan kaspo dechohen lechol bitruma, kinyan kaspo shel yisrael lo lechol bitruma:

Yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen. shekkibbel para mikkohen beshuma kefi ma shehi shava achshav kach vechach damim, vitappel bah yisrael lefattemah, uma sheyyashbiach al hashshuma yechalleku harevach benehem:
Lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. shekkevan shekkibbelah hayyisrael beshumatah kefi ma shehi shava, naaset parato shel yisrael veenah ochelet bitruma:
Vechohen shekkibbel parato shel yisrael. beshuma bederech zo:
Maachilah charshine teruma. mippene shehi naaset parato shel kohen mishshaa shekkibbelah alav beshuma:
Baayin shel tannur. hu chor keen ayin sheosim battannur lehotzi heashan, ucheshemmachnisim happat lattannur sotmim oto shello yetze hachom, veeno chashuv ketocho shel tannur:
Im haya vaavir. bemakom megulle shello haya tachat haohel, afillu chazayit min hammet natun beeno, tahor hattannur, deen tuma nichneset letocho chevan sheen baayin poteach tefach:
Veim yesh bo foteach tefach. sheovi sefat haayin hachitzona boletet umaahelet al kazzayit min hammet betefach al tefach:
Hakkol tame. haayin vehattannur. shettefach al tefach ohel mevi et hattuma:

Dachon. leshon makom. kemo duch pelan [berachot 18:]. vehu makom bolet min hakkira shekkeshemmotziin hakkedera min hakkira moshivin otah al otah habbelita, ufeamim yesh lo vet kibbul shete kederot o shalosh:
Tahor mishshum kira. deim nitmet hakkira lo nitma hu. i nammi, eno mittamme vimchubbar kakkira:
Hatztzedadim shello. ketalav shel dachon sheenan min hakkira:
Harachav shello. hu chotel hakkira atzmah letzad bet kibbulo shel dachon. ulefi shehaddachon marchiv veholech letzad hakkira kare la rachav:
Rabbi meir metaher. dela chashiv kakkira:
Verabbi yehuda metamme. dachashiv kakkira. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Vechen hakkofe et hassal. uvana al gabbav kira, uvolet chutz lakkira. vehassal hu mittamme mishshum keli etz, ucheshebbana alav kira verochav hassal bolet chutz ledafne hakkira veshoftim kederot al otah habbelita, dino chedachon:
Hattannur shechatzatzo. sheasa mechitztza beemtzaito vechilleko ad lemala mippiv:
Hakkol tame. afillu ochalim shebbaever hashsheni shel mechitztza:

Kavveret pechuta ufekuka vekash. lehachi nakat pechuta, delav keli hi, dei hava shelema hayta matztzelet al ochalim shebbetochah, daafillu cheli shetef matztzil, aval hasheta delav keli hi haveya chimchitztza vealma. ufekuka vekash lirvuta nekatah, deaf al gav difchitatah pekuka vekash lo haveya cheli veen matztzelet al ochalim shebbetochah:
Umeshulshelet. teluya:
Im hitztzila vemet hechamur. dechavveret pechuta ufekuka vekash chotzetzet bifne hattuma veohel hammet, veaf al pi shettumato chamura letamme adam vechelim tumat shiva:
Lo tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal. sheeno metamme ella ochalim umashkim:
Shekken cholkim ohalim. shedderech bene adam lachalok ohalim bimchitztza, hilkach haveya kavveret kimchitztza umatztzelet beohel hammet min hattuma:

Sheen cholkim kele chares. sheen derech lachalok kele cheres bimchitztza. perush acher veikkar, shekken cholkim ohalim, shemmoelet chalukkat mechitztza veohalim, deha tenan bemassechet ohalot perek sagos ave, bayit shechatzatzo binsarim o viriot, tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbetoch hammechitztza tehorim. veen chalukkat hammechitztza moelet bichle cheres, degabbe tannur tenan hacha tannur shechatzatzo vinsarim o viriot, nimtza sheretz bemakom echad hakkol tame. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Lematta minnechushto shel tannur. ritzpa shemmoshivin sham hattannur. shehattannur asuy kemin kedera gedola sheen lah shulayim, umetakkenim lo ritzpa vakkarka umoshivin oto sham, veotah ritzpa hi nechushto shel tannur:

Chay nafal. velo nitma hattannur. dei met nafal, haya hattannur mittamme baavir keshennafal derech piv shel tannur. veha dela talinan shemma sham haya kodem shehoshivu sham hattannur, lefi shellifamim nimtza hashsheretz lach venikkar shemmechadash met vehattannur yesh yamim merubbim shehoshivuhu sham, vehasheta i efshar lomar shehashsheretz kadam sham lattannur, deim ken mechom haesh haya nisraf venaasa efer, ella talinan shemma chay nafal, vederech sheratzim laasot chafirot bakkarka lehittamen sham, lefichach nimtza lematta minnechushto:
Sham hayu ad shello va hattannur. kodem shehoshivuhu sham velo raa avir hattannur:

Beefer mikle. shennaasa mechamat serefat haesh. vehayenu lemala bachalal hattannur. umishshum deashkechan afar deikkere efer vehacha veefer shel serefa mishtae, mishshum hachi tana efer mikle, leshon kaluy baesh:

Ezehu garnan lammaasrot. ematay hukbeu happerot lammaaser veasur leechol mehen aray, kemo hattevua vaggoren. sheaf al pi shehiggiu happerot leonat hammaasrot adayin muttar leechol mehen aray ad sheyyehe garnan lammaasrot:
Mishsheyyefaksu. mishsheyyinnatel pekas shellahem, vehu sear hatztzomeach bahen keshehen ketannim, ucheshennitbashshelu kol tzarkan nosher:
Mishsheyyaamid arema. sheyyaase mehen keri:
Mishsheyyeshallek. shilluk laavattiach kemo fikkus laddeluim:
Muktze. lefi sheen osim arema min haavattichim ella shotchim otam, umakom sheshshotchim bo happerot karuy muktze:
Yarak hanneegad. sheddarko lemachro aguddot:
Veim eno memalle et hakkeli. kegon sherotze lemallot shenayim o shelosha chelim, ochel mikkol echad aray ad sheyyemalle et haacharon:
Kalkala. hamelakket yarak letoch hakkalkala dehaynu sal:
Mishsheyyechappe. et hayyarak behutzin o vealin sheddarkan lechassot bo:
Bamme devarim amurim. shezzehu garnan lammaasrot:
Bemolich lashshuk. limkor, delav bedato haddavar taluy, shemma yimtza lakochot veyihyu happerot tevulim shehammikkach kovea lammaaser:

Aval bemolich leveto ochel aray ad shemmaggia leveto. divdato taluy haddavar, velo yihyu happerot tevulim ad sheyyaggia leveto, shehattevel eno chayyav bammaaser ad sheyyire pene habbayit, dichtiv (Devarim 26) biarti hakkodesh min habbayit:

Charasim shennishtammesh bahen mashkin temeim. kegon avit shel meme raglayim shel zav veshel zava shennishbar vacharasav balu meme raglehem. umayre chegon shehedichum bemayim shalosh peamim, shello nishar bahen mashke tame. dei lo hedichum, nitma hattannur mechamat hammashkim haddevukin bedafnotav keillu hen been:
Shessof mashke latzet. kelomar, derech mashke latzet al yede libbun hacharasim, vechevan shehayu ellu hacharasim battannur bishat hesseko yatzu hammashkin mehen vetimmeu hattannur meaviro:
Gefet. pesolet shel zetim leachar shehotziu shamnan:
Chadasha. toch shenem asar chodesh:
Yeshana. leachar shenem asar chodesh, devistama yatza chol hammashke shebbahen:

Katav leshum malchut sheenah hogenet. im haya bevavel vechatav lecheshbon shenot malchut edom, sheen lahem malchut bimkom ketivat hagget, tetze mizze umizze. venikret malchut [edom] malchut sheenah hogenet sheen lah lo ketav velo lashon:

O shekkatav leshum malchut maday. lefi shetztzarich lichtov leshem hammalchut shel medina shehagget nichtav bah, mishshum shelom malchut, sheyyomru chashuvim anu beenehem shekkotvim shetarotehem bishmenu:
Tetze mizze umizze. im nisset beget ze tetze min harishon umin hashsheni:
Veen lah lo ferot velo velaot vechulei. kullah matnitin mifarsha bivamot perek haishsha rabba:
Vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar kol hammeshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin havvalad mamzer. veenah halacha:
Mishsheyyekappe. mishsheyyasir hachartzannim vehazzaggim shemmaale hayyayin betoch bor shel yayin bishat retichato:
Min haggat haelyona. sheadayin lo yarad labbor:
Umin hatztzinnor. heasuy befi haggat, vehayyayin mekalleach min hatztzinnor labbor. vehayyayin shebbaggat o shebbatztzinnor adayin lo nigmera melachto:
Lauka. gumma shellifne vet habbad shehashshemen yored letochah:
Akal. keli asuy mechavalim shetztzovrim hazzetim letocho keshemmachbidim hakkora alehem:
Mamal. harechev haelyona shettochanin bah hazzetim:
Mibben happatztzim. shemen hayyotze mibben hannesarim:

Chamitta. hi ugga dakka, ucheshemmotziin otah min hattannur regilim lehachalik paneha beshemen, veka mashma lan delo chashiv kimvushshal. shehaesh kovaat lammaaser veasur leechol aray mikkol tevua uferot virakot shennitbashshelu vaur, aval hay lo chashiv bishshul:
Vechen lattamchuy. dichli sheni hu veeno mevashshel:
Aval lo yitten. shemen lakkedera velailfas keshehen martichim. af al pi sheheeviran min haur, veyochal achilat aray, dechol zeman shehayyad soledet bahen chashuv kimvashshel vekava lammaaser:
Lakkol hu noten. lechol ilfasin rotchin ulechol kederot rotchot hu noten, leachar sheheeviran min haur, veeno kovea lammaaser:
Chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir. shecharifato shel chometz vetzir mesayyea levashshel. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Higgia leantippatres. mefaresh baggemara mishna zo, kegon deatne shene tenaim, i matina laggalil, lealtar leheve gitta. vei lo matina laggalil, i mishtahinan telatin yomin velo atina leheve gitta, vei lo, lo leheve gitta. vehalach vehiggia leantippatres shehu sof eretz yehuda vechazar kodem sheloshim yom, batel hagget. delo laggalil meta, velo ishtahe telatin yomin:
Vechen im haya holech miggalil lihuda vehiggia lichfar otnay. shehu viktze gevul haggalil:

Vechen im haya holech limdinat hayyam vehiggia leakko. shehu viktze gevul shel eretz yisrael vechazar betoch sheloshim yom, batel hagget, shehare lo halach limdinat hayyam vegam lo nishtaha sheloshim yom:
Kol zeman sheeevor mikkeneged panayich sheloshim yom. kesheeshtahe sheloshim yom over minneged panayich az yehe get:

Vehaya holech uva vechulei. leachar mikkan kesheyyishtahe sheloshim yom over minneged paneha, yehe get. velo amrinan hoil umeikkara haya holech uva, nachush shemma piyyes ketata shebbenehem uvatel gitta, demeachar shello nityached immah beshaa shehaya holech uva, lo chayshinan shemma fiyyes. vechi mekayyem tenaeh veshaha sheloshim yom over minneged paneha, have gitta. uvaggemara moke lah baomer bishat hattenay al menat ken ani moser lah hagget, shettehe neemenet alay chemea edim kol zeman shettomar shello bati venityachadti ufiyyasti. vechen halacha. sheim lo amar ken bishat hattenay, chayshinan shemma yavo baal viarer vayyomar piyyasti:

Ketzad meshaarin otan. lefi shehappitputim rechokim ze mizze, ucheshennimtza sheretz benehem en anu yecholim ladaat im hu vetoch shalosh lassafa vetame, o chutz leshalosh vetahor, lerabbi meir baavir ulerabbi shimon ben bemagga ben baavir, hilkach moded lefitput ze shalosh etzbaot min hassafa vechen lashsheni, venoten haamma shemmesargelim bah et hassefarim bentayim mizze laze, vehi nikret kanna, umesargel, umin hassargel velifnim tame, dehaynu nammi mekom hakkanna, umin hassargel velachutz tahor:
Bamme makkifin. bamme sotmim pi hakkeli o medabbekim hakkissuy al pi hakkeli veyechashev tzamid patil:
Gippesis. min sid hu, veyoter lavan missid, venisraf bechivshan kemo hassid:
Charsit. ketishat charasim, velashim otah vammayim:
Baatz. hu bedil. et habbedil, metargeminan yat avtza. vetargum yerushalmi batza:
Shehu fatil veeno tzamid. kelomar kissuy hu, aval eno mechubbar umedubbak yafe al pi hakkeli:

Lo vidvela shemena velo bevatzek shennillosh beme ferot. veaf al gav dematztzilim shehare lo huchsheru lekabbel tuma, af al pi chen lechattechilla en makkifin bahen, gezera shemma yuchsheru, sheyyippelu alehen mashkin hammachshirim, veen davar tame matztzil:
Veim hikkif. velo va alehen mayim o echad min hammashkin hammachshirin, hitztzilu:
Kol haarayot sheamru tzarotehen muttarot. chamesh esre arayot sheamru chachamim shetztzarotehen muttarot linnase lashshuk belo chalitza:
Halchu hatztzarot. shel arayot:
Venisseu. lashshuk:
Venimtzeu. haarayot aylonit, veiggallay milleta shehayu kiddushe hammet betaut, venimtza shello hayu ellu tzarotehen velo fetarum haarayot haellu min hachalitza:
Tetze mizze. mibbaal shennisset lo. umin hayyavam:
Vechol hadderachim haellu vah. uvivamot mokminan la kerabbi akiva deamar yesh mamzer mechayyeve lavin, veenah halacha:

Bet seor mukkaf tzamid patil. bichli cheres askinan, shemmatztzil baavir hattannur betzamid patil kederech shemmatztzil beohel hammet, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) mikkol haochel asher yeachel, velo kol haochel, perat lemukkaf tzamid patil bichli cheres venatun letoch hattannur sheeno mittamme meavir hattannur. aval keli shetef eno matztzil betzamid patil al ochalim shebbetocho, dehachi tane vetorat kohanim, [kol] haochel, lehavi hammukkaf tzamid patil bichli shetef venatun letoch hattannur, sheeno matztzil miyyad keli cheres:

Hasseor vehashsheretz betocho vehakkeretz bentayim. kegon sheyyesh lichli ze shene kibbulin, vehammechitztza hammafseket ben bet kibbul lachavero nikret keretz, leshon mechomer koratzti gam ani (Iyov 33), vehammechitztza maggaat ad sefato, vehasseor mitztzad echad vehashsheretz mitztzad acher vehakkeretz hi hammechitztza hachotzetzet bentayim, umukkaf hakkeli chullo tzamid patil, denimtzeu hasseor vehashsheretz shenehem mukkafim tzamid patil:

Hattannur tame. mechamat hashsheretz shebbetoch hatztzamid patil. shetztzamid patil matztzil al hattohorot shebbetocho millekabbel tuma, veeno matztzil al hattuma shebbetocho shello letamme et acherim:
Vehasseor tahor. dahare hu mukkaf tzamid patil bifne atzmo:
Veim haya sham poteach tefach. shennifretza hammechitztza shebben hasseor uven kazzayit min hammet befoteach tefach:
Hakkol tame. detefach al tefach patuach mevi et hattuma:
Venafal laavir hattannur tame. demashkin temein metammein keli. veaf al pi shehammashkin beluin letoch hassefog, kiflutim damu, lefi shessefog asuy lehachenis ulehotzi bo:
Vechen chaticha shel lefet veshel gemi. havu chisfog. lefi shebbegemi vodkin bo et hayyayin vehave gam hu asuy lehachenis ulehotzi chisfog. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shene gittin shavin. bishmotehem:
Hare hashsheni vatel. delo yadinan deman nihu:
Kelal. zeman echad lechullan, bechach beshabbat geresh peloni felonit ufeloni felonit:

Tofes lechol achat. zeman lechol achat veachat, bechach beshabbat geresh peloni liflonit, vehishlim hagget. uvechach beshabbat geresh peloni liflonit, vehishlim hagget, vechen kullam. vehaedim millemattan:
Umenikat betochah. kemin kane chalul asuy mimmattechet, shennotnim rosho echad benekev hechavit umotzetz befiv merosho hashsheni veyotzin kol hammashkin shebbechavit derech otah menikat:

Hechavit vehammashkin tehorim umenikat temea. hechavit shel cheres, umenikat shebbetochah shel mattechet. hilkach hechavit vehammashkin sheen lahem tohora vammikve, vei metaharat lehu vehem shel am haaretz lo ate chaver leishtammoshe vehu, shehare hem bedelim mimmaggaam uvelav hachi nammi chol maachalam tame, lo gazru vehu rabbanan, venitztzolim betzamid patil, aval menikat shel mattechet sheyyesh lah tohora vammikve, im tetaharenna ate chaver leishtammoshe vah, sheyyishalenna meam haaretz veyatbilenna veyaariv shimshah veyishtammesh bah, kesavur en bah ella mishshum magga tame, vehu lo yada shehayta veohel hammet utzericha hazzaa shelishi ushevii, veaf al pi shehayta vichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, en tzamid patil shel keli shel am haaretz matztzilin min hattuma etzel chaver, shekkol kelav shel am haaretz hem bechezkat tuma etzel chaver, ucheli tame eno matztzil betzamid patil, sheen matztzil betzamid patil ella cheli cheres hattahor bilvad. veillu vau chachamim ligzor shello yatztzil shum keli cheres shel am haaretz betzamid patil, lo hayu amme haaratzot mekabbelin mehen, lefi shehen sevurin shehen bekiin veshomrin kelehen betohora. hilkach bichle cheres voochalim umashkin sheen lahen tohora vammikve, keshehayu betoch tzamid patil shel kele am haaretz omrim lahen tehorim hen veyishtammeshu vahen hen shemmachazikin kelehen bechezkat tehorim, veen lachush shemma yishal hechaver mehen, shehare hen etzlo vechezkat temein veen lahen tohora olamit, aval bichle shetef deikka lemechash shemma yishal hechaver mehem veyatbilem veyishtammesh bahem belo hazzaa shelishi ushevii, asu din shave lakkol veamru deen keli shetef nitztzol betzamid patil:

Uvet hillel omrim af menikat tehora. kodem sheshshamu taaman shel bet shammay lo hayu yodim mippene ma ochalim umashkin shebbetoch tzamid patil tehorin uchele mattechet temeim uleachar sheshshamu taaman kidfarshinan chazru lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
Venisset leacher. dekayma lan biat haachat poteret tzaratah:
Venimtzet zo. shennityabbema aylonit, veen yibbumeha yibbumin. venimtza shello niftera tzaratah venisset lashshuk belo chalitza:
Tetze mizze umizze. mibbaal ze umiyyevama harishon:
Sereda. kemin areva ketanna shehannachtom mishtammesh bah, vehi feshuta veenah mekabbelet tuma:
Shehi netuna al pi hattannur. umemurachat betit kede lehakkif betzamid patil velo yittamma hattannur beohel hammet:
Nisdak min hattannur lassereda. hayenu shennisdak hammeruach:

Melo fi mardea shello nichnas. hammardea hu malmad habbakar, veyesh behekkefo tefach veavyo shelish tefach, shekkol sheyyesh beavyo tefach yesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim. veshiur hassedek keshennisdak hammeruach, lerabbanan melo fi hammardea beshave, veaf al pi sheen hannekev gadol sheyyikkanes pi mardea bimloo, hoil veshave hassedek melo fi hammardea en kan tzamid patil, ulerabbi yehuda leolam have tzamid patil ad sheyyihye hassedek gadol sheyyikkanes bo fi hammardea:
Nisdeka sereda. atzma, lerabbanan kil mikkeshennisdak hammeruach ulerabbi yehuda kil keshennisdak hammeruach mikkeshennisdeka sereda atzmah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
